entries.title: Force Converter
entries.description:
Upon scoring a Micro-Missile, Rocket Launcher or Grenade Launcher Kill:
Grants Force Converter.

Sprinting while Force Converter is active grants Speed Booster.

Missiles:
Quicksilver Storm's Rocket Tracer, Nanotech Tracer Rounds, Exhaustive Research Rockets, Rocket Frames, Grand Overture Missiles, and Hazardous Propulsion's Exodus Rockets.
entries.officialDescription: After a final blow with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile, sprint for a short time to gain Speed Booster.

entries.title: Reactive Booster
entries.description:
Sprinting while at Critical Health, being Suspended, or being affected by a Stasis Debuff will grant Speed Booster.
Can only trigger once per Force Converter activation.
entries.officialDescription: Once per activation of Force Converter, sprinting while at critical health, being suspended, or being slowed by a Stasis effect will immediately grant Speed Booster for a short duration.

entries.title: Force Absorption
entries.description:
Upon scoring a Missile, Rocket Launcher or Grenade Launcher Kill:
20% Area-of-Effect Damage Resist and 60% Explosive Self-Damage Resist for 15 seconds.

Missiles:
Quicksilver Storm's Rocket Tracer, Nanotech Tracer Round, Exhaustive Research Rockets, Rocket Frames, Grand Overture Missiles, and Hazardous Propulsion's Exodus Rockets.

entries.title: Reactive Shock

Being hit by a Melee Attack triggers a Disorienting Burst, disorienting enemies within ? meters for ? seconds.

entries.description:

Grants Regenerative Threshold.

Consumes Regenerative Threshold.

entries.description:

entries.description:
Upon scoring a Weapon Kill within 4 seconds of reloading or readying a weapon:
Restores 40 HP.
Incurs a 3 second cooldown upon triggering. Must reload or swap weapons after the cooldown is over for the effect to trigger on kill.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.

entries.title: Unfaltering Focus
entries.description:
On Bow, Shotgun, or Sword Kill:
Resist x1 (10% | 2.5%) for 7 seconds.

entries.officialDescription: Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.

entries.title: Revving Up
entries.description:
While Movement Speed is at least ?m/s:
Grants a stack of Revving Up, with a maximum of 10 stacks.
Transforms into Fully Revved at 10 stacks.

Each Revving Up stack grants increased Critical Health Regeneration Speed. Does not affect Shields in any way.
By default, it takes 1.75 seconds for Critical Health to begin regenerating at a rate of 27.5%HP/s.
At x5 stacks, it takes 1.5 seconds to begin regenerating at a rate of ~37.5% HP/s.
At x10 stacks, it takes 1.25 seconds to begin regenerating at a rate of 45% HP/s

Sprinting: 5 seconds per stack, takes 45 seconds to max out regardless of speed.
Other movement (Jumping, Falling, Sword Swinging, Sparrows) greatly accelerate the rate based on their speed, down to a minimum of 1.25 seconds per stack.
Most easily achieved by using a Sparrow, as those reach the Movement Cap.

While Movement Speed is lower than 3m/s:
Rapidly removes 4 stacks per second after a 0.5 second delay.

While Fully Revved is ready:
Sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.
Triggering Speed Booster and sliding at least once grants Extended Slide Distance until death.
entries.officialDescription: Fast movement builds up a charge that gradually increases your health regeneration speed. Once you are Fully Revved, sprinting grants Speed Booster.

annotations.text: Does not affect Shields in any way.

entries.title: Dielectric Drift
entries.description:

Sliding inflicts Jolt to Combatants within ? meters.

entries.title: Between Poles
entries.description:
Light Weapon Kills grant a stack of Light Polarity for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Light Polarity grants +8 | +16 | +24 | +32 | +40 Grenade Stat.

Kinetic/Dark Weapon Kills grant a stack of Dark Polarity for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Dark Polarity grants +8 | +16 | +24 | +32 | +40 Melee Stat.

Scoring a Non-Alignment Matching Weapon Kill removes all stacks.
ANY Light Polarity --> Dark Alignment Weapon Kill --> x1 Dark Polarity and x0 Light Polarity.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.

entries.title: So Very Thin
entries.description:
Light Weapon Kills grant ~16% Grenade Energy.
Kinetic/Dark Weapon Kills grant ~16% Melee Energy.

Resist x3 (40% [7.5%] DR) for 5 seconds.
Refreshable by retriggering the effect.

Both effects can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.

entries.title: Shock and Clear
entries.description:
Upon scoring a Jolt Kill or a Jolted Enemy Kill:
Creates an Ionic Trace.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.

entries.title: Photogalvanic
entries.description:
Upon receiving ANY healing while not at Full HP:
+20? Handling, +10 Reload Speed, 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier, and ?% Flinch Resist for Solar Weapons for 4 seconds.
Works with ANY source of healing, such as Orb Pickups. Restoration constantly refreshes it
entries.officialDescription: Receiving healing temporarily grants your Solar weapons increased flinch resistance, handling, and reload speed.

entries.title: Cauterize
entries.description:
Upon scoring 3 Solar Kills within 3? seconds of each:
Restores 30 HP.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between heals.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid Solar final blows heal you.

annotations.text: Incurs a 1 second cooldown between heals.

entries.title: Paroli
entries.description:
Upon sliding:
?% Flinch Resist for ? seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Primary ammo weapons gain a bonus to flinch resistance after sliding.

entries.title: Martingale
entries.description:
On Ally Death or Ally Revival:
+? Handling and 0.?x ADS Duration Multiplier for 10 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Your weapons gain a temporary increase to handling and aim-down-sights speed when an ally is defeated or you revive an ally.

entries.title: Bad Dreams
entries.description:
Upon scoring 3 Elementally-Debuffed Enemy Kills:
Spawns an Orb of Power that grants ?% Super Energy.
No cooldown between Orbs?
entries.officialDescription: Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Dream-Devourer
entries.description:
On Elite+ Finisher:
Devour for 6+3 seconds.

While Devour is active:
20?% Damage Resist against Combatants.
entries.officialDescription: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.

entries.title: Iron Sharpens Iron
entries.description:
On Elite+/Guardian Kill:
+12% Special and +7.5% Heavy Ammo Progress.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows on Guardians and powerful combatants generate additional ammo progress.

entries.title: Ascendant Escape
entries.description:
On Elite+ Kill:
Grants Ascendant Escape.

Ascendant Escape: Upon reaching Critical Health or being damaged while at Critical Health:
Invisibility for 6+? seconds.
entries.officialDescription: After a final blow on a powerful combatant, the next time your shields are broken, you become invisible.

entries.title: Well Prepared
entries.description:
On Ammo Brick Pickup: 
Grants a stack of Armor Charge.

Each Armor Charge stack grants +10 Health Stat.
Grants up to +30 Health Stat with x3 Armor Charge.
Maxes out at +60 Health Stat with x6 Armor Charges.
entries.officialDescription: Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.

entries.title: Down the Line
entries.description:
Upon scoring a hit against Miniboss+ Combatants:
Grants a stack of Down the Line, up to a maximum of 10 stacks. 
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between gaining stacks.

Down the Line:
15% increased Weapon Damage against Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants.
Consumes a stack upon killing Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants.
entries.officialDescription: Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.

annotations.text: Incurs a 1 second cooldown between gaining stacks.

entries.title: Primary Chain
entries.description:
On Primary Ammo Weapon Kill:
Grants a stack of Primary Chain, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.
Stacks are only lost on death.

Primary Chain | +5 Mobility, +5 Range, and +10? Handling for Primary Ammo Weapons per stack.
Maxes out at +15 Mobility, +15 Range, and +30? Handling after scoring 3 Primary Ammo Weapon Kills.
entries.officialDescription: Primary ammo weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to mobility and Primary weapon range and handling until you are defeated.

annotations.text: Stacks are only lost on death.

entries.title: Sublime Transit
entries.description: Passively grants +20 Mobility, increases Sprint Speed from 8 m/s to 8.5m/s, and increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters.
entries.officialDescription: Increases mobility and grants enhanced sprint speed and slide distance.

entries.title: Stable Resonance
entries.description:
On Elite+ Kill:
7% Increased Weapon Damage and Resist x2 (25% DR) for 12 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.

entries.title: Resonance Redirection
entries.description:
While Stable Resonance is active:
Dealing 600? Weapon Damage within ? seconds of each triggers an Exhausting Blast, centered on the enemy.
Incurs an 2? second cooldown between Exhausting Blasts.

Exhausting Blast deals ? Damage and inflicts Exhaust over 8 meters, reducing Combatant Damage Output by 25%.
entries.officialDescription: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.

annotations.text: Incurs an 2? second cooldown between Exhausting Blasts.

entries.title: Resonant Plating
entries.description:
Upon receiving a Melee Attack from a Miniboss+ Combatant:
Begins Health Regeneration.
entries.officialDescription: Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.

entries.title: Siphoning Touch
entries.description:
Upon scoring weapon damage instances or a Glaive Melee Attack:
Grants a stack of Siphoning Touch, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
x1 = ~26.7% of Mag | x2 = ~53.4% | x3 = ~80% | x4 = ~106% | x5 = ~133%
Scorch does not count for damage instances. Always rounds down

On Weapon Stow:
Consumes all Siphoning Touch to restores HP, based on the stack amount.
30 | 60 | 90 | 105 | 120 HP restored.
entries.officialDescription: Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.

annotations.text: does not count for damage instances. Always rounds down

entries.title: A Wish for Protection
entries.description:
Upon receiving ? damage within ? seconds of each damage instance:
Grants Protective Wish for 7 seconds.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown once the buff expires before it can be triggered again.

Protective Wish:
+? Reload Speed and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer.
entries.officialDescription: Taking significant damage in a short time generates a Protective Wish that makes it harder for combatants to hit you, and grants increased reload speed and flinch resistance.

annotations.text: Incurs a 5 second cooldown once the buff expires before it can be triggered again.
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer

entries.title: A Wish Fulfilled
entries.description:
On Protective Wish expiry:
Grants Cure x1.

Upon scoring ? Kills within ? seconds of each:
Protective Wish expires prematurely.
entries.officialDescription:
When the Protective Wish expires, it cures you.

Rapid final blows prematurely end the Protective Wish.

entries.title: Combat Meditation
entries.description:
On Sword Hit:
3% Grenade and Class Ability Energy.
entries.officialDescription: Sword hits return grenade and class energy. Bonus energy is granted if Blade Focus is active.

entries.title: Blade Focus
entries.description:
Upon guarding for 1.35 seconds:
Grants Blade Focus Ready for 1 second.
 Swinging while it is active AND scoring a hit consumes Blade Focus Ready to grant Blade Focus for 7 seconds.

Blade Focus:
10% Increased Sword Damage and 100% Increased Sword Lunge Distance
Combat Meditation Energy Gains are increased to 8% Grenade and Class Ability Energy.
Blade Focus is removed upon guarding or stowing the sword.
entries.officialDescription: Briefly guard with a Sword to ready Blade Focus. While Blade Focus is readied, hitting a target with your sword increases Sword damage and lunge distance for a moderate duration.

annotations.text: is removed upon guarding or stowing the sword.

entries.title: Rasputin's Wrath
entries.description:
Upon scoring a kill with any of the following methods: 
Explosive Damage | Solar Ability Damage | Seventh Seraph Weapons | IKELOS Weapons | Sleeper Simulant | Outbreak Perfected:
Grants a Warmind Charge for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 charges.
All stacks disappear upon expiry.

Warmind Charges each grant +3 Grenade Stat and +3 Weapons Stat, up to +30 Grenade Stat and +30 Weapons Stat at 10 charges.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with area-of-effect damage, Solar abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, or IKELOS weapons grant Warmind Charges. Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.

entries.title: Rasputin's Reprisal
entries.description:
Upon killing an Elite+ Combatant or destroying a Construct/Tangle while having Warmind Charges:

Triggers a Warmind Detonation, centered on the Combatant/Construct.
Detonation (from Elite Kill) deals 405 [?] Solar Damage and restores 50 HP to the user and their allies over 10 meters without falloff.
Detonation (from destroying a Construct) deals half the damage and restores half the health. <---NEEDS MORE THOROUGH TESTING
Detonation Kills can grant Warmind Charges, but will not chain into additional Warmind Detonations.
Incurs a 0.3? second internal cooldown between explosions? Hard to test sometimes
entries.officialDescription:
While you have Warmind Charges, defeating powerful combatants, destroying a construct, or destroying a Tangle releases a Solar detonation that damages combatants and heals allies.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

annotations.text: Incurs a 0.3? second internal cooldown between explosions? Hard to test sometimes

entries.title: Reflex Action
entries.description:
Upon readying a Heat Weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon:
Grants Reflex Action for 1.5 seconds.
 Dealing Additional Weapon Damage refreshes the buff duration.

Reflex Action | +50? Handling, 0.6?x Ready Duration Multiplier, and -2.5% Accuracy Cone Size for 1.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Swapping to a Heat weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants a short period of increased handling and accuracy. This effect is extended by dealing damage with that weapon.

entries.title: Hotshot
entries.description:
While Reflex Action is active:
Scoring a kill grants Hotshot for 10 seconds.
Buff can be refreshed by retriggering Hotshot.

Hotshot | +15? Stability, +20 Reload Speed, and +? Aim Assist for Heat Weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons. Additionally, it grants +30 Weapons stat.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing final blows while Reflex Action is active grants a bonus to weapon stat and increases stability, reload, and aim assist for Heat weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons for a moderate duration.

entries.title: Ride Together, Die Together
entries.description:
On Orb of Power Pickup:
Grants Ride Together, Die Together for 3 seconds.
Ride Together, Die Together initially grants 40% [5%] Damage Resist.
Damage Resist scales down to ~30?% with 1.5 seconds left, further reduced to 24?% with 1 second left, decreasing down to 0% over the remaining second.
entries.officialDescription: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.

entries.title: Too Old for This
entries.description:
On Elite+ Finisher:
Restores 32 HP and +16% Special Ammo Progress.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.

entries.title: Augmented Armaments
entries.description:
Primary Ammo Weapons deal 15% increased damage against Disoriented Combatants.
Does NOT work with Arc Blind.
entries.officialDescription: Primary ammo weapons deal increased damage to disoriented combatants.

entries.title: Augmented Explosives
entries.description:
On Grenade Ability Detonation: 
Disorients enemies within 10 meters for 2.7 seconds.
Does not work on Grapple. 
Does not work on Young Ahamkara Spine's Tripmines.
entries.officialDescription: Your grenade abilities release an additional disorienting pulse shortly after detonating.

annotations.text:
. 
Does not work on Young Ahamkara Spine's Tripmines.

entries.title: Balestra
entries.description:
Upon damaging an enemy with a Sword, Glaive, or Melee Attack:
Inflicts Exhaustion for 5 seconds, reducing Combatant Damage Output by 25%.
entries.officialDescription:
Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

entries.title: Stesso Tempo
entries.description:
Upon blocking damage with a Glaive or a Sword:
50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4) for 3 seconds upon no longer guarding. 
Damage Resist can be reset by blocking and dropping the guard before buff expires.
entries.officialDescription: Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.

entries.title: The Ceremony
entries.description:
On Finisher or Ally Revival:
Initiates a Ceremony for 30 seconds.
Additional Finishers/Revivals extends the buff duration to 30 seconds.

While Ceremony is active:
+30 Super Stat.
entries.officialDescription: Finishing combatants or reviving allies initiates a Lucent Hive ritual. While the ritual is active, gain increased Super stat.

entries.title: Lucent Swarm
entries.description:
On Orb of Power Pickup:
Extends the Ceremony duration to 30 seconds.

While Ceremony is active:
Scoring 2 Ability Kills spawns a Loyal Arc Moth that lingers for 8 seconds.
Loyal Arc Moths relentlessly chase the closest enemy within 60+👀 meters, dealing up to 180 Arc Damage and inflicting blind for 8 seconds over ~6? meters.
Anything that would discharge Bolt Charge counts, including Unpowered Melee Kills and Forerunner's Rock EXCEPT FOR PRAXIC BLADE😔.
Arc Moth Damage is considered Generic Arc Damage. Does not benefit from Grenade, Melee, or Ability buffs nor does it interact with them.
entries.officialDescription: Collecting Orbs of Power extends the Ceremony. While it is active, ability final blows occasionally spawn allied Arc moths.

annotations.text: relentlessly chase the closest enemy within 60+
Arc Moth Damage is considered Generic Arc Damage. Does not benefit from
, or Ability buffs nor does it interact with them.

entries.title: Queensfoil Rush
entries.description:
Finishers grant a 200? HP Overshield for the duration of the finisher (+0.3s).

On Finisher:
Inflicts x? Slow to enemies within 7 meters.
entries.officialDescription: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.

entries.title: Truth to Power
entries.description:
Each damage instance scored grants a stack of Truth, up to a maximum of x999 stacks. wherein it gets renamed to Power.
Kills and Finishers grant many more stacks, although it seems to have different gains depending on the stack amount.
Kills tend to be within 20-35 stacks. Finishers tend to give around 60-90 stacks. 
ALL stacks are removed on death.

Truth grants Damage Resist per stack, up to 15% DR at maximum.
250 = 3.75% | 500 = 7.5% | 750 = 10% | 999 = 15% Damage Resist

Truth to Power Effect at x999 stacks:
+50% Additional Base Grenade, and Melee Regeneration Rate.
+35% Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
15% Damage Resist.
entries.officialDescription: Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.

annotations.text: ALL stacks are removed on death.

entries.title: Wrecker
entries.description:
Passively grants increased Kinetic Damage towards Combatant Shields, Overshields, Vehicles, and Constructs.
200% increased Kinetic Damage towards Combatant Shields and Combatant Overshields. Damage shows up as Yellow Numbers.
15% increased Kinetic Damage towards Constructs. Koregos is not a Construct lol
It's ALL Kinetic Damage, including Poison, Praxic Blade, and Unpowered/Glaive Melee!
entries.officialDescription: You deal significantly increased Kinetic damage to combatant shields, overshields, vehicles, and constructs. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

annotations.text: Damage shows up as Yellow Numbers.
Koregos is not a Construct lol
It's ALL Kinetic Damage, including Poison, Praxic Blade, and Unpowered/Glaive

entries.title: Concussive Rounds
entries.description:
Upon killing an Elite+ Combatant, or breaking a Combatant Shield with Kinetic Damage:
Triggers a disorienting Kinetic blast, dealing up to 162 Kinetic Damage, heavily staggering, and inflicting disorient to enemies within 10 meters for ? seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating powerful combatants or breaking a combatant shield with Kinetic damage releases a disorienting Kinetic shockwave.

entries.title: Opening Act
entries.description:
Upon scoring a Grenade Kill:
Grants Opening Act for 15 seconds.

Opening Act | +? Stability and +? Vent Speed to Heat Weapons. Primary Weapons are instead granted +? Stability and +? Reload Speed.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with grenades grant Heat weapons bonus stability and vent speed and grant Primary ammo weapons bonus stability and reload speed.

entries.title: Room Clearing
entries.description:
Upon scoring 3 Heat Weapons or Primary Weapon Kills within 4 seconds of each:
Grants Room Cleaning for 10 seconds.

Room Cleaning | +40 Grenade and +40 Weapons. Additionally, it grants +40 Ammo Generation for Heat Weapons and Primary Ammo Weapons.
entries.officialDescription: Multiple final blows with Heat weapons or Primary ammo weapons grant bonuses to weapon and grenade stats and increased ammo generation for Heat weapons and Primary ammo weapons.

entries.title: License to Thrill
entries.description:
On Grenade Ability Usage, or upon triggering either the Nanotech Tracer Missile Origin Trait or Quicksilver Storm's Missile Tracer: 
Grants a stack of License to Thrill for 15 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Buff duration is refreshed upon retriggering.

License to Thrill | 12% [2%] Damage Resist against enemies within <5 metres, increased by +?% [?%] per stack afterwards, up to 30% [5%] Damage Resist.
entries.officialDescription: Activating your grenade or the Nanotech Tracer Missiles Origin Trait provides stacking resistance to incoming damage at point-blank range.

entries.title: Lethal Weave
entries.description:
On Unraveled Enemy Kill:
10% Grenade Ability Energy.
+10% Special Ammo Progress if at maximum Grenade Ability Energy.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating an unraveled combatant grants grenade ability energy. If you have max grenade energy, you are granted Special ammo meter progress instead.

entries.title: Old Martian Diplomacy
entries.description:
On Weapon Stow after scoring an Elite+ or Guardian Weapon Kill:
Restores 40? HP and disorients Combatants within 12 meters.
Incurs a 2? second cooldown between activations
entries.officialDescription: Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.

annotations.text: Incurs a 2? second cooldown between activations

entries.title: High Noon
entries.description:
Upon readying a weapon:
7% Increased Weakspot Damage against Combatants for 4 seconds.
Buffs "Precision Hits" against Shielded Combatants and works on weapons without Precision Multipliers as long as they hit the weakspot.
Weakspot Buffs do not work on a Divinity Bubble

Bonus is doubled to 14% Increased Weakspot Damage for the following:
Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait and Tex Mechanica Exotics.
Dead Man's Tale | Huckleberry | Last Word | Tarrabah | Chaperone | Prospector
entries.officialDescription: Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.

annotations.text: Weakspot Buffs do not work on a Divinity Bubble

entries.title: Scoot to Loot
entries.description:
Upon scooting:
Pick ups Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.
+25 Handling and +25 Reload Speed for 10 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.

entries.title: Shoot to Scoot
entries.description:
Upon dealing Weapon Damage:
Increases Scoot Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters for 3? seconds.

While scooting:
50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4)
entries.officialDescription: Dealing damage with your weapons temporarily grants enhanced sliding. Sliding provides damage resistance.

entries.title: Crook and Flail
entries.description:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Restores 70 HP.
entries.officialDescription: Picking up an ammo brick heals you.

entries.title: Gift of Sight
entries.description:
Upon scoring a Primary Weapon Kill:
Enhanced Radar for 5 seconds.

Buff can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons grant you briefly increased radar resolution.

entries.title: Special Relativity
entries.description:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Refills stowed Special Weapons.
entries.officialDescription: Picking up ammo reloads stowed Special weapons from reserves.

entries.title: Superluminal Motion
entries.description:
Upon dealing Super Damage, while Movement Speed isn't 0m/s:
Restores 2? [?] HP/s for 11 seconds. 
Dealing Additional Super Damage refreshes the buff duration.
entries.officialDescription: After dealing damage with your Super, health and shields regenerate over time while you are in motion. Additional Super damage refreshes this effect.

entries.title: Lucent Transmutation
entries.description:
Upon scoring 2 Powered Melee Kills or a finisher:
Generates a Light-Subclass Super-Matching Elemental Pickup.
Does nothing while a Stasis or Strand Super is equipped. Kills must be spaced out by at least ~0.2 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Performing a finisher on a combatant, or landing successive powered melee final blows, generates an Elemental pickup based on your Light subclass.

entries.title: Lucent Tithes
entries.description:
On Elite+ Finisher:
Restores 50? HP and spawns 3 Loyal Void Moths that each grant 22.5HP Void Overshield to the user and their allies on impact.
entries.officialDescription: Performing a finisher on powerful combatants heals you and generates loyal Void moths.

entries.title: Fanfare
entries.description:
While Ammo = ≤50% of Magazine AND Ammo ≠ 0:
+15 Reload Speed and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier.

Does not trigger at 0 Ammo. rip bows, GLs, and Rockets
entries.officialDescription: Gain increased reload speed for the bottom half of your equipped weapon's magazine.

entries.title: Suros Harmony
entries.description:
Upon finishing a reload:
SUROS Harmony | +30? Handling and ?% Flinch Resist for 6 seconds.
Weapons that have the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait equipped, as well as SUROS Regime are additionally granted +15 Range. 
For some reason, the +Range benefit's timer begins only once you are able to shoot in the reload animation instead of when the ammo is refilled.

SUROS Harmony persists through stow, but only on the weapon that it was triggered on. 
Can be refreshed by retriggering the buff unless it is a SUROS Weapon lmao.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading a weapon grants it a bonus to handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time. Weapons with the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait are granted increased range instead.

annotations.text: only on the weapon that it was triggered on
unless it is a SUROS Weapon lmao

entries.title: Watchtower
entries.description:
Upon scoring a kill while ADS:
Resist x2 (25% [5%]) until no longer ADS.
entries.officialDescription: Precision final blows while aiming down sights grant damage resistance until you stop aiming down sights.

entries.title: Field Expertise
entries.description:
On Precision Kill:
Grants a stack of Field Expertise for 15 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Scoring a Non-Precision Weapon Kill immediately removes all stacks.

Field Expertise x1 | 3.5% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +? Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x2 | 7% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +? Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x3 | 8% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +? Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x4 | 9% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +? Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x5 | 10% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +? Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist.
entries.officialDescription:
Precision final blows with any weapon grant a stacking bonus to reload speed, target acquisition, and weapon damage against non-boss combatants for a short duration.

Weapon final blows with non-precision direct hits end this effect early.

entries.title: Untold Greed
entries.description:
Upon picking up an Ammo Brick, an Orb of Power, on Elemental Pickup, or destroying a Tangle:
Grants a stack of Untold Greed, up to a maximum of 100 stacks.

Upon reaching Critical Health:
Removes 10 stacks.

Untold Greed:
Up to +? Reload Speed and 15% Damage Resist at x25 stacks.
x5 = 6% DR | x10 = 9% DR | x15 = 11% DR | x20 = 13% DR | x25+ = 15% DR
entries.officialDescription: Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.

entries.title: Overflowing Coffers
entries.description:
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<<

While at x5 Untold Greed or higher:
Elemental Pickups are massively improved.
No discernible effect on Orbs of Power.

Firesprites (+120%) | 11.25% -> 25% Grenade Energy
Ionic Traces (+100% Class, +85% Grenade/Melee) | 11.25% Grenade/Melee + 13.5% Class -> 21% Grenade/Melee + 27% Class + 2% Super
Void Breaches (+120%) | 11.25% -> 25% Class Energy
Stasis Shards (+260%) | 10% -> 36% Melee Energy. Additive to Hunger's +60%, totalling 42.5% Energy per pickup.
Strand Tangles | 350% increased damage. Affects Whirling Maelstrom too!

Upon reaching Critical Health while having x5 Untold Greed or higher:
Consumes ALL STACKS to spawn 4 Orbs of Power that each grant ~3.15% Super Energy.
The Orbs of Power are ejected in front of the user at high speeds, likely clipping inside walls.

Looking upwards/downwards does not affect where the Orbs go.
Allied Guardians get the Orbs, too.
entries.officialDescription: While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.

annotations.text: No discernible effect on Orbs of Power.
Additive to Hunger's +60%, totalling 42.5% Energy per pickup.

entries.title: Press The Advantage
entries.description:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Shield:

+20 Stability, +20? Handling, and +20 Reload Speed for 10 seconds.
Swords receive +20 Guard Resistance.
entries.officialDescription: Breaking a combatant's shield grants increased weapon stability, handling, and reload speed. Swords gain increased guard resistance.

entries.title: Dielectric
entries.description:
On Arc-Debuffed Enemy Kill:

Grants x1 Bolt Charge.

Upon scoring 3 Arc-Debuffed Enemy Kills within 6 seconds of each:
Spawns an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.
Restores 40 HP.
entries.officialDescription:
Defeating 0 Arc debuffed targets grants Bolt Charge.

Rapidly defeating Arc debuffed targets spawns an Orb of Power and heals a small portion of health.

entries.title: Elemental Orbs: Arc
entries.description:
Upon scoring 6 [2?] Arc Weapon Kills:
Spawns an Arc Elemental Orb.

Arc Elemental Orb:
Arc Orbs remain on the ground for up to 20 seconds before expiring.
Arc Orbs that are picked up can be held for up to 20 seconds.

Arc Orbs deal up to 405 [101] damage, down to 90% damage, and inflict Jolt over 8 meters.
entries.officialDescription: 0 Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown or shot to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.

entries.title: Kinetic Synthesis
entries.description:
Dealing Kinetic Weapon Damage and scoring Kinetic Weapon Kills progress a counter, spawning an unique Kinetic Ammo Brick upon reaching 100%.
Counter lasts 15s and is refreshed upon dealing Kinetic Weapon Damage.

Each damage point grants 0.0265% progress, requiring 3770 damage to spawn a brick.
A499 generates 75% less progress (15K damage for a brick).
RnF Kill = 8% | Elite = 15% | Miniboss = 25%
Damage requirement IGNORES Power-Delta, but considers ACTUAL DAMAGE DEALT.
This means it requires the same "base damage" regardless of reduced damage from PL deltas.

Upon collecting a Kinetic Ammo Brick:
+5% Special and +5% Heavy Ammo Progress.
Refills equipped Kinetic Damage Weapons and generates Special/Heavy Ammo for them.
Generates (1/3rd of Magazine) + 1 Ammo, with certain exceptions.
Counts for Ammo Pickup effects. Kinetic Ammo Generation is unaffected by Scavenger Bricks.

Bastion = +1 Ammo | Cull's Shadow = +2 Ammo | Praxic = +2 Ammo |  Microcosm = +12 Ammo.
entries.officialDescription: Sustained Kinetic weapon damage and rapid final blows have a chance to generate a unique ammo brick. Collecting this brick will grant ammo to equipped Kinetic damage weapons and grant Special and Heavy ammo progress.

entries.title: Armorsmith

Kinetic Rupture Damage doesn't count as dealing damage to Combatants, uses PVP values for Damage Buffs, doesn't count as hitting nor missing either.
Eg: Radiant is 10%, Surges are 3% | 4.5% | 5.5%, Collective Action is 11%.

It's complicated, not worth on 99% of situations.
Tends to decrease damage by 25% to 50% on almost every situation.
One of the few meaningful exceptions is Izanagi x4
Izanagi x4 is +120% damage down baseline to +63% based on the buffs used.

entries.title: Limit Break
entries.description:
On Super Cast, while at Critical Health or affected by an Element-Matching Buff:

15% Increased Super Ability Damage.
One-Off Supers are only buffed for 8 seconds.
Roaming Supers are buffed until it runs out.

Arc = ↑Amplified ↑Bolt Charge
Solar = ↑Cure ↑Radiant ↑Restoration
Void = ↑Devour ↑Invisibility ↑Void Overshield
Stasis = ↑Frost Armor
Strand = ↑Woven Mail
entries.officialDescription: Casting a Super while you are critically wounded or have a elemental buff matching your Super element grants a period of increased Super damage.

entries.title: Perpetual Destruction
entries.description:
Non-Exotic Rocket Launcher Kills within 2-3? seconds of each progress a counter.
Rank-and-File = 25% | Elite = 34% | Miniboss = 100%

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress:
Rocket Launchers are granted +1 Ammo.
Precision/High-Impact Rockets (or Bipod RLs) receive +2 Ammo.
+? Reload Speed and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier for 10 seconds.
Not affected by Scavenger Mods.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid final blows with non-Exotic Rocket Launchers refund ammo and increase reload speed for a short duration.

entries.title: Gold from Lead
entries.description:
Upon picking up 5–6 Special Ammo Bricks:
Generates 8% Heavy Ammo, rounded up.
Pickup Counter is reset on death.
Not affected by Scavenger Mods.

Does not function in the Crucible.
entries.officialDescription: Picking up Special ammo has the chance to grant Heavy ammo.

annotations.text: Does not function in the Crucible.

entries.title: To Shreds
entries.description:
Upon scoring 6 weapon damage instances against Severed Enemies:
Inflicts Unravel.

On Severed Enemy Kill:
Releases 3 healing pulses on Enemy Death Location, restoring 15 HP and granting Woven Mail for 10 seconds to the user and allies within 10? metres every 2 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing sustained damage to severed targets unravels them. Defeating a severed target creates a hotspot of Strand energy, granting Woven Mail to nearby allies for a short duration.

entries.title: Wind Chill
entries.description:
Upon scoring multiple non-simultaneous Stasis Weapon Damage instances within 3 seconds of each:
Grants a stack of Frost Armor.
Incurs a 0.45s cooldown between triggers. Additional hits during this time do not count.
Counter resets on stow.

Instances to trigger Frost Armor:
Bows: 3 | Breech GL, Swords: 2
(35% of Magazine, rounded down) +2
Doesn't require a Stasis Weapon to be readied, instead using the current weapon's magazine for calculations.

Upon scoring multiple Stasis Weapon Damage instances within 3 seconds of each on Slowed Enemies:
Bows: 3 | Breech GLs, Swords: 2
(25% of Magazine, rounded down) +2
Spawns a Stasis Shard on top of the enemy.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid 0 Stasis weapon hits grant you a stack of Frost Armor; hits against slowed or frozen targets also create a Stasis Shard.

annotations.text:
Incurs a 0.45s cooldown between triggers. Additional hits during this time do not count.
Counter resets on stow.

entries.title: Frost Renewal
entries.description:
On Shield Break from Combatant Damage, while Frost Armor is active:

Releases a Stasis Burst over 10 meters.
Stasis Burst freezes enemies and grants a stack of Frost Armor to the user and allies in range.
entries.officialDescription: While you have Frost Armor, taking critical damage releases a burst that freezes nearby combatants and grants Frost Armor to you and nearby allies.

entries.title: Brain Freeze
entries.description: Frozen Enemies inflict x? Slow to enemies within 4? meters that aren't affected by Stasis Debuffs.
entries.officialDescription: Frozen combatants become surrounded by chilling fog, which slows combatants that aren't already.

entries.title: Crystalline Converter
entries.description:
Picking up Stasis Shards progresses the Crystalline Converter Counter.

Upon dealing Stasis Melee Damage or Diamond Lance Damage: 
Consumes the Crystalline Converter Counter.
Spawns Crystals based on the amount of Shards picked up.
8 | 12 | 15 Shards Pickups
1 | 2 | 3 Crystals Spawned

On Class Ability Usage:
The next Stasis Weapon Kill spawns a Stasis Shard.
entries.officialDescription:
After activating your class ability, your next 0 Stasis weapon final blow creates a Stasis Shard.

Gather Stasis Shards to gain stacks of Crystalline Converter, which cause your next powered Stasis melee hit to create Stasis crystals equal to the number of stacks you have.

entries.title: Hail The Storm
entries.description:
Upon shattering a Stasis Crystal:

Releases 5 Homing Ice Shards in a * pattern, each dealing 46 damage and inflicting x? [x10] Slow for ? seconds.
Shards are spread uniformally, with one shard going towards the closest enemy and the others spreading.

Enemy Shatters deal 12.5% [?%] increased damage.
Crystal Shatters deal 25% [?%] increased damage.
entries.officialDescription:
Shattering frozen targets and Stasis crystals deals increased damage.

Shattering Stasis crystals releases shards of ice that damage and slow targets.

entries.title: Supernova
entries.description:
On Void Breach Pickup: 

The next Void Damage Instance within 10 seconds releases a weakening burst, inflicting Weaken to enemies within 5? metres.
entries.officialDescription: Picking up a Void Breach causes your next source of Void damage to create a large weakening pulse.

entries.title: Total Carnage
entries.description:
Upon finishing an Elite+ Combatant:

Restores 100 HP.
Begins Health Regeneration.
25% Damage Resist (Resist x2) for 11 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: After finishing a powerful combatant, gain temporary damage resistance and replenish health.

entries.title: Debilitating Wave
entries.description:
Upon finishing a Combatant:

Triggers a wave, dealing 180 Super-Element Matching Damage up to 15? meters away.
Wave travels in the direction of the finisher and tracks enemies.

Equipping an Arc, Void, or Stasis Super makes the wave inflict a Super-Matching Elemental Debuff.

Arc = Blind
Void = Weaken
Stasis = Slow
entries.officialDescription: BOOST: While you have an 0 Arc, 1 Void, or 2 Stasis Super equipped, the blast also applies Blind, Weaken, and Slow, respectively.

entries.title: Conductive Cosmic Crystal
entries.description:
Against Stasis-Debuffed Enemies:

Arc and Void Ability Damage is increased by 5%?
entries.officialDescription: Your 0 Arc and 1 Void abilities deal bonus damage to targets that are affected by a 2 Stasis debuff.

entries.title: Power from Pain
entries.description:
Upon scoring 3 Consecutive Weakened Enemy Kills within 4 seconds of each:

Grants Devour for 5+2.5 seconds.
Spawns a Void Breach.

Hits that would've inflicted Weaken will also count even if they instantly kill an enemy.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid final blows against weakened combatants grant you Devour.

entries.title: Weakened Clear
entries.description:
Upon damaging a Boss, Champion, or breaking a Combatant's Shield with a Grenade Launcher:

Inflicts Weaken for 20 seconds.
Debuff is not refreshable by Grenade Launchers.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown between inflicting Weaken.
Weaken can be refreshed by reinflicting Weaken by any means.

 Refills stowed weapons.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown between refills.
entries.officialDescription: When using a Grenade Launcher, damaging a boss, damaging a Champion, or breaking a combatant's shield reloads your stowed weapons and weakens the combatant.

annotations.text: Incurs a 10 second cooldown between inflicting
Incurs a 10 second cooldown between refills.

entries.title: Served Cold
entries.description:
Stasis Shards additionally grant 10% Class Energy.

Void Breaches additionally grant 10?% Melee Energy.
entries.officialDescription:
Picking up a 0 Stasis Shard grants you class ability energy. 

Picking up a 1 Void Breach grants you melee energy.

entries.title: Trace Evidence
entries.description:
Upon scoring 2 Precision Hits within 1? seconds of each against Arc-Debuffed Enemies, or upon scoring 3 Arc-Debuffed Enemy Kills within ? second of each:

Spawns an Ionic Trace.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown between Ionic Trace spawns.

On Ionic Trace Pickup:
Grants a stack of Armor Charge.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing precision damage to combatants affected by Arc debuffs spawns an Ionic Trace.

entries.title: Retinal Burn
entries.description:
Upon scoring 2 Arc Weapon Precision Hits against Non-Blinded Combatants within ? seconds of each while Armor Charge is active:

Consumes x1 Armor Charge.
Triggers a blinding burst, inflicting blind to enemies within ? meter radius for ? seconds
entries.officialDescription: Rapid 0 Arc weapon precision hits consume an Armor Charge to trigger a blinding burst at the target's location.

entries.title: Kinetic Impacts
entries.description:
Upon scoring 3 non-simultaneous damage instances within 3 seconds of each with a Power Grenade Launcher OR a single non-lethal damage instance with Primary/Special Grenade Launchers:

Triggers a single Shockwave underneath the enemy.
Shockwave deals 227x2 = 454 Kinetic Damage and stagger Unstoppable Champions over 7 meters.
Shockwaves from Primary and Special GLs only deal 150x2 Damage.
Shockwave has no damage falloff.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown before additional hits count.
-------------------------------------------
Upon dealing Grenade Launcher Damage:
Grants a stack of Rapid Impacts for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.

+5 | +10 | +15? | +20? | +30 Reload Speed
0.99x | 0.99x | 0.98x | 0.96x | 0.94x Duration Multiplier
entries.officialDescription:
Sustained damage with a Grenade Launcher increases the reload speed of Grenade Launchers and triggers a damaging Kinetic shockwave.

This shockwave can stun 0 Unstoppable Champions.

annotations.text: Incurs a 1 second cooldown before additional hits count.

entries.title: The Thick of It
entries.description:
Upon scoring 3 Kills within ? seconds of each while within 15? meters of 3? enemies:

Grants a stack of Armor Charge.

While within 15? meters of 3? enemies:
Grants +? Handling and +? Charge Rate
entries.officialDescription: Rapid final blows while surrounded grant you Armor Charge. While you are surrounded, your weapons have increased handling; Swords gain increased charge rate.

entries.title: Curative Orbs
entries.description:
Upon first breaking a Combatant Shield, or a Supering Guardian's Shield:

Creates an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.
Performing a Finisher on a Combatant that didn't trigger the effect will also spawn an Orb of Power.

Upon picking up an Orb of Power, an Elemental Pickup, or destroying a Tangle:
Restores 40 HP.
entries.officialDescription:
The first time you break a target's shield or break the shield of a Guardian using their Super, you create an Orb of Power.

Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle grants you a small amount of health.

entries.title: Arc Compounding
entries.description:
15% [7.5%] increased Arc Damage against Blinded Enemies.
Stacks with everything.
entries.officialDescription: 0 Arc sources deal increased damage to Blind targets.

entries.title: Killing Breeze
entries.description:
Upon scoring 3 Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each:
+? Mobility for 7 seconds.
Buff can be refreshed by retriggering it.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid weapon final blows grant you a bonus to mobility.

entries.title: Void Renewal
entries.description:
While Devour is active:

Void Weapon Kills progress a counter that spawns a Void Breach upon reaching 100%.
RnF = 16.7% | Elite = 34% | Miniboss+ = 50% | Guardians = ?%

On Void Breach Pickup:
+? Handling and +? Reload Speed for ? seconds.
Refills Shotguns and Grenade Launchers.
entries.officialDescription:
While Devour is active, 0 Void weapon final blows have a chance to generate a Void Breach.

Picking up a Void Breach increases weapon reload and handling; Shotguns and Grenade Launchers are also reloaded from reserves.

entries.title: Old God's Rite
entries.description:
On Void Breach Pickup: 

The next Void Weapon Damage Instance within 10 seconds creates a Void Portal.

Void Portal:
Releases 8 Homing Void Orbs towards enemies within ~10 meters.
Void Orbs deal up to 334 [?] Splash Damage over ~3? meters.
Rank-and-File Combatants take 540 Damage per Orb.
Miniboss+ take 180 Damage per Orb.
entries.officialDescription: After picking up a 0 Void Breach, dealing damage with a Void weapon creates a rain of seeking projectiles.

entries.title: Elemental Siphon
entries.description:
Upon scoring 3 kills within 3 seconds of each using a Kinetic Weapon or a Super-Element Matching Weapon:

Creates an Elemental Pickup that matches the equipped Super Ability's element.

Unlike Tablet of Ruin's version, this does NOT grant Super Energy.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid final blows with a Kinetic weapon or a weapon matching your equipped Super create an Elemental pickup that matches your equipped Super. Elemental pickups grant matching Super energy when they are collected.

entries.title: Counter Energy
entries.description:
Whenever a Champion gets stunned:

25% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability.
Excludes Super Abilities, obviously.
entries.officialDescription: When you or a member of your fireteam stuns a champion, you gain energy for your least-charged ability.

entries.title: Prismatic Transfer
entries.description:
On Super Cast:

Allies within 15 meters with a Super Element different from the caster's receive 20% [10%] increased damage for 10 [5] seconds.
Damage buff is not refreshable.

Doesn't stack with Radiant or other similar empowering buffs.
entries.officialDescription: When you cast your Super, each member of your fireteam with a Super type different than yours gains a bonus to weapon damage.

entries.title: Energy Diffusion Substrate
entries.description: 5%? Damage Resist against Combatants.
entries.officialDescription: Gain a small amount of resistance to all damage dealt to you by combatants.

entries.title: Blade Stamina
entries.description:
Upon scoring 3 Combatant Kills within 5 seconds of each with a Sword:

Generates +3 Ammo.
Praxic Blade and Ergo Sum receive +2 Ammo instead.
entries.officialDescription: Rapidly defeating combatants with a Sword refunds some ammo.

entries.title: Argent Blade
entries.description:
Dealing Sword Damage consumes an Armor Charge to grant Argent Blade for 5 seconds.

Argent Blade:
15% Increased Sword Damage
+100 Charge Rate.
Stacks with other buffs.

Does not consume additional Armor Charges while Argent Blade is active
entries.officialDescription: While you have Armor Charge, dealing damage with a Sword consumes an Armor Charge and empowers your Sword for a short time, granting it bonus damage and energy charge rate.

entries.title: Creeping Chill
entries.description:
Upon scoring a Stasis Kill against a Stasis-Debuffed Enemy:
Triggers a Slowing Burst over 6 meters.

Slowing Burst
Inflicts x20 Slow for 2?+? seconds to enemies.
Grants x? Frost Armor to the user and allies.

Has no effect.
entries.officialDescription: Stasis final blows against slowed or frozen targets release a burst that slows combatants and grants Frost Armor to allies caught in the blast.

entries.title: Void Hegemony
entries.description:
While a Void or Prismatic Subclass is equipped:

Killing Weakened Enemies grants 15 Overshield HP.
entries.officialDescription: While you have a Void or Prismatic subclass equipped, defeating weakened targets provides a small Void Overshield.

entries.title: Expanding Abyss
entries.description:
User deals increased Void Damage towards Weakened Enemies.

7.5% -> 10% (2.3% increased damage)
15% -> 25% (8.7% increased damage)
30% -> 35% (3.8% increased damage)
35% -> 40% (3.7% increased damage)

Divinity's Weaken is unaffected.
entries.officialDescription: Void sources deal increased damage to weakened targets.

entries.title: Press The Advantage
entries.description:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Shield:

+20 Stability, +20? Handling, and +20 Reload Speed for 10 seconds.
Swords receive +20 Guard Resistance.
entries.officialDescription: Breaking a combatant's shield grants increased weapon stability, handling, and reload speed. Swords gain increased guard resistance.

annotations.text: +20 Stability, +20? Handling, and +20 Reload Speed for 10 seconds.

entries.title: Radiant Orbs
entries.description:
While a Solar or Prismatic Subclass is equipped:

Orbs of Power grant Radiant for 10+5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: While you have a Solar or Prismatic subclass equipped, picking up an Orb of Power makes you radiant.

entries.title: Shieldcrush
entries.description:
While Frost Armor, Void Overshield, or Woven Mail are active:
?% [?%] Additional Base Melee Recharge Rate
 50% [5%] Increased Powered Melee Damage.
Also increases Super Melee Damage and Ignition Damage.

While Amplified or Radiant are active:
?% [?%] Additional Base Grenade Recharge Rate
25% [5%] Increased Grenade Damage.

Grapple Melee instead receives 12% Increased Damage for each half of the perk.
entries.officialDescription:
While you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or a Void Overshield, your melee recharges faster and deals increased damage.

While you are amplified or radiant, your grenade recharges faster and deals increased damage.

annotations.text: instead receives 12% Increased Damage for each half of the perk.

Explosion has an additional damage instance that deals 288 [?] damage, down to 75% damage over a 17 meter radius.
Additional damage counts as Tangle Damage for all interactions.
entries.officialDescription: Destroying a Tangle with 0 Strand damage increases the radius of the explosion and its damage.

entries.title: Bad Amplitude
entries.description:
Upon dealing Arc Ability Damage to a Champion:
Inflicts Jolt to the Champion.
entries.officialDescription: Damaging a Champion with an Arc ability causes the Champion to become jolted.

entries.title: Transference
entries.description:
While Transcendent:
10% Increased Grenade and Melee Damage.

After Transcendence ends:
Each Weapon Kill scored grants 4.2% Light and Darkness Energy.
Grants up to 50% Light/Dark Energy after 12 kills.
entries.officialDescription:
Gain increased grenade and melee damage while transcendent.

Weapon final blows while transcendent refund Light and Dark energy after Transcendence ends.

entries.title: Incendiary Rifle Rounds
entries.description:
Upon scoring a Solar Sniper Rifle Precision Hit:
Inflicts x30+15 Scorch.

Unaffected by Weapon Frame or Ammo Type.
entries.officialDescription: Solar Sniper Rifle precision hits scorch targets.

entries.title: Solar Fulmination
entries.description:
Ignitions deal an additional damage instance.

Fulmination deal 171 [30] Solar Damage in a 12? meter radius. 
Fulminations count as Ignitions and don't [do?] have damage falloff.

While Ember of Char is equipped:
Fulminations inflict an additional x40+20 Scorch.
entries.officialDescription: Your ignitions do increased damage in an increased radius.

entries.title: Sniper's Meditation
entries.description:
On Sniper Rifle Direct Hit:
Grant a stack of Sniper's Meditation for 7 seconds.
Heavy Sniper Rifle hits grant 2 stacks.
Sniper's Meditation Buff persists through stow.

Sniper's Meditation 
Increased Damage, Stability, and Reload Speed.
2.8% | 5.7% | 9% | 12% | 15% Increased Damage
+? | +? | +? | +? | +? Stability
+15 | +30 | +35 | +40 | +45 Reload Speed
entries.officialDescription: Sniper Rifle hits grant stacking Sniper Rifle damage, stability, and reload bonuses for a short time. Heavy ammo Sniper Rifle hits count as more than one.

entries.title: Sustained Fire
entries.description:
Upon scoring 10 Auto Rifle Hits within 1.5 seconds of each against a single Combatant:

Resist x2 (25% DR) for 6 seconds.
 Buff is refreshable and persists through stow.
Support Autos can also trigger the buff by healing injured allies.
entries.officialDescription: Continuously damaging combatants or healing allies with an Auto Rifle grants you damage resistance.

entries.title: Targeting Autoloader
entries.description:
Auto Rifle Combatant Kills progress a Counter.
Kills grant 50% Counter Progress.
Kills while within 15 meters of 3 enemies grants 100% Progress.
Kills while at 5 stacks grant 100% Progress.
Counter Progress persists through stow.

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress:
Grants a stack of Targeting Autoloader for 15 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Buff is refreshable.

Targeting Autoloader:
Refills 20% | 20% | 30% | 40% | 40% of Magazine
10% | 13% | 16% | 18% | 20% Increased Auto Rifle Damage.
Stacks with other buffs.
Buff is removed upon readying a non-Auto Rifle Weapon.
entries.officialDescription:
While you have an Auto Rifle equipped, defeating combatants reloads your equipped weapon and temporarily increases weapon damage.

Awards bonus progress when dealing final blows while surrounded.

entries.officialDescription: When you have an Arc or Prismatic subclass equipped, Arc final blows while you are amplified summon a burst of lightning that damages and jolts targets.

entries.officialDescription: Damaging unraveled targets with a weapon occasionally spawns a threadling.

5% Increased Weapon Damage against Non-Boss Combatants that are affected by Strand or Stasis debuffs.

Strand Debuffs: Unraveled, Severed, Suspended
Stasis Debuffs: Slowed, or Frozen.
entries.officialDescription: While radiant, deal increased weapon damage to combatants affected by Strand and Stasis debuffs.

Champion triggers an ignition.

entries.title: Rays of Precision
entries.description:
While Radiant:

Solar Precision Kills on Combatants cause an Ignition.
entries.officialDescription: While radiant, Solar precision final blows cause combatants to ignite.

entries.title: Armorsmith
entries.description:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Shield or performing a Finisher:

10% [2.5%] Damage Resist (Resist x1) for 6 seconds.
100% Increased Melee Damage for 6 seconds.
Increases Super Melee Damage as well.
entries.officialDescription: Breaking a combatant's shield temporarily grants you damage resistance and increased melee damage.

entries.title: Anti-Champion Nosecone
entries.description:
For Rocket Launchers:
33% Increased Damage against Champions.
entries.officialDescription: Rocket Launchers deal increased damage to Champions.

1.2% Increased Weapon Damage against Combatants per stack.

Works with Roaming Supers as long as Super Energy is above 60%.
entries.officialDescription: While your Super is nearly fully-charged, ability final blows spawn Orbs of Power.

annotations.text: Incurs a 30 second cooldown between spawning orbs.

entries.description:
Upon scoring a Precision Kill with a Stasis Weapon while Frost Armor is active:

Triggers a Freezing Burst on Enemy Death Location.
Freezing Burst affects enemies within 7 meters.
entries.officialDescription: While Frost Armor is active, 0 Stasis precision final blows cause combatants to release a freezing burst.

entries.title: Blast Radius
entries.description:
Upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with Grenade Launchers or Rocket Launchers:

Grants a stack of Armor Charge.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid final blows with Rocket Launchers and Grenade Launchers grant Armor Charge.

entries.title: Perpetual Destruction
entries.description:
Non-Exotic Rocket Launcher Kills within 2-3? seconds of each progress a counter.
Rank-and-File = 25% | Elite = 34% | Miniboss = 100%

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress:
Rocket Launchers are granted +1 Ammo.
Precision/High-Impact Rockets (or Bipod RLs) receive +2 Ammo.
+? Reload Speed and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier for 10 seconds.
Not affected by Scavenger Mods.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid final blows with non-Exotic Rocket Launchers refund ammo and increase reload speed for a short duration.

entries.title: To Shreds
entries.description:
Upon scoring 6 weapon damage instances against Severed Enemies:
Inflicts Unravel.

On Severed Enemy Kill:
Releases 3 healing pulses on Enemy Death Location, restoring 15 HP and granting Woven Mail for 10 seconds to the user and allies within 10? metres every 2 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing sustained damage to severed targets unravels them. Defeating a severed target creates a hotspot of Strand energy, granting Woven Mail to nearby allies for a short duration.

entries.title: Improved Unraveling
entries.description: Unraveling Threads deal 15% increased damage.
entries.officialDescription: Increases the amount of damage dealt by unraveling a target.

entries.title: Strand Soldier
entries.description:
Upon receiving Woven Mail, while on a Strand or Prismatic Subclass:

 Grants Unraveling Rounds for 8 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Your Strand weapons gain Unraveling Rounds whenever you gain Woven Mail while your Strand or Prismatic subclass is equipped.

entries.title: Conductive Cosmic Needle
entries.description:
Against Strand-Debuffed Boss Combatants:

 5% Increased Arc and Void Ability Damage per Strand Debuff.

1x = 5% | 2x = 10.25% | 3x = 15.76%
entries.officialDescription: Targets affected by Strand debuffs take increased damage from Arc and Void abilities.

entries.title: Volatile Flow
entries.description:
On Orb of Power or Void Breach Pickup:
Volatile Rounds for 9 [?] seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Picking up a Void elemental well grants your Void weapons Volatile rounds.

entries.title: Suppressing Glaive
entries.description:
Upon dealing a Glaive Damage Instance against Combatants:
Inflicts Suppression for 10 seconds.

Glaive Melee inflicts Suppression at the cost of 10% Glaive Energy.
Does not drain Glaive Energy if the enemy is suppressed.
entries.officialDescription: Damaging combatants with your Glaive suppresses them, preventing them from using abilities for a short time.

entries.title: Shock and Awe
entries.description:
While an Arc or Prismatic Subclass is equipped, while Amplified: 

Arc Kills trigger a lightning burst, dealing up to 126 [?] Arc Damage and jolting in a 8 metre radius.

Incurs a 5 second cooldown between activations.
entries.officialDescription: When you have an Arc or Prismatic subclass equipped, Arc final blows while you are amplified summon a burst of lightning that damages and jolts targets.

annotations.text: Incurs a 5 second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Unto the Breach
entries.description:
On Void Debuffed Enemy Kill while on a Void or Prismatic Subclass:

 Spawns a Void Breach.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating a Void debuffed target creates a Void Breach while your Void or Prismatic subclass is equipped.

entries.title: Protective Breach
entries.description:
On Void Breach Pickup:

+45 Void Overshield for 10+5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Picking up a Void Breach gives you an overshield or refreshes your existing overshield.

entries.title: Supernova
entries.description:
On Void Breach Pickup: 

The next Void Damage Instance within 10 seconds releases a weakening burst, inflicting Weaken to enemies within 5? metres for 8 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Picking up a Void Breach causes your next source of Void damage to create a large weakening pulse.

entries.title: Amped Up
entries.description:
While on Arc or Prismatic Subclass: 

Amplified duration is increased to 20 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Stay amplified longer.

entries.title: Counter Charge
entries.description:
Upon stunning a Champion:

Grants a stack of Armor Charge.
entries.officialDescription: Gain a stack of Armor Charge when you stun a Champion.

entries.title: Squad Goals
entries.description:
On Finisher while affected by the Super-Matching Elemental Buff:

Allies within ? metres are bestowed the Subclass-Specific Buff. 

Subclass Specific Buff:
Arc: Amplified | Void: Devour | Strand: Woven Mail
entries.officialDescription:
Performing a finisher while you are amplified grants Amplified to nearby allies.

Performing a finisher while you have Woven Mail grants Woven Mail to nearby allies.

Performing a finisher while you have Devour grants Devour to nearby allies.

entries.title: Thunderous Retort
entries.description:
While at Critical Health or Amplified:

30% increased Arc Super Damage.

Only affects damage while in the Super Animation, resulting in lowered bonuses for Thundercrash and Gathering Storm.
entries.officialDescription: Grants bonus Arc Super damage if cast while critically wounded or while amplified. Lasts until the end of the Super activation.

entries.title: Bricks from Beyond
entries.description:
Every 3? Elite+ Void Weapon Kills:

50?% Heavy Ammo Progress to the user and allies within ? meters.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating a powerful combatant with a Void weapon has a chance to generate Heavy ammo progress for you and your teammates.

entries.title: Lightning Strikes Twice
entries.description:
On Arc Grenade Ability Usage:

130% Additional Grenade Base Recharge Rate for 5 seconds.

Arc Kills increase the buff duration by +3? seconds, up to 20 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: After throwing an Arc grenade, gain increased grenade recharge for a short time. Arc final blows extend the duration of this benefit.

entries.title: Sustained Fire
entries.description:
Upon scoring 10 Auto Rifle Hits within 1.5 seconds of each against a single Combatant:

Resist x2 (25% DR) for 6 seconds.
 Buff is refreshable and persists through stow.
Support Autos can also trigger the buff by healing allies.
entries.officialDescription: Continuously damaging combatants or healing allies with an Auto Rifle grants you damage resistance.

entries.title: Overload Grenades
entries.description: Void Grenade Ability Damage inflicts disruption.
entries.officialDescription: Void grenades disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against 0 Overload Champions.

entries.title: Passive Aggressive Guard
entries.description:
While a Glaive is readied:

50% Damage Resist against Combatants within ? meters.
entries.officialDescription: Receive less damage from combatants that are close to you while you are wielding a Glaive.

entries.title: Shatter Orbs
entries.description:
Upon first breaking a Combatant Shield:

Creates an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.
Performing a Finisher on a Combatant that didn't trigger the effect will also spawn an Orb of Power.

Only works once per enemy.
entries.officialDescription: The first time you break a combatant's shield, you create an Orb of Power if you break the shield with the matching damage type.

entries.title: Targeting Autoloader
entries.description:
Auto Rifle Combatant Kills progress a Counter.
Kills grant 50% Counter Progress.
Kills while within 15 meters of 3 enemies grants 100% Progress.
Kills while at 5 stacks grant 100% Progress.
Counter Progress persists through stow.

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress:
Grants a stack of Targeting Autoloader for 15 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Buff is refreshable.

Targeting Autoloader:
Refills 20% | 20% | 30% | 40% | 40% of Magazine
10% | 13% | 16% | 18% | 20% Increased Auto Rifle Damage.
Stacks with other buffs.
Buff is removed upon readying a non-Auto Rifle Weapon.
entries.officialDescription:
While you have an Auto Rifle equipped, defeating combatants reloads your equipped weapon and temporarily increases weapon damage.

Awards bonus progress when dealing final blows while surrounded.

entries.title: Void Weapon Channeling
entries.description:
Upon scoring a Void Weapon Kill while having at least 1 charged Void Ability:

Grants Weapon Surge stacks equal to the amount of Void Grenade, Melee, Class, and Super Ability Charges for 11 seconds.

Up to x4 Weapon Surge by having 4 Void Ability Charges.
2 Grenade + 2 Melee = x4 | Grenade + Melee + Class + Super = x4

Buff can only be refreshed if the stack amount is less or equal (≤) to the amount of Void Ability Charges.

Works as expected on Prismatic!
entries.officialDescription: You gain a temporary bonus to Void weapon damage after you defeat a target with a Void weapon while at least one of your Void abilities is fully charged. This damage bonus increases based on the number of fully charged Void abilities you have.

entries.title: Amplified
entries.description:
Intrinsic Arc Subclass Buff
Obtained by reaching 100% Counter Progress through Arc Kills within 6 seconds of each, or through Aspects.
Rank-And-File = 25% | Elite = 50% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 50%

Amplified:
+50 Mobility, increases Slide Distance to 8.5 meters, +40 Handling, and 0.95x Handling Duration Multiplier for 15 seconds. 
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer and grants 15% Damage Resist against Combatants while active.
While Amplified, sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.

Speed Booster:
Maximizes Movement Speed, increased Slide Distance to 11 meters, 25% Increased Jump Height, and 15% Damage Resist against Combatants.
Speed Booster lingers for 2 seconds until no longer sprinting, even after Amplified runs out.
Performing a Speed Booster Slide permanently increases base Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters until death.
entries.officialDescription:
Your movement speed and weapon handling are greatly increased. After sprinting for a short time, your movement speed is further increased.

Rapidly defeating targets with 0 Arc damage makes you amplified.

annotations.text: Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer and grants 15% Damage Resist against Combatants while active.
Performing a Speed Booster Slide permanently increases base Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters until death.

entries.title: Bolt Charge
entries.description:
Upon scoring a Magazine-Based amount of Weapon Damage Instances within 5 seconds of each while Bolt Charge is active:
The next damage instance from any source will grant a stack of Bolt Charge.
Swapping weapons resets the counter. Can only gain up to 1 stack per simultaneous damage instance.

Damage instances needed to gain a stack:
(15% of Magazine, rounded down) + 1
Swords and GLs: 2
3-Ammo Snipers: 1

Gaining a Bolt Charge stack grants 2.5% Melee Ability Energy per Bolt Charge stack obtained, generally granting 25% Melee Ability Energy over the 10 stacks needed to discharge.
Acquiring over x10 stacks through abilities will still grant the corresponding Ability Gains (For example, being at x9 and acquiring x4 will still grant 10% Melee Energy)

After 0.5 seconds of scoring an Ability Hit or dealing Unpowered Melee Damage while at x10 Bolt Charge stacks:
Discharges an Arc Bolt over the damaged enemy, dealing up to 405 Bolt Splash + 270 Ground Splash = 675 Total [36 Bolt Splash + 30 Ground Splash] Arc Damage over ? meters.
Does not count as Ability Damage, only as Generic Arc Damage.

Triggers Discharge:
Volatile Explosions | Freeze Shatter (Not auto-shatter on Bosses) | Tangle Explosions | Threadlings | Unraveling Threads | Suspend Snap on Bosses | Forerunner's The Rock

Do NOT trigger Discharge:
 Jolt's Chain Lightning | Scorch and Ignitions (from Non-Abilities) | Crystal Shatter (from Non-Abilities) | Gifted Conviction's Explosives
entries.officialDescription:
Accumulate stacks of Arc Bolt Charge. While you have Bolt Charge, sustained weapon damage generates stacks of Bolt Charge. At maximum stacks, any ability damage generates a powerful bolt of Arc lightning at the target's location.

Receiving a stack of Bolt Charge grants you melee energy.

annotations.text: Can only gain up to 1 stack per simultaneous damage instance

entries.title: Ionic Trace
entries.description:
Arc Elemental Pickup.

Energizing Seekers that home in towards the user at a speed of 6m/s.
Grants 11.25% Grenade, and Melee Ability Energy, and 13.5% Class Ability Energy on pickup. Allies do not receive Ionic Traces created by the user.
entries.officialDescription: A bolt of pure 0 Arc energy that travels along the ground, seeking toward its creator. When picked up, Ionic Traces grant ability energy.

entries.title: Blind
entries.description:
Blinded Combatants are disoriented, rendering them unable to attack or use abilities for 10 seconds.

Blinded Guardians have their HUD removed, screen whitened, and audio distorted for 3 seconds.

Unstoppable Champions become Stunned upon being Blinded.
entries.officialDescription:
Combatants are disoriented and cannot fire their weapons. Opposing Guardians' HUD is removed and their vision is obscured.

When blinded, 0 Unstoppable Champions are stunned.

entries.title: Jolted
entries.description:
Jolted Enemies will release chain lightning for 10 [5] seconds, dealing 119 [51] Arc Damage to all enemies within 12 meters upon taking 115 [45] damage. 
Duration can be refreshed by reinflicting Jolt.
 The damage from the hit that applies Jolt counts towards the damage threshold. Jolt has a 0.8 second cooldown between chain lightning activations.

Guardians that release Chain Lightning do not receive chain damage unless it deals damage to other Guardians.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon receiving Jolt damage.
entries.officialDescription:
The target is energized with destructive 0 Arc Light. They take additional damage while jolted and chain lightning to nearby targets.

Jolt damage causes 1 Overload Champions to be stunned.

annotations.text: do not receive chain damage unless it deals damage to other

entries.title: Spark of Amplitude
entries.description:
Scoring 2 kills within 4 seconds of each while 0 Amplified creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.

The kill that makes you amplified counts towards this requirement.

Kills within 10 seconds of an activation do not count.
entries.officialDescription: Rapidly defeating targets while you are amplified creates an Orb of Power.

alternateDescriptions.text:
While Amplified:
Scoring 2 kills within 4 seconds of each creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
Triggering Amplified through an Arc Kill will count the kill towards the 2-kill counter.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon creating an Orb of Power. Kills during the cooldown do not count.

entries.title: Spark of Beacons
entries.description: 0 Arc 1 Special or 2 Power Weapon Kills while 3 Amplified create an explosion, 4 Blinding enemies within 7.5 meters of the target.
entries.officialDescription: While you are amplified, your Arc Special or Heavy ammo weapon final blows create a blinding explosion.

alternateDescriptions.text: Special and Heavy Ammo Arc Weapon Kills while Amplified create a blinding blast, inflicting Blind to enemies within 7.5 metres.

entries.title: Spark of Brilliance
entries.description: Precision Kills against 0 Blinded enemies release a 1 Blinding explosion, 2 Blinding enemies within 7.5 meters.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating a blinded target with precision damage creates a blinding explosion.

alternateDescriptions.text: Precision Kills against Blinded Enemies trigger a Blinding blast, inflicting Blind to enemies within 7.5 metres.

entries.title: Spark of Discharge
entries.description:
Collecting 0 Ionic Traces grants a Stack of 1 Bolt Charge.

Scoring multiple 2 Arc Weapon Kills spawns an 3 Ionic Trace at the killed target's location.

Activation progress granted by Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 34%
• Elites, Players: 67%
• Minibosses and Bosses: 100%
entries.officialDescription:
Arc weapon final blows have a chance to create an Ionic Trace.

Collecting an Ionic Trace grants you a stack of Bolt Charge.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Arc Weapon Kills progress a counter that spawns an Ionic Trace upon reaching 100%.
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite = 67% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 67%

Picking up Ionic Traces grants x1 Bolt Charge.

entries.title: Spark of Feedback
entries.description:
Being struck by a Melee Attack grants an additional 100% [PVP: 50%] of your base Melee damage for your next Melee Attack within 5 seconds.

Buff duration is not refreshable.
entries.officialDescription: Taking melee damage briefly increases your outgoing melee damage.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Upon being physically struck by a Melee Attack:
100% [50% | 15% while Knockout is active] Increased Melee Damage for the next Melee Hit within 5 seconds.
Buff is not refreshable.

entries.title: Spark of Focus
entries.description:
After 1.25 seconds of sprinting and while maintaining both sprint and a movement speed of at least 5 meters per second:
Grants 150% [PVP: 75%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.

Deactivates once you have at least one Class Ability charge.
entries.officialDescription: After sprinting for a short time, your class ability regeneration is increased.

alternateDescriptions.text:
After 1.25 seconds of sprinting, while maintaining both sprint and a movement speed of at least 5m/s:
150% [75%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
Deactivates once Class Ability has at least 1 charge readied.

entries.title: Spark of Frequency
entries.description:
Scoring a Melee Hit grants 15 Stability, 50 Reload Speed, and a 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier for 5.25 seconds.

While 0 Amplified:
• (Almost) all sources of 1 Bolt Charge now grant an additional stack
• Grants no additional benefit to reload speed (bug?)
entries.officialDescription:
Melee hits increase your equipped weapon's reload speed and stability for a short duration.

While amplified, the effects are increased and you gain increased stacks of Bolt Charge from all sources.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Upon scoring a Melee Hit:
+15 Stability, +50 Reload Speed, and 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier for 5.25 seconds.

While Amplified:
(almost) All sources of Bolt Charge now grant an additional stack.
In-game tooltip mentions increasing the fragment's effects, which is not true, at least for the Reload Speed bonuses.
