entries.title: Spark of Haste
entries.description: Grants 50 Health stat after 1.25 seconds of sprinting and while maintaining both sprint and a movement speed of at least 5 meters per second.
entries.officialDescription: While sprinting, you have greatly increased health stat.

alternateDescriptions.text:
After 1.25 seconds of sprinting, while maintaining both sprint and a movement speed of at least 5m/s:
 Grants +50 Health Stat.

entries.title: Spark of Instinct
entries.description:
While at Critical Health:
Being damaged releases a burst of 0 Arc Energy, dealing 46 [PVP: 20] damage and applying 1 Jolt to enemies within ? meters.

15? second cooldown between activations.
entries.officialDescription: While critically wounded, taking damage emits a burst of damaging Arc energy that jolts targets.

alternateDescriptions.text:
While at Critical Health:
Being damaged releases a burst of Arc Energy, dealing up to 46 [20] damage and inflicting Jolt to enemies within ? metres.
Incurs a 15? second cooldown between activations.

annotations.text: Incurs a 15? second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Spark of Ions
entries.description:
Killing a 0 Jolted enemy or scoring a kill with a 1 Bolt Charge lightning bolt creates an 2 Ionic Trace.

10 second cooldown between activations.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating a jolted target or defeating a target with Bolt Charge creates an Ionic Trace.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Killing Jolted Enemies, or scoring a Bolt Charge Kill creates an Ionic Trace.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown between Ionic Traces spawns.

entries.title: Spark of Magnitude
entries.description:
0 Lightning Grenades release an additional lightning bolt. (4🠚5)

1 Pulse Grenades release an additional 2 pulses. (6🠚8)

2 Storm Grenades release a third volley, dealing the same damage as the second volley.

When combined with the 3 Touch of Thunder titan aspect, Storm Grenade's Roaming Storm lasts 1.5 seconds longer. (4🠚5.5s)
entries.officialDescription: Your lingering Arc grenades (Lightning Grenade, Pulse Grenade, and Storm Grenade) have extended duration.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Lightning Grenade fire an additional lightning bolt, increasing to a maximum of 5 bolts.
 Pulse Grenade release an additional 2 pulses, increasing to a maximum of 8 pulses.
 Storm Grenade release an additional barrage. Enhanced Storm's Roaming Storm lasts 1.5 seconds longer.

entries.title: Spark of Momentum
entries.description: Collecting Ammo Bricks by sliding over them refills your held weapon's magazine from reserves and grants 3 stacks of 0 Bolt Charge.
entries.officialDescription: Sliding over ammo bricks reloads your equipped weapon and grants you a small amount of Bolt Charge.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Upon sliding over Ammo Bricks while not on Full Ammo of the respective type:
Refills the equipped weapon and grants x3 Bolt Charge.

entries.title: Spark of Recharge
entries.description: Dropping to Critical Health grants 400% [PVP: 200%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Ability Regeneration Rate until your Shields are fully recharged.
entries.officialDescription: While critically wounded, your melee and grenade energy regenerates more quickly.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Upon reaching Critical Health:
400% [200%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Ability Regeneration Rate.
Buff lasts until Shields are fully restored.

entries.title: Spark of Resistance
entries.description:
Grants 25% [PVP: 10%] Damage Resistance while within 15 meters of 3+ enemies.

Remains active for 2 seconds once the activation condition is no longer met.
entries.officialDescription: While surrounded by combatants, you are more resistant to incoming damage.

alternateDescriptions.text:
While within 15 metres of at least 3 enemies:
25% [10%] Damage Resist.
Lingers for 2 seconds.

entries.title: Spark of Shock
entries.description: 0 Arc Grenades apply 1 Jolt on Hit.
entries.officialDescription: Your Arc grenades jolt targets.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Arc Grenades inflict Jolt on hit.

Arc Soul and Ionic Sentries have a 4 second cooldown before being able to inflict Jolt again.

entries.title: Spark of Volts
entries.description: Finishers make you 0 Amplified and grant 1 Stack of 1 Bolt Charge.
entries.officialDescription: Finishers make you amplified and grant you a stack of Bolt Charge.

alternateDescriptions.text: Finishers grant Amplified and x1 Bolt Charge.

entries.title: Arcbolt Grenade
entries.description:
Heavy Trajectory | Scan

Scans and targets the closest enemy in Line of Sight within 12 meters upon impact, releasing Arc Lightning towards them after 1 second.
After dealing damage, it chains to the closest enemy within 10 meters that hasn't been hit by Arc Lightning, repeating until it has damaged a maximum of 4 enemies.

Arc Lightning deals 521 [85] damage.
entries.officialDescription: A grenade that chains bolts of lightning to nearby targets.

entries.title: Flashbang Grenade
entries.description:
Medium Trajectory

Explodes after its speed is sufficiently reduced. Has a brief delay before it can explode.

Explosion deals up to 684 [120] damage, down to 0% damage over a 7.5 meter radius, and inflicts blind to enemies within 10 meters for up to 5 [3] seconds.
The user is immune to self-blind.

Aspect - Touch of Thunder: Explodes an additional time on impact, dealing up to 684 [?] damage over 7.5 meters and inflicting blind to enemies within 5 meters.
entries.officialDescription: An explosive grenade that damages and blinds nearby targets.

entries.title: Flux Grenade
entries.description:
Almost Straight Trajectory | Slight Projectile Tracking | Sticky

Attaches to enemies or surfaces, exploding after 1.7 seconds.

Explosion deals up to 901 [150] damage, down to 0% damage over a 6 meter radius on detonation.
Sticking an enemy increases explosion damage by 66.7% to 1,500 [250] damage.
entries.officialDescription: An explosive grenade that attaches to targets.

entries.title: Lightning Grenade
entries.description:
Medium Trajectory | Wall-Mounted

Attaches to surfaces and enemies, projecting a laser for 1 second before triggering.

Emits a Lightning Bolt every 1.67 seconds, up to a maximum of 4+1 times.
Lightning Bolts deal 373 [120] damage, up to a total of 1492 [1865] [480 [600]] damage.

Aspect - Touch of Thunder: Grants an additional Grenade Ability Charge.
Lightning Bolts after the first inflict Jolt on hit.
Grants x5 Bolt Charge upon dealing damage, up to once per lightning bolt.
entries.officialDescription: A grenade that sticks to any surface and emits bolts of lightning.

entries.title: Pulse Grenade
entries.description:
Medium Trajectory

Detonates on impact, dealing up to 156 [50] damage in a 6 meter radius.

Periodically pulses every 0.7 seconds, dealing up to 249 [80] damage in a 6 meter radius an additional 5+2 times.
Can deal up to a total of 1,245 [1,743] [530 [690]] damage.

Aspect - Touch of Thunder: Pulse Grenade hits spawn an Ionic Trace and deal increased damage. Incurs a 1 second cooldown between Ionic Trace spawns.

Pulse Damage Increases: 1st = 2% | 2nd = 9% | 3rd = 18.5% | 4th = 24% | 5th onwards = 25%
entries.officialDescription: A grenade that periodically damages targets within its explosion radius.

entries.title: Skip Grenade
entries.description:
Medium Trajectory | Seekers

Splits on impact, releasing 4 seekers that chase after enemies.

Seekers begin chasing enemies that come within 6 metres of them, exploding after dealing damage, or self-destructing after ~2 seconds if their velocity is low.

Each projectile deals 24 [4] impact damage twice, then explodes for up to 90 [15] damage.
Deals up to 552 [92] damage with all 4 seekers.
entries.officialDescription: A grenade that splits upon impact, creating multiple projectiles that seek targets.

entries.title: Storm Grenade
entries.description:
Medium Trajectory

Calls down a focused strike on impact which hits after 0.85 seconds, dealing up to 440 [70] damage in a 7 meter radius.

After 0.6 seconds of the initial strike:
Calls down a barrage of bolts in a X pattern over 7 meters, dealing up to 311 [50] damage.
Spark of Magnitude: Calls down a second barrage of bolts in an + pattern over 7 meters, dealing up to 311 [50] damage.
Combatants can only be damaged once per barrage, up to a maximum of 751 [1062] damage.
Guardians can only be hurt once by the barrage of bolts, regardless of pattern, for a maximum of 120 damage.

Aspect - Touch of Thunder: Creates a roaming storm for 4+1.5 seconds after detonating, chasing after enemies at an initial speed of 2 [1.5] m/s, increasing to 4 [3] m/s after 1.3 seconds.
 Roaming Storm fires lightning bolts underneath it that deal 158 [30] damage up to 11+4 times.
entries.officialDescription: A grenade that calls down a focused lightning storm.

annotations.text: can only be hurt once by the barrage of bolts, regardless of pattern, for a maximum of 120 damage.

entries.title: Combination Blow
entries.description:
Upon scoring a Melee Kill:
Grants 100% Class Ability, restores 100 Health, and grants a stack of Combination Blow for 20 seconds, up to 3 stacks.
Basic Melee Attacks count as Arc-Infused Melee Damage while Combination Blow is active.
70 Class Stat is required for a full Gambler's Dodge refund.

Combination Blow x1 | 133% [23%] Increased Melee Damage. Melee Kills restore 80 HP.
Combination Blow x2 | 266% [51.3%] Increased Melee Damage. Melee Kills restore 60 HP.
Combination Blow x3 | 400% [86%] Increased Melee Damage. Melee Kills restore 40 HP.
entries.officialDescription:
A quick strike that temporarily increases your melee damage when defeating a target, stacking three times.

Defeating targets with this, grants class ability energy and restores a small amount of health. Energy gain is scaled by your Class stat.

entries.description:
Deals 162 [?] Impact Damage and up to 976 [?] Splash Damage, down to ?% damage over 7 meters.
Inflicts Blind for 8.5 seconds to enemies within 9.6 meters on hit.

Grants Amplified and x2 Bolt Charge on hit.
entries.officialDescription: Striking a target with this melee ability blinds them, amplifies you, and grants you a moderate amount of Bolt Charge.

entries.title: Arc Staff
entries.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [53%]
Base Duration: 20 seconds, or 5% Super Drain per Second

entries.title:
Solar Effect
Damage Scaling
entries.description:
Solar Effect (Scorch | Ignition) damage can be increased through Perks and Exotics, but the source used for initially scorching will determine what it will be counted as.
 
Inflicting a Solar Effect with a Weapon, such as with Incandescent/Burning Ambition or through Exotic Weapons such as Tommy's Matchbook or Conditional Finality, will result in Solar Effects counting as Weapon Damage, benefitting from Weapon Buffs and Activity Modifiers that exclusively benefit Weapons, such as other Damage Perks, Weapon Stat, Radiant, and Solar Weapon Surges.
New Gear Bonus is applied permanently to all Weapons, so all Solar Effect Damage against Combatants will always be 5% higher than expected, on top of Combatant Rank Scalars.

Inflicting Solar Effects through abilities such as Fusion Grenades and Well of Radiance will result in the Solar Effects counting as Solar Ability Damage, with their damage only being increased by Grenade (Verity's Brow), and Super (Heart of the Flame) Damage Increases respectively. Melee Damage Buffs and 100+ Melee Stat do not increase Solar Effect Damage.
Effects that increase all Ability Damage will benefit all Solar Effects that are initially applied through Solar Abilities.

Activity Modifiers that increase all Solar Damage, such as Solar Surge, will also apply to Solar Effects, regardless of source.

entries.title: Heat Rises
entries.description:

Consuming a 1 Healing Grenade grants 2 Cure x3. If 3 Touch of Flame is equipped, this also grants 4 Restoration x1 for 4 seconds.

Consuming a 5 Song of Flame Wisp grants 6 Cure x3 and 7 Restoration x2 for 4 seconds.

Restoration effects are extended to 6 seconds with 8 Ember of Solace. All other grenades grant 9 Cure x2.

Heat Rises grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness and effectively infinite Glide flight time, along with improved base movement capabilities of your equipped Glide. Enemy combatants are less accurate while Heat Rises is active.

Scoring kills while Airborne extends Heat Rises, up to a maximum of 30 seconds based off Combatant Rank:

• Elites and Minibosses: 10 seconds
• Bosses: 15 Seconds

entries.title: Invisibility
entries.description:
Cloaks the user, granting various benefits, while lowering Maximum Radar Range to 24 meters for 5+2 seconds. Immediately ends upon performing an Offensive Action.
 Radar Booster Weapon Mod removes the Radar Reduction. Reapplying Invisibility without it breaking refreshes the duration of the longest lasting invisibility.

Combatants are unable to directly target the user, preferring to either shoot at the user's last visible location, or not firing. Combatants will track through Loud Actions, but not fire.

Guardians are unable to see the user's health bar, and the user's radar will only ping every 5 seconds for 0.6 seconds, or upon performing Loud Actions.

Weapons and Abilities that are able to home in (Tracking Projectiles) or scan (Firebolt Grenades) for enemies will not target the user, and will stop tracking if they already were. 

Offensive Actions: Instantly ends Invisibility
Shooting | Grenade, Melee, Super, or Blink Ability Usage | Barricade or Rift Placement | Vehicle Summon

Loud Actions: Pings Radar | Combatants Track
Beginning Sprint | Non-Blink Movement Ability Usage | Hunter Class Ability Usage

• Tier 3: 20%

When a target is being drained, you are granted grenade and melee energy (if running Healing Rift) or health (if running Empowering Rift).

Grounded Guardians can cast their Super Ability to instantly break out.

Stasis = x? Slow for ? seconds | Strand = Sever

entries.title: Facet of Devotion
entries.description:
Killing enemies affected by 0 Stasis or 1 Strand Elemental debuffs grants additional Light Transcendence Energy:
• Minors: 1%
• Elites: 3%
• Minibosses and higher: 5%
• Players: ?%
entries.officialDescription: Defeating targets afflicted with 2 Stasis or 3 Strand debuffs grants bonus Light Transcendence energy.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Killing enemies affected by Stasis or Strand Elemental Debuffs grants additional Light Transcendence Energy.
Rank-and-File = 1% | Elites = 3% | Minibosses+ = 5% | Guardians = ?%

entries.title: Facet of Dominance
entries.description:
0 Void Grenade Ability damage applies 1 Weaken for 6 [PVP: ?] seconds.

2 Arc Grenade Ability damage applies 3 Jolt.
entries.officialDescription: Your Void grenades weaken targets, and your Arc grenades jolt targets.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Void Grenade Ability Damage inflicts Weaken for 6 [?] seconds.

Arc Grenade Ability Damage inflicts Jolt.
Arc Soul has a 4 second cooldown before being able to inflict Jolt again.

annotations.text: has a 4 second cooldown before being able to inflict

entries.title: Facet of Generosity
entries.description:
Kills while Transcendent spawn up to 4 Orbs of Power for allies that grant 7.15?% Super Energy.

Orbs spawn upon passing specific point thresholds: 30, 50, 70, and 100 points for each orb.

Points gained per Kill by Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10 points
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 15 points
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 20 points
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites: 34 points
• T4 Elites, Minibosses: 40 points
• Bosses: 50 points
• Players: ? points
entries.officialDescription: Defeating targets while transcendent creates Orbs of Power for your allies.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Kills while Transcendent progress a counter that spawns Orbs of Power that grant 7.15% Super Energy for allies at specific thresholds.
Up to a maximum of 4 Orbs of Power can be spawned per Transcendence activation.

Tier 1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 15% | T3 = 20% | T4 = 34% | Minibosses = 40% | Bosses = 50% | Guardians = ?%
Orbs of Power are spawned at the 30% (1st) | 50% (2nd) | 70% (3rd) | 100% (4th) thresholds.

entries.title: Facet of Grace
entries.description:
Kinetic Weapon Kills grant an additional 2% [PVP: ?%] Light and Darkness Transcendence energy.

Super Kills grant an additional 2% [PVP: ?%] Light and Darkness Transcendence Energy to you and allies within ? metres.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating targets with Kinetic weapons grants you bonus Transcendence energy. Defeating targets with your Super grants you and nearby allies bonus Transcendence energy.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Kinetic Weapon Kills grant an additional 2% [?%] Transcendence energy.

Super Kills grant an additional 2% [?%] Transcendence Energy to the user and allies within ? metres.

entries.title: Facet of Honor
entries.description:
Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying a 0 Tangle grants additional Transcendence Energy of the matching alignment:
• 1 Ionic Traces, 2 Firesprites, 3 Void Breaches: 7.5% Light Transcendence Energy
• 4 Stasis Shards: 5% Darkness Transcendence Energy
• 5 Tangles: 10% Darkness Transcendence Energy
entries.officialDescription: Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants Transcendence energy of the same type.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Picking up Elemental Pickups or destroying a Tangle grants additional Transcendence Energy of the matching alignment.

Ionic Traces, Firesprites, Void Breaches = 7.5% Light Energy 
Stasis Shards = 5% Darkness Energy | Tangles = 10% Darkness Energy

entries.title: Facet of Hope
entries.description:
Having an active elemental buff grants an additional 40% Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.

Having 2+ active elemental buffs grants an additional 60% instead.
entries.officialDescription: While you have an elemental buff, your class ability regenerates more quickly.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Grants Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate based on the amount of active Elemental Buffs.
x1 = 40% | x2 = 60%

entries.title: Facet of Justice
entries.description: Ability Kills while Transcendent trigger an explosion that deals up to 130 [PVP: ?] Ability-Matching Elemental damage in a ? meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: While transcendent, your ability final blows explode.

alternateDescriptions.text: Ability Kills while Transcendent trigger an explosion that deals up to 130 [?] Ability-Matching damage over ? meters

entries.title: Facet of Mending
entries.description:
Grenade Ability Kills grant you 0 Cure x1.

Prismatic Grenade Kills grant you 1 Cure x2.
entries.officialDescription: Grenade final blows cure you. Transcendence grenade final blows increase the strength of the effect.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Grenade Ability Kills grant Cure x1.
Prismatic Grenade Kills grant Cure x2.

entries.title: Facet of Protection
entries.description:
Grants 15% [PVP: ?%] Damage Resistance while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.

The Damage Resistance is NOT increased while Transcendent, it simply stacks with Transcendence's 20% Damage Resistance for a total of 32%.
entries.officialDescription: While surrounded by combatants, you are more resistant to incoming damage. While transcendent, the effect is increased.

alternateDescriptions.text:
While within 15 metres of 3 enemies:
15% [?%] Damage Resist.
In-Game Description is erroneous, the effect does NOT become increased while Transcendent. 
Instead, the 15% DR from Protection stacks with Transcendence's 20%, totalling 32% DR.

.

entries.title: Facet of Purpose
entries.description:
Collecting Orbs of Power grants Elemental buffs based on your equipped Super's element:
• 0 Arc: 1 1 Bolt Charge Stack
• 2 Solar: 3 Restoration x1 for 5 seconds
• 4 Void: 22.5 HP 5 Overshield for 5 seconds
• 6 Stasis: 2 7 Frost Armor Stacks for 9 seconds
• 8 Strand: 9 Woven Mail for 5 seconds
entries.officialDescription: Picking up an Orb of Power grants either Bolt Charge, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail, or Overshield based on the damage type of your equipped Super.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Orbs of Power grant Elemental Buffs on pickup, based on the equipped Super.

Arc: x1 Bolt Charge.
Solar: Restoration x1 for 5 seconds.
Void: 22.5 HP Overshield for 5 seconds.
Stasis: x2 Frost Armor for 5 seconds.
Strand: Woven Mail for 5 seconds.

entries.title: Facet of Ruin
entries.description:
0 Ignitions have a 25% increased blast radius.

1 Shattering enemies or destroying 2 Crystals creates an additional damage instance, dealing up to 25 [PVP: 9] damage in a 10 [PVP: 8] meter radius.

Damage falls off to 17 [PVP: 4] damage at the edge of the radius.
entries.officialDescription: Increases the size and damage of the burst when you shatter a Stasis crystal or frozen target, and increases the area of effect of Solar ignitions.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Shattering enemies or destroying Crystals deals an additional damage instance, dealing up to 25 [9] damage in a 10 [8] metre radius. 
Falloff decreases damage dealt down to a minimum of 17 [4] damage at the maximum falloff distance.

Ignitions have 25% increased radius.

entries.title: Facet of Sacrifice
entries.description: Ability Kills with an active 0 Arc, 1 Solar, or 2 Void Elemental buff grant an additional 1% [PVP: ?%] Darkness Transcendence Energy.
entries.officialDescription: While you have an Arc, Solar, or Void buff, ability final blows grant bonus Darkness Transcendence energy.

alternateDescriptions.text: Ability Kills while affected by an Arc, Solar, or Void Elemental Buff grant an additional 1% [?%] Darkness Transcendence Energy.

entries.title: Facet of Solitude
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each causes your next damage instance within 3 seconds (from any source) to trigger a 0 Severing Burst.

1 Severing Burst applies 2 Sever to enemies in a 3 meter radius. Radius is increased to 6 meters while Transcendent.

Further Precision Hits within 4 seconds of an activation provide no activation progress.

Precision Hits required to prepare the Severing Burst:
• 20% of magazine size rounded down + 1
• Bows require 2 hits
entries.officialDescription: Landing rapid precision hits emits a severing blast from the target. While transcendent, the severing blast is bigger.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Upon scoring a Magazine-Based amount of Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each:
The next damage instance from any source within 3 seconds will emit a Severing Burst.
Sever Burst inflicts Sever to enemies within 3 metres. Radius is increased to 6 meters while Transcendent.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown upon Severing. Precision Hits during the cooldown will not be counted.

Precision hits required to prepare the Severing Burst:
20% of Magazine + 1, rounded down.
Bows: 2 hits
The Precision Hit that prepares the Severing Burst can't trigger the effect. Trinity Ghoul and the Explosive Payload perk, for example.

annotations.text: during the cooldown will not be counted.

entries.title: Hailfire Spike
entries.description:
Prismatic Grenade

Attaches to surfaces or enemies, releasing a torrent of Stasis and Solar energy in a cone up to ? meters away.

Erupts into a slowing storm, dealing up to 78 [?] damage upon erupting.
Slowing storm deals 15.6 [?] Stasis Damage and inflicts x13? Slow every 0.25 seconds for 3.45 seconds.

After 3.45 seconds of attaching, it releases a scorching cyclone that deals 39 [?] Solar Damage and inflicts x10 Scorch every 0.25 seconds for 4 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Grenade : Throw a device charged with 0 Stasis matter and 1 Solar energy that attaches to surfaces or targets, then erupts into a slowing storm. After a short duration, the device ignites, creating a deadly scorching cyclone.

entries.title: Electrified Snare
entries.description:
Prismatic Grenade

Explosive charged with Arc and Strand energy.
Explodes in a supercharged suspending burst, dealing up to 105 [?] damage, and inflicting Suspension to enemies within ? meters.
Suspended Enemies are dealt ? damage every ? seconds for ? seconds, and are inflicted Jolt.
entries.officialDescription: Grenade : Throw an explosive device energized with 0 Strand matter and 1 Arc energy that detonates in a supercharged suspending burst. The suspended target takes heavy damage over time and chains jolting lightning to any nearby targets.

entries.title: Freezing Singularity
entries.description:
Prismatic Grenade

Deals up to 70 [26] Void Damage on impact, pulling enemies within 12 meters towards it, and creating a miniature black hole orbited by a halo of slowing ice.

The slowing field deals 18 [4] Stasis Damage and inflicts x13? Slow every 0.25 seconds for 3.65 seconds to enemies within 6 meters.

After 5 seconds of impacting, the black hole implodes, infliction suppression and dealing up to 570 [150] Void Damage to enemies within 7 meters.
entries.officialDescription: Grenade : Throw a mass of 0 Void energy and 1 Stasis matter. On impact, deploys a miniature black hole orbited by a slowing field. After a short duration, the black hole implodes, suppressing and dealing heavy damage to all nearby targets.

entries.title: Heavy Ammo Finder
entries.description: Grants a 1.33x|1.66x|2x multiplier to all Heavy Ammo Meter progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
entries.officialDescription: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Heavy ammo meter.

entries.title: Weft Cutter
entries.description: 20 Direct Hits on a target within 1 second of each other applies 0 Sever for 10 seconds (15 seconds with 1 Thread of Continuity) and grants you 2 Woven Mail for 10 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing sustained damage severs the target.

entries.title: Chaotic Exchanger
entries.description:
Grants 20% Damage Resistance while overcharging a 0 Void Grenade with 1 Chaos Accelerant.

Overcharged Grenade Hits apply 2 Weaken for 6 seconds and grant additional base grenade Regeneration Rate depending on the equipped grenade for 1.75 seconds.

• Axion: 5000% [PVP: 4000%]
• Scatter: 3700% [PVP: 2700%]
• Vortex: 3400% [PVP: 2400%]
• Handheld Supernova: 2500% [PVP: 2000%]

4 second cooldown between activations, which is removed on grenade usage. Grants between 50-60% Grenade energy per activation.

3 Vortex Grenades can proc twice if enemies get hit by the initial explosion and the last few ticks.
entries.officialDescription: Resist incoming damage while charging your Void grenade with Chaos Accelerant. Charged Void grenades return grenade energy on a hit and apply Weaken.

entries.title: Powerful Attraction
entries.description:
Class Ability usage collects certain pickups within 12.5|18.5 meters with 1|2+ Mods equipped.

Applicable pickups:
• Orbs of Power
• Motes of Light in Gambit
• Crests in Supremacy
• Data Motes in Episode: Echoes activities
entries.officialDescription: Automatically collects nearby Orbs of Power when you activate your class ability.

entries.title: Iron Grip
entries.description:
Passively increases Stability by 20 but decreases Reload Speed by 🡅15.

🡅 Reload Speed penalty is decreased by 5.
entries.officialDescription: Massively improves weapon stability at the cost of a reduced amount of reload speed.

entries.title: Adrenaline Junkie
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Adrenaline Junkie for 🡅5 seconds. Grenade Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly even if the weapon is stowed.

Adrenaline Junkie benefits:
• 20 Handling
• 6.7%|13.3%|20%|26.6%|33.3% increased damage at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.

entries.title: Kinetic Weapon Surge
entries.description:
Increases Kinetic Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage

The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.
entries.officialDescription: Your Kinetic weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.

entries.title: Nano-Munitions
entries.description:
While within 15 meters of an ally:
Grants a stack of Nano-Munitions every 3 seconds. Maximum of 7 stacks.

Emptying this weapon's magazine consumes a stack to refill 25% of your magazine (rounded up). Consuming a stack restarts the timer for gaining new stacks.

Emptying the magazine of any other weapon consumes all stacks, with each stack refilling 25% of your Magazine (rounded up). Holding a weapon with an empty magazine also consumes these stacks.

Heat weapons confuse the perk in unexpected and inconsistent ways, and all stacks may be consumed at random while using one.
entries.officialDescription: Being near allies slowly builds up a partial emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Emergency ammo amount increases with time spent near allies.

entries.title: Box Breathing
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights for 🡅1.4 seconds without firing grants the following for a single shot:
• 10% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 40% increased precision damage (35% for 0 Scout Rifles, 30% for 1 Heavy Ammo Sniper Rifles)

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.

For glaives (Greasy Luck), the projectile must strike the target's critical hitbox in order to recieve the 40% [PVP: 35%] damage bonus.

🡅 Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Aiming this weapon for an improved short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

entries.title: Gift of the Traveler
entries.description: Gain 15 Handling, 15 Reload Speed, and 2 Aim Assist for each stack of Gathering Light.
entries.officialDescription: Each stack of Gathering Light improves this weapon's reload, handling, and target acquisition.

entries.title: Quicksilver Storm Catalyst
entries.description:
Converts this weapon's element into 0 Strand damage.

Kills with Grenade Chaser grenades spawn a 1 Tangle.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon's damage type becomes Strand. Final blows with grenades from this weapon create Tangles.

entries.title: Empowering Rift
entries.description:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.

Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.

Grants the following benefits to you and allies within the rift:
• 20% [PVP: 15%] Increased Damage (Empowering Buff)
• 260% [PVP: 104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate
• 230% [PVP: 92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
• Kills generate 15% Increased Ammo Meter Progress
entries.officialDescription:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.

entries.title: Healing Rift
entries.description:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.

Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.

Heals you and allies in the Rift for 40 [PVP: 35] HP per second.

If at full health, the Rift grants 3 HP of Overshield per second, up to a 15 HP Overshield.

Standing in a friendly Healing Rift makes the game count you as having an active Overshield at all times.
entries.officialDescription: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.

entries.title: Dual Loader
entries.description:
Reloading loads 🡅2 additional rounds into the magazine at a time.

🡅 Loads in 1 more round at a time.
entries.officialDescription: Reloads two additional shots at a time.

entries.title: The Scientific Method
entries.description: Dealing damage grants 'Scientific Method' for 5 seconds, granting 35 Handling and maximized Movement Speed. Buff cannot be refreshed.
entries.officialDescription: Damaging an opponent temporarily increases speed and handling.

entries.title: Sword Logic
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant Stacks of Sword Logic.

The number of Stacks and the buff duration are tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed since activation:
• Minors: 1 Stack for 🡅6.5 seconds
• Elites, Players: 2 Stacks for 🡅8.5 seconds
• Players in their Super and Minibosses: 3 Stacks for 🡅11.5 seconds
• Bosses: 4 Stacks for 🡅16.5 seconds

Damage increase at 1|2|3|4 Stacks:
15% | 25% [PVP: 15%] | 35% | 50%

Additional Kills refresh the buff duration to the duration tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

entries.title: The Right Choice
entries.description:
Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.

Every 7th shot in the magazine deals 252.52% [PVP: 5%] increased damage, has 50% increased Auto Aim cone size, and ricochets to the nearest target within an 8 [PVP: 5] meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: Every seventh bullet from this weapon ricochets to nearby targets.

entries.title: Reaper
entries.description:
The next Weapon Kill within 10 seconds of using your Class Ability spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)

10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
entries.officialDescription: Shortly after using your class ability, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Opening Shot
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits for your first shot (of the burst):
• 🡅25 Aim Assist and 🡅30 Range
• 5% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth

0 Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.

Firing the weapon prevents the perk from activating for 3 seconds.

🡅 Grants 5 more Aim Assist and Range.
entries.officialDescription: Greatly improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

entries.title: Shield Break Charge
entries.description: Breaking a Combatant Shield with the matching Elemental Damage Type grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge.
entries.officialDescription: Breaking a combatant's shield with the matching damage type grants you Armor Charge.

entries.title: CQC Optics: High
entries.description:
Passively increases Zoom by 1.

Increasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Increased Magnification
• Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Decreased Absolute Recoil
• Narrowed Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)
entries.officialDescription: Slightly increases zoom magnification.

entries.title: Solar Scavenger
entries.description:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to 0 Solar Weapons matching the Ammo Type.

Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.
entries.officialDescription: Solar weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.

entries.title: Gravity Well
entries.description:
Finishing a reload picks up all Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.

Also works on Motes and Crests.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading this weapon automatically gathers nearby ammo.

entries.title: Permeability
entries.description:
Class Ability usage refills ?% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your Super Ability until stowed.

Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.

Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on 0 Primary, 15% on 1 Special).

🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.
entries.officialDescription: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon. Improves handling.

entries.title: Explosive Payload
entries.description:
Splits off 50% of the weapon's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates on impact.

The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more. On Hand Cannons, the Payload deals 7% decreased damage in PvP.

The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.

[PvE] Total damage is increased by 15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. For crits, the overall increase is roughly equal to 15% divided by the Crit Multiplier.

[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.
entries.officialDescription: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact. Improves reload.

entries.title: Supercharged Magazine
entries.description:
Refills 5% of the magazine (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds while 0 Amplified.

Activating 1 Speed Booster increases this rate to once every 0.25 seconds, and allows the perk to overfill the magazine up to double its base capacity.

🡅 Passively grants 15 Magazine stat. (Equivalent of 50% of Backup Mag's Magazine stat benefit)
entries.officialDescription:
While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine.

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine. Improves magazine size.

entries.title: Fleet Footed
entries.description:
Dealing damage grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness and ?% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

Scoring a Weapon Kill increases this to 30 Airborne Effectiveness and ?% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Weapon damage refreshes buff duration.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing damage grants you a short window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.

entries.title: Weighted Edge
entries.description:
When the magazine has at least 1 round loaded, Glaive Melee Attacks deal 50% increased damage and apply 0 40 Slow for 4 [PVP: 1.5] seconds (8 [PVP: 1.5] with 1 Whisper of Durance).

Bosses only receive 20% increased damage.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon's melee attacks deal increased damage and slow targets when loaded with ammo.

entries.title: Final Warning Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 10% increased damage to marked targets. Minibosses and Bosses only receive 5% more damage.

Hits against marked Minors and Elites|Minibosses and Bosses have an 85%|25% chance to refund one ammo into the magazine.
entries.officialDescription: Hits against marked targets deal increased damage and have a chance to refund ammo to the magazine.

entries.title: Psychohack
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.

Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.

Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles
entries.officialDescription:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

entries.title: One Thousand Voices Catalyst
entries.description:
I gain 30 Stability and 20 Ammo Generation.

Each of my detonations release a Taken Seeker which aggressively tracks and burrows into nearby targets, dealing 22 ticks of damage, one tick every 0.25 seconds, for 5.65 seconds.

My Taken Seekers can stun 0 Overload Champions.

My foes can be afflicted by up to 5 seekers at once, and Blighted Enemies (directly impacted by Witherhoard) take 100% increased tick damage.

I do not interact with Malfeasance or Wish-Ender.

▛ Most of those who bargain with me do not win... ▟
entries.officialDescription: The weapon has become partially Taken. Detonations produce Taken energy that aggressively seeks out nearby targets and Blights them.

entries.title: Empowered Finish
entries.description: Finishers with no active Armor Charge Stacks grant 1 Stack of Armor Charge.
entries.officialDescription: Finisher final blows grant you 1 temporary Armor Charge when you have none.

entries.title: Ranged Weapon
entries.description:
Deals 50% increased damage to PvE Combatant Shields and 200% increased damage to 0 Barrier Champion shields.

Melee Hits can discharge 1 Bolt Charge stacks.

Tapping [Heavy Attack] throws your blade up to 50 meters away, seeking up to 3 enemies before returning. Blade deals 945 [PVP: 174] damage to each target and 80% reduced damage while returning. Pressing [Light Attack] recalls the blade early.

Holding [Heavy Attack] throws your blade 20 meters forward in a straight unguided path and increases its damage by 100%.

With Gyro Core Equipped: Thrown Blade Hits apply elemental effects matching your subclass:
• 2 Grants x1 Bolt Charge
• 3 35? Scorch (50? with 4 Ember of Ashes). Stacks vary? between the two heavy attacks
• 5 Weakens for 6 seconds
• 6 50 Slow for 4 seconds (8 with 7 Whisper of Durance). Stacks vary? between the two heavy attacks
• 8 Severs for 10 seconds (15 with 9 Thread of Continuity)
entries.officialDescription:
Heavy Attack : Throw your Praxic Blade, which will seek out multiple targets. Attacking recalls the Blade while it is in flight.
Heavy Attack : Hold to perform a more powerful throw, sending the Blade on a straight path in the direction of your aim. Releasing the button recalls the Blade.

entries.title: Hungering Quarrel
entries.description: Fires two 0 Void Bolts that heal on hit for 11 HP each.
entries.officialDescription: Double fires tracking bolts. Landing bolts leeches health from the target.

entries.title: Onslaught
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Onslaught' for 🡅5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of Onslaught:
• 16.7% | 28.6% | 37.5% decreased Firing Delay
• 15 | 25 | 35 Reload Speed

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5? seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon increase its rate of fire for an improved duration.

entries.title: Strand Loader
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Strand Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier
entries.officialDescription: Increases reload speed of Strand weapons.

entries.title: Arc Targeting
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Arc Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier
entries.officialDescription: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Arc weapons.

entries.title: Hatchling
entries.description:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each other spawns a 0 Threadling at the target's location.

🡅 Spawns an additional hatchling every ? activations.
entries.officialDescription: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

entries.title: Void/Strand Dual Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a 0 Void or 1 Strand Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid Void weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Reaper's Tithe
entries.description:
Grants stacks of 'Reaper's Tithe' based on the number of simultaneously killed enemies. Maximum of 4 stacks. (e.g. triple kill ⇒ 3 stacks)

'Reaper's Tithe' grants 20%|30%|40% increased damage for 🡅17 seconds at 2|3|4 stacks (1st stack does not exist). Timer only starts after firing.

Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration by 6 seconds, but not beyond the initial 🡅17-second duration.

Scoring a higher number of simultaneous Kills than the currently active stack count will not "upgrade" the buff.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Improved timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.

entries.title: The Dance
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness to 0 Primary Weapons.

Grants the following benefits while a 1 Primary Weapon is readied and not Aiming Down Sights:
• 30 Mobility
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance

DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook are uniquely tuned and do not receive as significant of a benefit.

2 Primary Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 20%

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

At full Class Ability energy, scoring multiple 3 Primary Weapon Kills within 6 seconds of each grants an additional Class Ability Charge. Maximum of 2 extra charges.

Activation progress granted by Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 100%
entries.officialDescription:
Moderately increases airborne effectiveness and hip fire mobility, range, and accuracy for weapons that use Primary ammo.

Final blows with Primary ammo weapons return dodge energy, which can overflow to create additional charges when full.

entries.title: Adept Accuracy
entries.description: Passively grants 10 Accuracy.
entries.officialDescription: +10 Accuracy

entries.title: Runneth Over
entries.description:
While within 15 meters of allies:
• Finishing a reload overfills the Magazine from reserves by 10% of the Base Magazine Capacity (rounded up) for each ally
• Bows receive 7.5%|15%|17.5%|20%|25% decreased Draw Time for 1|2|3|4|5+? allies
• Swords receive increased Charge Rate
entries.officialDescription: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.

entries.title: Adhesive Ordnance
entries.description:
Picking up an Ammo Brick causes the next shot fired to attach a Sticky Bomb on impact.

Sticky Bomb detonates after 0.8 seconds, dealing up to 🡅410 [PVP: ?] Kinetic Damage and Exhausting targets in 6 meter radius. Damage falls off to 50% at the edge of the radius.

Sticky Bombs inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.

🡅 Increases Sticky Bomb damage.
entries.officialDescription: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, has an improved detonation shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.

entries.title: Hierarchy of Needs Catalyst
entries.description:
Deploying a Guidance Ring or Guidance Seeker Hits grants the following benefits for 5 seconds:
• 40% reduced Hip-Fire Accuracy Cone
• 50% decreased Draw Time
• 100 Reload Speed
• ?% decreased Reload Animation Duration
entries.officialDescription: Deploying a Guidance Ring or striking a target with a seeking projectile improves draw time, hip-fire accuracy, and reload speed for a moderate duration.

entries.title: Headstone
entries.description:
Precision Kills create a Large 0 Stasis Crystal at the target's location.

Creating 5 1 Crystals within ? seconds prevents the perk from activating for 5 seconds.

🡅 Low-tier enemy kills also spawn a Large 2 Stasis Crystal instead of a Medium one.
entries.officialDescription: Precision final blows spawn a large Stasis crystal at a target's location.

entries.title: Dynamic Charge
entries.description:
Precision Hits and Kills grant one stack of 'Dynamic Charge'. Maximum of 15 stacks.

Holding [Reload] refills the magazine based on the number of stacks and converts them into 'Revolution' stacks. Switching modes again removes all stacks.

Revolution stacks remain ready until fired, after which point they last 10 seconds. Arc Seekers gain 30% [PVP: Varying] increased damage per stack of Revolution, up to 450% increased damage.

Arc Seekers also gain a non-linear increase to their splash radius, granting 33%|233% increased splash radius at x10|x20 Stacks (up to 4|7 meters in radius).

While Revolution's timer is active, Arc Seekers generate x2 0 Bolt Charge for each hit and gain the ability to discharge 1 Bolt Charge stacks. At or above 10 stacks of Revolution, hits generate x3 2 Bolt Charge.

3 Bolt Charge generation is unaffected by 4 Spark of Frequency.

Review this exotic's intrinsic perk to learn a special note about the 5 Bolt Charge behavior from this gun.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows and precision hits build up Dynamic Charge. Swapping to Arc Seeker mode increases damage and partially reloads the magazine based on the number of charges. Charged Arc Seeker hits grant, and can spend, Bolt Charge.

entries.title: Soulburn
entries.description:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.

Landing two Frontal Blade hits within 2 seconds of each other, or scoring a Frontal Blade kill, heals you for 40 HP and grants one stack of 'Soulfire Charge'. Maximum of 6 stacks.

Firing this weapon consumes one stack of Soulfire Charge to apply Potent Corruption (poison) that increases in DOT over time.

Potent Corruption deals 65 [PVP: ?] 0 Kinetic damage once every 0.5 seconds for 10 seconds, ramping up in damage by 8.7% for each tick over 20 ticks, ending at 300 [PVP: ?] damage on the final tick. In total, one application of Potent Corruption deals 2,985 [PVP: ?] damage.

Frontal Blades deal 50% increased melee damage against corrupted (poisoned) enemies.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows or rapid hits with this weapon's frontal blades heal you and provide Soulfire Charges, which cause rounds fired by this weapon to inflict potent corruption. These frontal blades deal increased damage to targets afflicted by corruption.

entries.title: Reversal of Fortune
entries.description: Missing twice within 6 seconds refills 1 round into the Magazine from thin air.
entries.officialDescription: Missing 2 shots returns a bullet to the magazine after a short duration.

entries.title: Sleeper Simulant Catalyst
entries.description: Increases Reserves by 2 (14🠚16) and decreases Charge Time by 33% (1024🠚774) without reducing damage.
entries.officialDescription: Speeds up weapon charge.

entries.title: Whirlwind Blade
entries.description:
Powered Sword Hits grant 3% increased damage for 🡅4 seconds. Stacks 10 times for a 30% Buff.

Stowing the weapon or Blocking removes all stacks. Wolfpack Round Hits also count as Powered Sword Hits.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid Sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for an improved duration. Guarding ends the effect.

entries.title: Mulligan
entries.description:
Missing has a chance to refund 1 ammo into the magazine based on the ammo type:
• 0 Primary Weapons: 🡅40%
• 1 Special and 2 Power Weapons: 🡅25%

🡅 Ammo Refund chance is increased by an additive 5%.
entries.officialDescription: Missing a shot has an improved chance to return ammo directly to the magazine.

entries.title: Nanotech Tracer Missiles
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Hits within 6 seconds of each fires a Tracking Rocket that matches the weapon's element.

Rockets deal 22.4 [PVP: 14] Impact and 24 [PVP: 15] Explosive damage on Hit and inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling. On non-primary weapons, the Rockets receive an additional damage increase.

% of magazine capacity as Hits required and the additional damage increase by weapon archetype:
• Hand Cannons, Pulse Rifles, Submachine Guns: 45% Magazine Capacity \\ 0% increased damage (Baseline)
• Sniper Rifles: 50%? \\ 100%
• Grenade Launchers: 30% \\ 25%
• Machine Guns: 25% \\ 50%
• Fusion Rifles, Shotguns: ?% \\ 150%

1 second cooldown after activation before further Hits provide activation progress again.
entries.officialDescription: Landing multiple hits turns your next shot into a homing micro-missile.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Scoring multiple Hits within 6 seconds of each fires a Tracking Rocket that matches the weapon's element.

Rockets deal 22.4 [PVP: 14] Impact and 24 [PVP: 15] Explosive damage on Hit and inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling. On non-primary weapons, the Rockets receive an additional damage increase.

% of magazine capacity as Hits required and the additional damage increase by weapon archetype:
• Hand Cannons, Pulse Rifles, Submachine Guns: 45% Magazine Capacity \\ 0% increased damage (Baseline)
• Sniper Rifles: 50%? \\ 100%
• Grenade Launchers: 30% \\ 25%
• Machine Guns: 25% \\ 50%
• Fusion Rifles, Shotguns: ?% \\ 150%

🡅 0.? second cooldown after activation before further Hits provide activation progress again.

entries.title: Dragonfly
entries.description:
Precision Kills cause targets to explode, dealing up to 123.89 [PVP: 95.3] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4.5-meter radius.

🡅 Increases detonation damage by 10%.
entries.officialDescription: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion. Improves reload.

entries.title: For the Empire
entries.description: Deals 11% increased damage against Cabal enemies and pierces through Phalanx Shields and Cabal Shield Domes.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon is Full Auto, does extra damage to Cabal, and penetrates Phalanx shields.

entries.title: Under-Over
entries.description:
Increases damage against shielded targets:
• 🡅140% increase against PVE Combatant Overshields
• 🡅55% increase against PVE Combatant Elemental Shields and 0 Barrier Champion Shields
• 🡅22% increase against Player Overshields and for bodyshots against Players with 1 Woven Mail

Notable Combatant Overshields include Shadow Legion Tech Pack and Lucent Moth Overshields. They are indicated with a glowing outline around the targets as well as a small blue health bar under the normal one.

Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

🡅 Damage Buff is increased: 125%⁠🠚⁠140%, 50%⁠🠚⁠55%, 20%⁠🠚⁠22?⁠%.
entries.officialDescription: Deals improved bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.

entries.title: Volatile Battery
entries.description:
Sets the Magazine Size to 33, greatly exceeding that of any other fusion rifle.

▛ ...an energy cell pulling from multiple timelines, resulting in a charge surplus that can only be explained if the firing cycle began in... ▟
entries.officialDescription:
This battery simultaneously exists in multiple timelines, causing the weapon to Overcharge.

 • Greatly increases magazine size

entries.title: Glacial Guard
entries.description:
Requires a 0 Stasis Super Ability to be equipped. Overwrites Barricade Cooldown to a unique, faster, 70 second Base Cooldown class ability (~30 seconds at 100 Class Stat).

Scoring 2 1 Stasis Kills within 3 seconds of each grants a Stack of 2 Frost Armor.

Restores 10 HP for each Stack of 3 Frost Armor you gain from any source.

Replaces Barricade with Glacial Guard which has a cooldown matching Towering Barricade's. Does not work with 4 Thruster.

On Glacial Guard Cast:
• Grants you maximum 5 Frost Armor Stacks (restoring HP for each Stack gained)
• Applies 100 [PVP: 40] 6 Slow to enemies within ? meters
entries.officialDescription: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, rapid Stasis final blows grant Frost Armor. You heal a small amount whenever you gain Frost Armor. Replaces your class ability with a burst of Stasis energy that freezes nearby combatants, slows nearby opponents, and grants you increased Frost Armor.

entries.title: Halberdier's Reach
entries.description:
Glaive Melee Kills load 1 Ammo into the Magazine from reserves. Can overfill the Magazine up to double the normal capacity.

While within 15 meters of 3 enemies:
Grants 50 Reload Speed and 200% increased Glaive Melee Damage.

Glaive Projectile Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to 350 [PVP: 101] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4? meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: Increases Glaive reload speed and melee damage when surrounded. Glaive melee final blows overflow a round to the magazine. Glaive projectile final blows detonate in an explosion.

entries.title: Slideshot
entries.description:
Sliding refills 15% of the Magazine (rounded up) and grants 🡅22 Range and Stability for your next shot (of the burst) within 2.5 seconds.

0.3 second cooldown after activation but can activate multiple times during a slide. Buff is removed on stow.

🡅 Stat bonuses are increased by 2?.
entries.officialDescription: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability greatly.

entries.title: Ambush
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits if you have not dealt or received damage in the last 5 seconds:
• 20 Range and 20 Handling
• 15% decreased Draw Time on Bows
• 10.78% increased damage against PvE Combatants. Linear Fusion Rifles only receive an 8.88% damage increase.

Deactivates 2 seconds after exchanging damage.
entries.officialDescription: Improves range, handling, and damage against combatants during the opening moments of an engagement.

entries.title: Stasis Dexterity
entries.description:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to 0 Stasis Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.
entries.officialDescription: Faster ready and stow speed for Stasis weapons.

entries.title: Butterfly
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights for 🡅1.4 seconds without firing causes your next kill to trigger an explosion matching the weapon's element within an 8 meter radius, experiencing a maximum of 30% damage falloff.

Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.

🡅 Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.

entries.title: Lightning Rod
entries.description:
Precision Kills grant 'Lightning Rod'.

Lightning Rod arrows explode on impact and chain lightning in an 8 meter radius around their point of impact for 194 [PVP: 50.3] damage each.
entries.officialDescription: Precision kills grant the next shot chain-lightning capabilities.

entries.title: Archer's Tempo
entries.description:
Precision Hits decrease Draw Time by 25% for 🡅4 seconds.

Buff is removed on stow.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.
entries.officialDescription: Draw time substantially decreases after every precision hit for a longer duration.

entries.title: Pulse Monitor
entries.description:
Refills Magazine from reserves upon dropping to 🡅35% Shield Health. Can activate while stowed.

Grants 50 Handling and a 0.95x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier while at or below 🡅35% Shield Health.

Buff lingers for 1 second once the condition is no longer met.

🡅 Activates with 5?% more Shield Health remaining.
entries.officialDescription: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when lightly wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

entries.title: Paracausal Shot
entries.description:
On kill or Precision Hit, gain one stack of Paracausal Charge. Maximum of 7 stacks. Stacks are removed on reload or any full magazine refill.

Paracausal Charge grants increased damage against Combatants at 1|2|3|....|7| Stacks:
21%|36.5%|48%|55%|60%|63%|66%

Paracausal Charge turns into Paracausal Shot on the final round of the magazine. Buff is removed if stowed.

Paracausal Shot's damage bonus at 1|2|3|...|7| stacks:
PvE: 292%|300%|340%|425%|667%|1071%|1736%
PvP: 30%|33%|46%|80.5%|154%|288%|509%
entries.officialDescription: Final blows and precision hits with Hawkmoon grant stacks of Paracausal Charge, increasing damage versus combatants. The final round in the magazine greatly increases damage based on the number of stacks. Stowing Hawkmoon on the final round removes this bonus.

entries.title: Snareweaver
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.

Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3

At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits 0 Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.

Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [PVP: 5] damage and are 1 Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.

5 second cooldown between 2 Suspends on the same enemy.

3 Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with 4 Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.
entries.officialDescription: Precision hits and final blows build energy towards a Snareweaver arrow that can be fired from the hip. On impact, Snareweaver arrows create a pattern of traps that suspend nearby targets.

entries.title: Precision Frame
entries.description: This weapon fires a small auto-tracking missile. Missiles lock onto targets when aimed.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon fires small auto-tracking rockets. Rockets lock onto targets when aimed.

alternateDescriptions.text: Recoil pattern on this weapon is more predictably vertical. Fires quickly with high accuracy.

entries.title: The Master
entries.description:
Rounds must be chambered after every shot. Animation can be sprint-cancelled as soon as the bolt is drawn in (at the 'clink'), allowing for an increased rate of fire.

Scoring a Precision Hit grants one stack of 'The Master' up to an infinite amount, with effective benefits ending after 20 stacks. Shots visually explode after 20 stacks with no added benefit.

Grants diminishing increases to Precision Damage across 1|2|3|....|20 stacks:
• Stacks 1-5: 16%|22%|27%|31%|35%
• Stacks 6-10: 38%|41%|44%|47%|49.5%
• Stacks 11-15: 52%|54%|56.5%|59%
• Stacks 16-20: 63%|64.5%|66%|68%|70%

Buff persists until death.
entries.officialDescription:
Scoring precision hits increases this weapon's damage until the wielder's defeat.

Massively increases ammo reserves.

entries.title: Sundering
entries.description:
Grants the following for 7 seconds upon breaking an enemy's shield or destroying a Vehicle or Construct:
• 40 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 0.9x Draw Time Multiplier
entries.officialDescription:
Destroying vehicles and constructs or breaking target shields grants this weapon bonus reload speed and charge rate.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

entries.title: Detonator Beam
entries.description:
Scoring 🡅20 Hits within ? seconds of each triggers an explosion around the target, dealing up to 250 [PVP: ?] weapon element-matching damage in an 8 meter radius.

🡅 Number of Hits required is decreased by 5.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target. Triggers faster.

entries.title: Overclocked Heatsink
entries.description:
Passively grants 2% increased damage and 10 decreased Cooling Efficiency stat.

🡅 Passively grants 2 Handling.
entries.officialDescription: Slightly increases damage in exchange for reduced cooling.

alternateDescriptions.text: Passively grants 2% increased damage and 10 decreased Cooling Efficiency stat.

entries.title: Soaring Fang
entries.description:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

While grounded, hits grant 1.5% charge to your Anti-Grav Repulsors. Kills grant 10% charge.

Once you are above 3% charge, hits after being airborne for 0.5 seconds activate 'Hover Mode'. Hover Mode is disengaged by Holding [Reload], reaching 0% charge, or stowing the weapon.

Hover Mode removes all airborne accuracy penalties, reduces combatant accuracy (similar to 0 Amplified's effects), and grants complete aerial movement at a speed of 5.5 meters per second.

Hover Mode starts at 3 seconds. Each hit restores 0.3 seconds to the timer. Timer cannot exceed 3 seconds.
entries.officialDescription:
Dealing damage while grounded charges antigrav repulsors. Dealing damage while airborne extends antigrav repulsors.
Alternate Weapon Action to disengage antigrav repulsors.

entries.title: Adept Blast Radius
entries.description: Passively grants 10 Blast Radius.
entries.officialDescription: +10 Blast Radius

entries.title: Osteo Striga Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 30 Reload and 20 Stability.

Poison Kills instantly refill the magazine and can overfill it up to 300% total capacity.

0.5 second cooldown between activations.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with corruption return ammo to the magazine.

entries.title: Apollonic Tangent
entries.description:
While at 3 stacks, hip-firing a fully-drawn arrow spawns a Guidance Ring.

Guidance Ring lasts 20 seconds and will rotate in place to face you. Only one Guidance Ring per-guardian can exist at a time, but up to 3 Guidance Rings can exist across a fireteam. Each Guidance Ring can stack.

Firing any fully-drawn arrow through the Guidance Ring triggers several additional seeking projectiles, each dealing 192 [PVP: 15] damage. Seekers gain 50% [PVP: 15-20%] increased damage past 40 meters and have a maximum range of 80 meters. Precision hits with the fired arrow guide the seekers towards that enemy.

Each seeker applies 15 0 Scorch (20 with 1 Ember of Ashes) and deals Weapon-Element Matching Explosive Damage in a 4 meter radius.

Guidance Rings grant their benefits to any Combat Bow, including Legendaries, Exotics, Heavy Crossbows, 2 Shadowshot, and also Buried Bloodline.

Arrows fired by Hierarchy of Needs release three seekers, while most other bows release two. Casting 3 Shadowshot: Deadfall releases six.
entries.officialDescription: Arrows fired through a Guidance Ring release seeking projectiles, which scorch targets and do more damage based on distance traveled. Precision hits help guide these seekers toward their targets.

entries.title: Service of Luzaku Catalyst
entries.description:
Teeming Nests can be harvested into a collectible 0 Tangle after spawning 6 1 Threadlings. This destroys the nest.

These tangles ignore the global 2 Tangle cooldown.
entries.officialDescription: Nests now mature over time. Fully mature nests can be harvested with [Interact] Hold to grant yourself a held Tangle.

entries.title: Peregrine Strike
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness.

Grants Peregrine Strike after sprinting for 2 seconds and being airborne for 0.5 seconds. Buff is removed upon touching the ground.

Peregrine Strike increases the impact damage of Shoulder Charge Melee Abilities by 250%.

Against Minibosses, the buff is increased to 550% and refunds your Melee Ability charge on hit.

Shoulder Charge abilities: 0 Seismic Strike, 1 Hammer Strike, and 2 Shield Bash

Provides no benefits when hitting 3 Frozen enemies.
entries.officialDescription: All shoulder charge abilities (Seismic Strike, Hammer Strike, or Shield Bash) deal bonus damage when activated in the air. Damaging mini-bosses, Tormentors, or Champions with your shoulder charge refunds your melee. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.

entries.title: Vanishing Execution
entries.description:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers grant 0 Invisibility and restore 67 HP.

Invisibility Duration is based on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 7 seconds
• Elites, Enemy Players: 10 seconds
• Minibosses and Bosses: 13 seconds

The duration of 1 Invisibility granted by Finishers is 3 seconds longer. 2 Echo of Persistence increases 3 Invisibility duration by 41.5%.
entries.officialDescription: Powered melee final blows grant invisibility and restore a portion of health and shields. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the duration of the invisibility and the amount of health and shields restored.

entries.title: Reflective Vents
entries.description:
Upon sliding after sprinting for at least 1.5 seconds with your Class Ability fully charged:
Projects a 180° frontal shield that reflects all incoming projectiles for 0.45 seconds.

Reflected projectiles deal 50% increased damage.

After shield deactivation, 2% Class Ability energy is drained for every point of damage reflected.

Currently partially bugged and does not drain Class Ability Energy for projectiles reflected at the end of your slide.
entries.officialDescription: While sliding with full class ability energy, you gain a frontal shield that reflects incoming damage. After reflecting damage, your class ability energy is depleted based on the amount of damage reflected.

entries.title: Attrition Orbs
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 🡅1.1% Super Energy.

Does not require Direct Hits. Hit counter persists through stow.

Hit requirements for activation:
• Rocket Launchers: 2 hits
• Heavy Grenade Launchers: 3 Hits
• Wave-Frame Grenade Launchers: 4 hits
• Bows: 4 Hits
• Swords: 5 Hits
• Area-Denial Grenade Launchers: 26 Hits
• Others: 55% of Magazine Size rounded down + 1

Support Frame Auto Rifle healing round Hits on damaged allies count as 2 Hits.

🡅 Spawned Orbs grant 37.5?% more Super Energy (0.8%⁠🠚⁠1.1?⁠%).
entries.officialDescription: Dealing sustained damage creates a slightly improved Orb of Power.

entries.title: Rapid Hit
entries.description:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier

🡅 Stronger Effect.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed substantially.

entries.title: Radiolaria Transposer
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Weapon Kills within 8 seconds of each causes your last-killed target to explode and create a Radiolaria Pool at their location. Stowing the weapon resets the Kill Counter.

Explosion deals up to 67.5 [PVP: ?] damage in a 3? meter radius.

Radiolaria Pool information:
• Deals 15 [PVP: ?] 0 Arc damage every 0.65 seconds
• Lasts for ? seconds (3? damage ticks)
• Inherits the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling and any weapon damage buffs

Activation Progress based on Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: ?%
entries.officialDescription: Rapid final blows cause targets to explode into a pool of radiolarian fluid.

entries.title: Reservoir Burst
entries.description:
Passively grants 30 Magazine Size stat. (Identical to a Backup Mag mod)

While Magazine is at or above maximum capacity:
Grants 🡅33% increased damage and causes enemies to explode on death, dealing 162.5 damage in a ? meter radius.

Explosions inherit the weapon's element and Combatant Damage Scaling. Explosions triggered with Linear Fusion Rifle kills deal an additional 30% increased damage.

🡅 Damage buff is increased by 10% (30%🠚33%).
entries.officialDescription: When the battery is full, your next burst is improved, dealing additional damage and causing targets to explode when defeated.

entries.title: Noble Deeds
entries.description:
Assisting Allies by Reviving, Healing, Empowering, or granting Subclass Buffs to them grants 10 Stacks of Noble Deeds. Maximum of 10 Stacks.

Can be triggered even while the weapon is stowed.

Kills consume 1 [PVP: 2] Stacks of Noble Deeds.

Grants 🡅 35? Handling and 🡅 35? Reload Speed while you have active Stacks. Swords receive 🡅 25? Charge Rate instead.
entries.officialDescription: Gain charges by assisting your allies with revives, healing, overshields, and subclass buffs. Consume charges by defeating combatants. While charged, this weapon is granted improved bonus handling, reload speed, and Sword charge rate.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Assisting Allies by Reviving, Healing, Empowering, or granting Subclass Buffs to them grants 10 Stacks of Noble Deeds. Maximum of 10 Stacks.

Can be triggered even while the weapon is stowed.

Kills consume 1 [PVP: 2] Stacks of Noble Deeds.

Grants 30 Handling and 30 Reload Speed while you have active Stacks. Swords receive 20 Charge Rate instead.

entries.title: Firmly Planted
entries.description:
While Crouched:
• 🡅35 Handling and 🡅25 Stability
• -40% Accuracy Cone Size
• -17% Accuracy Cone Growth
• -80% horizontal Recoil

Effects are halved on Fusion Rifles (decimals are rounded up).

🡅 Grants 5 more Handling and Stability.
entries.officialDescription: Greatly increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.

entries.title: White Nail
entries.description: Landing 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each refills the magazine. Pulls 2 shots from reserves and generates 1 ammo from thin air.
entries.officialDescription: Higher base precision damage. Rapidly landing three precision hits will refill the magazine.

entries.title: Temporal Alignment Refit
entries.description:
Grants 20% increased damage for 16 seconds upon activating both 0 Arc and 1 Stasis Overcharge one after another.

No time limit between the two activations.
entries.officialDescription: Overcharging both Arc and Stasis modes grants a period of increased damage.

entries.title: Transcendent Zen Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Transcendent Moment trait:
Weapon Kills grant stat benefits based on the weapon's elemental alignment for ? seconds.

Light Alignment grants ? Stability and ? Handling.

Dark Alignment grants ? Range and ? Aim Assist.

Kills while Transcendent activate both bonuses.

Light Alignment: 0 Arc, 1 Solar, 2 Void
Darkness Alignment: 3 Stasis, 4 Strand
entries.officialDescription: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

entries.title: Subsistence Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Subsistence trait:
Weapon Kills refill 10% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.

Submachine Gun and Auto Rifle Kills refill 17% of the magazine.
entries.officialDescription: Subsistence

entries.title: Rapid Hit Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Rapid Hit trait:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier
entries.officialDescription: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

entries.title: Rampage
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Rampage. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Stacks expire one at a time every 🡅5 seconds.

Grants a 10%|21%|33.1% damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks.

Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant increased damage for an improved duration. Stacks 3 times.

entries.title: Revved Consumption
entries.description: Landing hits grants 7HP per damage instance.
entries.officialDescription: Damaging a combatant heals the wielder.

entries.title: Unflinching Harmonic Aim
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights with Weapons matching your Subclass Element:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.
entries.officialDescription: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming an Arc weapon.

entries.title: Adept Range
entries.description: Passively grants 10 Range.
entries.officialDescription: +10 Range

entries.title: Release the Wolves
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights, fires in 5 round bursts.

While Hip-Firing, Lord of Wolves becomes fully-automatic and grants the following benefits:
• 60% increased Rate of Fire
• 200% increased Accuracy Cone Size
• ? reduced Range
• 39% increased bodyshot damage and 20% increased precision damage. Bosses take 10% increased bodyshot damage and receive no increase to precision damage.
entries.officialDescription: When firing from the hip, this weapon shoots in full auto and damage and rate of fire are increased, but accuracy and range are decreased.

entries.title: Delicate Tuning
entries.description:
Grants linearly decreasing benefits as Weapon Heat increases from 0% to 50%:
• 🡅22 to 🡅11 Range
• ? to ? Handling
• ? to ? decreased Accuracy Cone Growth

🡅 Stat Benefits are increased by 10%.
entries.officialDescription: While at low heat, this weapon has slightly more improved range, handling, and accuracy.

entries.title: Unflinching Arc Aim
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights with 0 Arc Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.
entries.officialDescription: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming an Arc weapon.

entries.title: Cosmology
entries.description:
Kills throw enemies ? meters back before triggering a 0 Void Explosion. Void Explosions deal 470 [PVP: ?] damage in a 7 meter radius and spawn two seeking orbs, each dealing 51 [PVP: 20] damage. Explosion falls to 0% damage at the edge of its blast radius.

Void Explosion kills can trigger additional Void Explosions.
entries.officialDescription: Kills with this weapon cause enemy targets to detonate and spawn Void projectiles that track targets.

entries.title: Solar Targeting
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Solar Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier
entries.officialDescription: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Solar weapons.

entries.title: Cascade Point
entries.description:
After scoring a kill or multiple Precision Hits within 5 seconds of each with a different weapon:

Readying this weapon reduces its Firing Delay for 🡅2.75 seconds.

Firing Delay is reduced by 30% on SMGs and Machine Guns and by 40% on other archetypes.

Precision Hits requried per weapon archetype:
• Bows, Linear Fusion/Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaive Projectiles: 2 hits
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 hits
• Auto/Trace/Pulse Rifles, SMGs, Machine Guns, Sidearms: 6 hits

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.25 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for an improved duration.

entries.title: Precision Instrument
entries.description:
