Enemies within 6 meters of the explosion are disoriented for 4.5 seconds. Disorient radius cannot be increased using other perks.

Champions and Bosses are unaffected by Disorient.

(Disorient is effectively the equivalent of 0 Arc Blind without any of the elemental synergies and anti-champion benefits)

Players near the explosion briefly lose their HUD and have their screen distorted for up to ? seconds. Duration varies depending on the distance from the blast.
entries.officialDescription:
Detonation has a brief disorienting effect.
 • Greatly decreases blast radius

entries.title: Break the Bank
entries.description:
Direct Hits apply 'Blighted' to the target, dealing twice as much tick damage as Blighted Pools at half the rate for 9.5 seconds. Killing Blighted enemies causes them to drop a Blighted Pool.

Targets can only take damage from a single instance of Blighted at a time.

Enemies that are Blighted can take simultaneous damage from a Blighted Pool, and also take 25% increased damage from Malfeasance and Wish-Ender.

Blighted targets are STILL NOT CONSIDERED "TAKEN COMBATANTS".
entries.officialDescription: Blighted targets take damage over time and blight the nearby area on death.

entries.title: Heavy Burst
entries.description: Hard-hitting two-burst fire.
entries.officialDescription: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.

entries.title: Aggressive Frame
entries.description: Hard-hitting, high recoil. Increases rate of fire after kill.
entries.officialDescription: Hard-hitting, high recoil. Increases rate of fire after final blows.

entries.title: Bray Inheritance
entries.description:
Weapon Hits grant Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy. Does not require Direct Hits.

Ability Energy gains on Hits by weapon:
• Trustee: 0.35%
• Posterity: 0.45%
• Commemoration: 0.4%
• Heritage: 0.85%
• Succession: 1.5%
• Bequest: 2% (Grenade and Class Ability only)

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing damage regenerates a small amount of ability energy.

entries.title: Colony Catalyst
entries.description: Increases Magazine Size by 1 (7🠚8) and grants 30 Ammo Generation.
entries.officialDescription: Increased ammo reserves.

entries.title: Repulsor Brace
entries.description:
Kills against 0 Void Debuffed enemies grant a 45 HP 1 Void Overshield for 🡅10 seconds (🡅15 with 2 Echo of Persistence).

🡅 Overshield Duration is increased by 2 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.

entries.title: No Distractions
entries.description:
Grants 35% Flinch Resistance after 1 second of Aiming Down Sights (ADS) without firing. Remains active until you're no longer ADS.

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed.
entries.officialDescription: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

entries.title: Enlightened Action
entries.description:
Weapon Hits grant Stacks of Enlightened Action for 2 seconds. Maximum of 12 Stacks.

Stat bonuses at 1|2|…|12 Stacks:
2|7|12|15|20|25|30|35|38|40|45|50 Handling and Reload Speed

Stacks granted per hit by Weapon Type:
• Hand Cannons: 3 Stacks
• Bows: ? Stacks
• Automatic Weapons: 1 Stack
entries.officialDescription: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

entries.title: Field Prep
entries.description:
Grants the following while Crouched:
• 50 Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 0.8x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier

Passively grants 20 Ammo Generation stat. (50% more than 1 Ammo Generation armor mod)
entries.officialDescription: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

entries.title: Play with Your Prey
entries.description:
0 Void Rocket applies 1 Suppression for 10 seconds.

2 Solar Rocket applies 60 3 Scorch (90 with 4 Ember of Ashes).
entries.officialDescription: The Void rocket suppresses combatants. The Solar rocket scorches.

entries.title: Osmosis
entries.description:
Grenade Ability usage refills 50% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your equipped Grenade Ability until stowed.

Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.

Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on 0 Primary, 15% on 1 Special).

Perks that replace your Grenade Ability (such as 2 Gunpowder Gamble or Transcendence Grenades) will also trigger Osmosis.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.
entries.officialDescription: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it. Handling is improved.

entries.title: Surrounded
entries.description:
Being within 15 meters of 3 Enemies grants 🡅47% increased damage. Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once the condition is no longer met.

Exceptions:
• Swords only receive a 🡅41.75% damage increase.
• Grenade and Rocket Launchers receive a 🡅41.75% Explosive Damage increase and a 🡅47% Impact Damage increase.
• Wolfpack Rounds receive a 🡅41.75% Explosive Damage increase.

🡅 Damage is increased by a further 5%. (40%🠚47%, 35%🠚41.75%)
entries.officialDescription: This weapon gains improved bonus damage when three or more targets are in close proximity.

entries.title: One-Two Punch
entries.description:
Hitting a target with 🡅10 of the 12 Pellets in the spread increases the damage of your next Melee attack within 3 seconds.

Melee Damage increase by weapon type:
• Shotgun: 150% additional base melee damage
• Hand Cannon: 75% [PVP: 100?%] additional base melee damage

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

The buff does not stack with the passive Melee Damage increase against 0 Frozen non-Boss targets. The higher buff of the two takes precedence.

🡅 Requires 2 fewer Pellets to activate.
entries.officialDescription: Hitting a target with nearly every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

entries.title: Evolution
entries.description:
Transmutation Spheres act like Relics and grant three actions. Spheres last 30 seconds once on the ground, start with 30 ammo on pickup, and drain at a rate of 1 ammo per second. Dropping a Sphere despawns it.

• Light Attacks deal 270 [PVP: 150] damage, disorient combatants, and cost 1 ammo. You can attack twice per second. Airborne attacks deal 25% reduced damage.

• Heavy Attacks consume the sphere, slamming it on the ground for 1350 [PVP: 300] damage with no falloff, and 0 Suppress enemies in a 5 meter radius.

• Guarding projects a draining field in a 5 meter radius around you. The field disorients enemies, deals 28 [PVP: 12] damage every 0.3 seconds to lifesteal 5 HP, and grants 80% [PVP: 50%] damage resistance along with knockback immunity.

Guarding drains 1 ammo every 0.25 seconds, slowing at 3 ammo and halting on the final round. Guarding at 1 ammo deals increasingly lethal self-damage every 0.7 seconds until you stop or die.
entries.officialDescription:
Transmutation spheres you create can be picked up and wielded as weapons by you or your allies.
• Light Attack : Light attack
• Heavy Attack : Suppressing heavy attack
• Block : Guard/drain nearby targets

entries.title: Void Scavenger
entries.description:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to 0 Void Weapons matching the Ammo Type.

Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.
entries.officialDescription: Void weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.

entries.title: Temporal Unlimiter
entries.description:
Kills in Auto Rifle mode grant 'Overcharge' stacks. Maximum of 6 Stacks.

Tier 1 and 2 Minors, as well as Tier 1 Elites grant 1 stack. All other enemy tiers and players grant 2 stacks.

At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to change this Fusion Rifle into a Linear Fusion Rifle. Grants three Hobgoblin-like shots that deal 1475 [PVP: 537] precision damage and 200% increased damage against Champions. Stowing after activation removes all charged shots.

Precision Kills while in this mode trigger a 0 Solar Ignition that deals 5% more damage than base.

Exiting Linear Mode refills the magazine.
entries.officialDescription:
Defeating targets builds stacks of Overcharge.

Alternate Weapon Action : When fully Overcharged, swap firing modes. In this mode, hold the trigger to charge up and fire Linear Fusion Rifle shots that cause an ignition on precision final blows.

entries.title: Rapid-Fire Frame
entries.description: Full Auto. Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.

entries.title: Heretical Behavior
entries.description:
Landing 4 Weapon Hits within 3 seconds of each other grants 'Heretical Behavior' for 8 (🡅 ?) seconds. Each hit only counts once every 0.4 seconds. Glaive Melees require 8 hits. Area-Denial Grenade Launchers require ? hits.

Heretical Behavior grants the following benefits while active:
• 8% Increased Damage
• 50? Handling
• 50? Reload Speed
• 20% Faster Reload Animation Speed

Buff can be refreshed.
entries.officialDescription: Sustained weapon damage or final blows versus powerful targets grant this weapon bonus reload, handling, and damage versus combatants. Gain this bonus immediately for a longer duration when you are revived.

entries.title: Finality's Auger Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants the Bait and Switch trait:
Dealing damage with a weapon starts a 7 second timer. Dealing additional weapon damage resets the timer to 7 seconds.

Dealing damage with all 3 of your weapons without letting the timer run out grants you 'Bait and Switch' for 10 seconds, granting 30% increased damage.

Timer is disabled while Bait and Switch is active, requiring a full activation sequence once the buff expires.
entries.officialDescription: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

entries.title: Shattering Blade
entries.description: Grants 67% increased damage for Grounded Heavy Attacks that consume all remaining ammo.
entries.officialDescription: If your heavy attack consumes the last of your ammo, it deals significantly increased damage. Excludes aerial attacks.

entries.title: Red Death Reformed Catalyst
entries.description:
Scoring 2 [PVP: 1] kills grants 'Red Death Charged'.

Your next kill with Red Death Reformed consumes this buff and triggers a burst of healing, granting 120 HP (0 Cure x2) to allies within a 7.5 meter radius of you.

This kill also spawns a 1 Restoration Orb at your feet, granting you and allies 2 Restoration x2 for 4 seconds (6 with 3 Ember of Solace) on pickup.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows charge this weapon. When the weapon is charged, the next final blow creates a healing burst at your location and leaves a remnant behind that provides restoration to allies.

entries.title: Proximity Power
entries.description:
Weapon Kills while within 15 meters of an enemy grant a stack of Proximity Power 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Each stack grants 🡅18 Melee stat.

🡅 Grants 3 more Melee stat per stack.
entries.officialDescription: When targets are nearby, final blows grant an improved amount of bonus Melee stat.

entries.title: Seriously, Watch Out
entries.description:
Grants one stack of 0 Bolt Charge every 1.5 seconds while 1 Juggernaut's Shield is active.

While 2 Speed Booster is active, allies in a ""certain"" area behind you receive 3 Speed Booster.

...We have no idea what they were cooking with this rework, but it's here to stay I guess.
entries.officialDescription: While your Juggernaut shield is active, you slowly gain Bolt Charge stacks over time and increased weapon ready speed. Sprinting while amplified creates an energizing field behind you that grants close by allies speed boost.

entries.title: Backup Plan
entries.description:
Grants the following for 🡅2.5 seconds upon readying:
• 30% decreased Charge Time
• 20% decreased damage
• 100 Handling

Weapon must be stowed for 3 seconds before readying for the perk to activate.

Linear Fusion Rifles only: firing the weapon refreshes the buff duration (but only at higher framerates).

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for an improved short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.

entries.title: Phase Magazine
entries.description:
Sets the Submachine Gun's damage and magazine profile to that of a Precision Frame.

Does not grant Precision Frame intrinsic benefits.
entries.officialDescription:
Increases damage while lowering rate of fire.
 • Decreases magazine size

entries.title: Kickstart
entries.description:
Upon sliding after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon held:
Grants 15% increased damage and 20% decreased Charge Time for ? seconds.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased.
entries.officialDescription: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for an improved duration.

entries.title: Stasis Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a 0 Stasis Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid Stasis weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Vex Mythoclast Catalyst
entries.description:
Landing 15 hits within 3 seconds of each, or scoring a kill, grants 20% increased damage, 20 Stability, and 20% reduced Accuracy Cone Size for 5 seconds.

Buff applies to Auto Rifle mode only.
entries.officialDescription: While in full auto mode, final blows or rapid hits with this weapon grant bonus damage, accuracy, and stability for a short duration.

entries.title: Encore
entries.description:
On Weapon Kill, for 🡅7.5 seconds:
Grants 1 Stack on Bodyshot Kills and 2 Stacks on Precision Kills. Maximum of 4 Stacks.

Each stack grants 5 Range, 8 Stability, and -1.25% Accuracy Cone Size.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription:
Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.
Effect duration is improved.

entries.title: Carrion Munitions
entries.description:
Killing an Elite or higher-ranked Combatant spawns a seeking insectoid robot that chases enemies within 25 meters. The insectoid deals weapon-element matching damage (varying by archetype) in a 5 meter radius.

0.5 second cooldown between insectoid spawns. Insectoid kills count as weapon kills and can trigger perks, but cannot spawn more insectoids.

🡅 Insectoid robot damage is increased by ?%
entries.officialDescription: Final blows on tougher combatants create insectoid robots that chase combatants and create greater explosions.

alternateDescriptions.text:
Killing an Elite or higher-ranked Combatant spawns a seeking insectoid robot that chases enemies within 25 meters. The insectoid deals weapon-element matching damage (varying by archetype) in a 5 meter radius.

0.5 second cooldown between insectoid spawns. Insectoid kills count as weapon kills and can trigger perks, but cannot spawn more insectoids.

entries.title: Lightning Seeker
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a seeking 0 Arc Wave.

Lightning Seeker Properties:
• Aggresively tracks the closest enemy within a 32 meter radius, dealing 1634 [PVP: Death] damage and applying 1 Jolt
• Additionally chains to 4 additional targets within a 10 meter radius on hit, dealing 65 damage
entries.officialDescription: Alternate Weapon Action : When weapon is fully charged, consume charge before firing to make your next shot track targets across the ground, jolting them and unleashing chain lightning on impact.

entries.title: Fourth Time's the Charm
entries.description:
Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 🡅3 seconds of each refills 2 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.

Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.

🡅 Allowed time between Precision Hits is increased by 1 second.
entries.officialDescription: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine. Increases time between precision shots.

entries.title: Unrelenting
entries.description:
Starts Health Regeneration and restores 🡅70 HP upon reaching 100% Activation Progress with Weapon Kills within 5 seconds of each.

Activation Progress by Enemy Rank:
• Minor Combatants: 34%
• Players: 67%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%

🡅 Restores an additional 5 HP.
entries.officialDescription: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

entries.title: Ashes to Assets
entries.description:
Increases Super Energy Gains from Grenade Kills based on Enemy Rank with 1|2|3 Mods equipped:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1%|?|?
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: ?|?|?
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?|?|?
• T4 Minors, T3-T4 Elites, and higher: 5%|?|?
• Players: ?|?|?

Bonus Super Energy gains from Grapple Melee Kills are reduced by 50%. Kill can only trigger either Ashes to Assets or Hands On but not both.
entries.officialDescription: Gain bonus Super energy on grenade kills.

entries.title: Tight Fit
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Direct Weapon Hits within 3? seconds of each grants ~20% Class Ability Energy. There is no cooldown on hits or activation procs (Hint: Use DoT Weapons).

Activation progress granted by weapon type:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 7.14%
• Auto Rifles, Machine Guns: 8.33%
• Pulse Rifles: 9.1%
• Sidearms: 12.5%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 16.7%
• Swords, Shotguns: 20%
• Fusion Rifles, Bows, Glaives, Grenade Launchers, Sniper Rifles: 34%

Casting Dodge reloads all equipped weapons, collects all nearby ammo bricks within 15 meters, and grants you 1 Stack of 'Tight Fit' for 15 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.

Allies within 15 meters receive the same number of stacks as you have after the Dodge.

Stat Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 40|40|45|50|55 Reload Speed
• 0%|7.5%|8.5%|9%|11% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 40?|40?|45?|50?|55? Handling
entries.officialDescription: Dodging instantly reloads all your weapons and grants increased reload and handling to you and nearby allies. While the buff is active, additional dodges increase the buff strength and refresh the timer, maxing out at 5 stacks. Dealing sustained damage grants class ability energy.

entries.title: One for All
entries.description:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 🡅11 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.
entries.officialDescription: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for an improved duration.

entries.title: Vermin
entries.description: Finishing a reload within 3 seconds of a kill grants 0 Void Invisibility for 5.8 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading immediately after a kill grants a brief period of invisibility.

entries.title: Jötunn Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants the Cornered trait:
Grants 15% decreased Charge/Draw Time while within 15 meters of 2 enemies.

Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.

Also grants the Incandescent trait:
Weapon Kills trigger a 0 Solar explosion that applies 30 1 Scorch Stacks (40 with 2 Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more 3 Scorch Stacks.

4 Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.
entries.officialDescription: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

entries.title: Shot in the Dark
entries.description:
Entering 0 Void Invisibility grants 'Shot in The Dark' until you leave Invisibility. Lasts for 2.5 seconds upon exit.

While Shot In The Dark is active:
• 25% increased damage
• Hits apply 1 Weaken for 6 [PVP: 3] seconds
• Kills grant 2 Invisiblity again
entries.officialDescription:
Remaining invisible grants this weapon increased damage for a brief duration.

Hitting a target with this weapon's projectiles while Shot in the Dark is active weakens them. Defeating a target with this weapon while Shot in the Dark is active turns you invisible once more.

entries.title: Paracausal Imbuement
entries.description:
Kills grant bonus Super Energy based on Combatant Rank.

Refills the magazine on Super cast.

Grants 20% increased damage for 20 seconds once Super energy reaches 0%.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant Super energy. This weapon gains bonus damage once your Super expires.

entries.title: Harmonic Scavenger
entries.description:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Weapons matching your Super Element and the Ammo Type.

Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.
entries.officialDescription: Arc weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.

entries.title: Willing Vessel
entries.description:
Dealing damage or scoring kills increments continuously scales up stat bonuses. Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up continuously.

Maximum effect is displayed as x5 Willing Vessel. Stat bonuses constantly decrease by 2.2?% of the maximum bonus per second?.

Stat bonuses when the visual stack display reaches 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• ?|?|?|?|20? Stability
• ?|?|?|?|30? Handling
• 2?|5|10|25|30 Reload Speed
• ?|?|?|?|15% decreased Draw/Charge Time
• 20|40|50|70|80 Charge Rate (Swords)
entries.officialDescription: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants increased stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.

entries.title: Strategist
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 🡅11% Class Ability Energy.

Kills with Fusion Rifles, Glaives, Shotguns, and Sniper Rifles grant 🡅22%.

Class Ability usage grants ? Stability for ? seconds.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

🡅 Class Ability Energy gains are increased by 10%. (e.g. 10%⁠🠚⁠11%)
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon generate improved class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

entries.title: And Another Thing
entries.description:
Grants an extra Grenade Ability Charge and a passive copy of Firepower.

Weapon Kills grant 10% Grenade Ability Energy, and using a Grenade Ability refills your weapon's magazine.
entries.officialDescription: Gain an additional grenade charge. Grenade final blows spawn an Orb of Power. Weapon final blows grant grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads your equipped weapon from reserves.

entries.title: Bolt Scavenger
entries.description:
Picking up a Crossbow Bolt grants ? Handling and ? Reload Speed for 4 seconds.

Picking up additional Bolts adds 3? seconds to the buff duration up to the maximum of 15 seconds.

🡅 Buff duration is increased.
entries.officialDescription: Recovering a bolt increases reload speed and handling for an improved duration.

entries.title: Hunter's Trace IV
entries.description:
Deals 100% increased damage against Champions at all times.

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.

Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal 1833 [PVP: 474] precision damage.

Hits with sniper rounds trigger a 322 [PVP: 20] damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust for 5 seconds in a 6 meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon fires special shield-piercing ammunition and is strong against 0 Barrier Champions. Precision hits grant targeting data. Alternate Weapon Action to swap to the alternate scope, loading high-damage rounds based on the amount of targeting data. High damage rounds create shockwaves around impacted targets, exhausting them.

entries.title: Hunter's Trace II
entries.description:
Deals 100% increased damage against Champions at all times.

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.

Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal 1833 [PVP: 474] precision damage.

Hits with sniper rounds trigger a 322 [PVP: 20] damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust for 5 seconds in a 6 meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon fires special shield-piercing ammunition and is strong against 0 Barrier Champions. Precision hits grant targeting data. Alternate Weapon Action to swap to the alternate scope, loading high-damage rounds based on the amount of targeting data. High damage rounds create shockwaves around impacted targets, exhausting them.

entries.title: Hunter's Trace III
entries.description:
Deals 100% increased damage against Champions at all times.

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.

Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal 1833 [PVP: 474] precision damage.

Hits with sniper rounds trigger a 322 [PVP: 20] damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust for 5 seconds in a 6 meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon fires special shield-piercing ammunition and is strong against 0 Barrier Champions. Precision hits grant targeting data. Alternate Weapon Action to swap to the alternate scope, loading high-damage rounds based on the amount of targeting data. High damage rounds create shockwaves around impacted targets, exhausting them.

entries.title: Rapid Cooldown
entries.description:
Class Ability usage grants 6.25% increased Sprint Speed for 10 seconds. Duration is not refreshable.

Sprinting grants the following benefits:
• 1 stack of 0 Frost Armor every 3 [PVP: 6] seconds
• 100% [PVP: 200%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate
• Doubled [PVP: 100% Additional] Base Grenade and Melee Ability Regeneration Rate

For as long as 1 Frost Armor is active, you are granted x3 [PVP: x1] Stasis Weapon Surge.

Multiplicative Ability Regeneration Rate increase in PVE is applied after all additive Ability Regeneration Rate modifiers.
entries.officialDescription:
Increases grenade, melee, and dodge regeneration while sprinting.

Gain stacks of Frost Armor while sprinting. When you have Frost Armor, Stasis weapons deal additional damage.

entries.title: Kinetic Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Kinetic Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid Kinetic weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Blessing of Order
entries.description:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Lumina and Noble Seekers grant Noble Rounds to it.

Standing in a Rift or 0 Well of Radiance creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies within 40 meters and apply buffs to them:
• Healing Rift Seeker: restores 70 Health, 60 Shields, and starts Health Regeneration
• Empowering Rift Seeker: grants 100 Class Stat and 35% [PVP: 15%] increased damage for 5 seconds (Empowering Buff)

Noble seekers spawn at a constant rate based on your Fireteam size.

Buffing allies with Noble Seekers grants ?|25%|?|?|? Class Ability energy based when your fireteam has 2|3|4|5|6 members.

Seekers prioritize allies who have not been healed in the last 8 seconds followed by nearby allies. Seekers will not target an ally more than once every 4 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Standing in a rift creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies and heal them. Standing in an empowering rift creates Noble Seekers that grant both you and your ally a damage bonus. When a Noble Seeker finds an ally, you gain class ability energy. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of the Hand Cannon Lumina.

entries.title: Discord
entries.description:
Grants the following for 🡅8 seconds upon readying the weapon within 5? seconds of scoring a Kill with a different weapon:
• 25% decreased ADS Animation Duration
• 25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness

Weapon Kills while Discord is active fully refill the Magazine of 0 Primary Weapons, and refund 1 Ammo for 1 Special and 2 Power Weapons. (Scoring multiple kills with a single shot/burst still only refunds 1 ammo.)

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1? second.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a longer duration. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

entries.title: Sneak Bow
entries.description:
Crouching grants the following benefits:
• Prevents Radar Ping when shooting
• ? Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 25% increased Hold Time

🡅 Grants an additional ? Stability and Reload Speed while crouched.
entries.officialDescription: Increases hold time and reload speed; prevents radar pings from shooting while crouched. Improves stability and reload.

entries.title: Puppeteer's Control
entries.description:
Improves 0 Drengr's Lash and grants 1 Woven Mail for 10 seconds upon 2 Suspending enemies.

When used with a Barricade:
3 Drengr's Lash creates 2 additional Lashes. Lashes gain stronger seeking capabilities, travel 16.7% (5 meters) farther, and 4 Suspend for 3 seconds longer (2 seconds for Minibosses).

When used with 5 Thruster:
Created 6 Strand Knot is launched towards nearby enemies with some tracking. Detonates and 7 Suspends nearby targets on contact.
entries.officialDescription: Improves Drengr's Lash and spawns additional projectiles. These projectiles track targets more aggressively, travel farther, and suspend stronger. Gain Woven Mail when you suspend a target.

entries.title: Telesto Catalyst
entries.description:
Increases the Magazine Size by 3 (4🠚7) and grants 40 Ammo Generation.

Triggering Harbinger's Pulse three times will cause Telesto to start smoking and short circuiting, granting access to 'Harbinger's Seethe'.

Hold [Reload] to slap your malfunctioning Telesto. On its next direct hit, it will spawn a Wormhole from the Telesto Dimmension, wildly spraying 22 Telesto Bolts over 2.25 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Increased ammo reserves.

entries.title: Fervid Coldsnap
entries.description:
Grants 0 Coldsnap Grenades an extra Ability Charge, better tracking, and travel 17.5% farther and faster.

Damaging an enemy with 1 Coldsnap Grenades grants Grenade Ability Energy.

Grenade Energy gains based on Enemy Rank:
• Enemy Players: 7%
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 22%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 34%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 50%

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Your Coldsnap grenades have an additional charge that recharges quicker on hits. The seeker spawned from Coldsnap grenades travels farther.

entries.title: Slice
entries.description:
Using your Class Ability (even while the weapon is stowed) grants you 'Slice' for 🡅9 seconds.

While 'Slice' is active, damaging non-0 Severed targets 1 Severs them, grants a stack of Slice, and refreshes the buff duration. (Hitting immune targets also triggers this.)

Reaching 5 stacks immediately removes the buff.

If the 2 Severing hit kills the target, the perk will not trigger and you will not gain a stack.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.
entries.officialDescription: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for an improved duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

entries.title: Fighting Lion Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 30 Reload Speed.

Firing this gun grants equipped 0 Kinetic and 1 Heavy ammo weapons the following benefits for 3 seconds:
• 100 Handling
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
entries.officialDescription: After this weapon fires, equipped Kinetic and Power weapons gain a brief period of increased handling and accuracy.

entries.title: Prospector Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 40 Blast Radius and 50 Reload Speed.

Increases Blast Radius by ?% and decreases Self-Damage by 40% while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.

Effect lingers for 3.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.
entries.officialDescription: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.

entries.title: Tome of Dawn
entries.description:
While a 0 Solar Super Ability is equipped:
• Grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness while airborne
• Aiming Down Sights while airborne grants 'Tome of Dawn'

Tome of Dawn lasts 2.8 seconds and holds you in place midair. Weapon Hits add ? seconds to its duration.

Tome of Dawn grants the following benefits:
• 15% Damage Resistance
• 25% Flinch Resistance
• Enemies are less accurate when targeting you
• Weapon Kills grant 1 Restoration x1 and refill the magazines of stowed weapons from reserves
entries.officialDescription: While you have a 2 Solar Super equipped, aiming weapons while you're midair suspends you there for a short time. While this effect is active, you are more resistant to incoming damage and combatants are less accurate. Weapon hits extend this effect's duration, and 3 Solar weapon final blows provide Restoration and reload your other weapons from reserves. Provides a large benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.

entries.title: Fusion Harness
entries.description:
Grants the following with 0 Fusion Grenades equipped:
• An extra Grenade Charge
• 100% Class Ability Energy on Fusion Grenade Kills
• Passive 20% Additional Base Grenade Ability Recharge Rate

While 1 Radiant, in an Empowering Rift, or in a 2 Well of Radiance:
• Weapon Kills grant 15% 3 Fusion Grenade energy
• Weapon Hits grant 5% 4 Fusion Grenade energy (0.4 second cooldown between activations)

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Fusion Grenades have an additional charge and recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy. Defeating targets with Fusion Grenades grant Rift energy.

entries.title: Resolute
entries.description:
Scoring 2 to 3 0 Arc Kills within 10 seconds of each grants 1 Stack of 1 Arc Weapon Surge for 11 [PVP: 6] seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks. 2 Arc Kills while at 4 Stacks refresh the buff's duration.

Grants a 75 HP Overshield upon casting the 3 Fists of Havoc Super that negates Precision Damage. As long as it does not get fully destroyed, the overshield regenerates over 7 seconds after not receiving damage for 5 seconds.

Scoring Kills with 4 Fists of Havoc refunds ?% Super Energy.

Once 5 Fists of Havoc ends, it grants 4 Stacks of 6 Arc Weapon Surge for 30 [PVP: 6] seconds.
entries.officialDescription: 7 Arc final blows grant an escalating damage bonus with Arc weapons. While using Fist of Havoc, activating your Super grants an overshield; final blows extend its duration. When it ends, gain a damage bonus to your Arc weapons.

entries.title: Cayde's Retribution
entries.description:
Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.

Precision Hits and collecting Orbs of Power charge up a Golden Gun. Precision Hits grant 16.67% progress, and Orbs of Power grant 8.34% progress. Progress persists through death, and Rally Flags fully charge this perk.

Hold [Reload] at full charge to cast 'Cayde's Retribution' for 3 shots. Cayde's Retribution lasts 16 seconds and deals 100% increased precision damage to Bosses.

Each Precision Hit with Cayde's Retribution grants 45%|90% increased damage for the 2nd|3rd shot.

Wearing Celestial Nighthawk transforms Cayde's Retribution into a single high-powered shot that deals ~43% more damage than 3 successive precision shots and causes enemies to explode if defeated.

Does not count as a super for related effects or buffs.
entries.officialDescription: Pick up Orbs of Power or land precision hits to charge this weapon's Super bar. Once full, Alternate Weapon Action to fire Golden Gun shots.

entries.title: Advanced Reflexes
entries.description:
Upon Aiming Down Sights or Guarding within 1 second of receiving damage:
• 5% Increased Damage
• 30 Mobility
• 40 Handling
• 35 Charge Rate (Swords) for 7.5 seconds.

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.
entries.officialDescription: Upon taking damage from a target, quickly guard or aim down sights with this weapon to gain bonus damage, handling, and charge rate for a short time.

entries.title: Concussive Dampener
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming AoE Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.
entries.officialDescription: Reduces incoming area-of-effect damage from combatants.

entries.title: Contending Cascade
entries.description:
Scoring kills within 4 seconds of another kill each grant a stack of Contending Cascade. Maximum of ? stacks. Kills from any source count.

Each stack of Contending Cascade grants increased Handling and Reload Speed.

Starting at 15 stacks, kills trigger an explosion matching this weapon's element.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon gains bonus handling and reload speed based on your longest chain of rapid final blows from any source. After achieving an impressive record, final blows with this weapon create an elemental damage explosion.

entries.title: Horizon Ironsights
entries.description: Iron Sights. Allows for peripheral vision while scoped in.
entries.officialDescription:
Sturdy iron sights.
• Increases range.
• Slightly increases handling speed.

entries.title: Personal Assistant
entries.description:
Hits apply 0 Jolt.

Aiming at a target for 0.5 seconds highlights them and reports their Health and Shield percentages, Distance, and Power Level into the scope.

Maximum Highlight Range of 150 Meters.
entries.officialDescription:
Aim at a target to view their health and other critical information in the scope.
Jolts targets when dealing damage. Strong against 1 Overload Champions.

entries.title: Target Acquired
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits while Personal Assistant is active:
• 18.35% increased damage
• 31.34% increased precision damage
• ? Aim Assist
• 50% decreased Flinch, Recoil, and Accuracy Cone Size

Buff lasts for 1 second after being off-target.
entries.officialDescription: When Personal Assistant is active, this weapon has better target acquisition and deals significantly more precision damage.

entries.title: Icarus Grip
entries.description: Passively grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness.
entries.officialDescription: Moderately increases airborne effectiveness.

entries.title: SUROS Legacy
entries.description:
Kills have a 25% chance to grant 20 HP and begin Health Regeneration.

Linearly grants 5% to 10% increased damage as the magazine decreases from 50% capacity.
entries.officialDescription: The bottom half of each magazine deals bonus damage and has a chance to return health on kill.

entries.title: Impulse Amplifier
entries.description:
Passively grants 🡅25 Reload Speed and 15% decreased Reload Animation Duration (20% for Rocket Launchers).

Passively increases Projectile Velocity based on Weapon Archetype:
• Rocket Launchers: 10%
• Support-Frame Auto Rifles: 15%
• Micro-Missile Frame Weapons: 25%

🡅 Reload Speed Bonus is increased by 5.
entries.officialDescription: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.

entries.title: Arc Resistance
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming 0 Arc Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.
entries.officialDescription: Reduces incoming Arc damage from combatants.

entries.title: Snapshot Sights
entries.description:
Passively decreases the ADS Animation Duration:
• 50% decrease on 0 Primary Weapons
• 20% decrease on 1 Special Weapons

🡅 Passively grants 5 Stability.
entries.officialDescription: Faster time to aim down sights. Stability is increased.

entries.title: Danger Zone
entries.description:
Increases Blast Radius by ?% and decreased Self-Damage while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.

Effect lingers for 3.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.

Grenade Launchers: 40% decreased Self-Damage

Rocket Launchers: 99.99% decreased Self-Damage and allows for rocket jumping

🡅 Passively grants 5 Blast Radius.
entries.officialDescription:
The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.
Base blast radius is also improved.

entries.title: Tear
entries.description:
Precision Kills 0 Sever enemies within ? meters of the target for ? seconds.

? second cooldown between activations.

🡅 Activation cooldown is decreased.
entries.officialDescription: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed. Cooldown between activations reduced.

entries.title: Ignition Trigger
entries.description:
Accuracy Cone Size and Accuracy Cone Growth are massively decreased while hip-firing. Hip-Firing grants 50% reduced recoil, which is carried into ADS if the trigger stays held down after initially hip-firing.

Firing 20 rounds within 0.125 seconds of each begins 'Ignition Trigger'. Ignition Trigger grants 100% [PVP: 50%] increased damage and 3% reduced Accuracy Cone Growth size while active. In exchange, it drains 15 HP every 0.4 seconds until you reach Critical Health.

While Ignition Trigger is active, firing builds its meter at a rate of 20% per second. Meter drains at a rate of 25% per second when not firing.

This meter serves as a timed period in which Ignition Trigger can be resumed without warmup and provides no other benefits. Meter progress persists through reload.
entries.officialDescription: Sustained fire with this weapon overheats it, increasing damage but burning the user.

entries.title: Wicked Implement Catalyst
entries.description:
0 Stasis Shards grant 7 ammo on pickup that can overfill the magazine, up to 100% capacity.

Due Tithing Harvest refilling the entire magazine on 1 Stasis Shard pickup, the overfill effect only activates if your current magazine is above 13 shots remaining.

Grants the Headstone trait:
Precision Kills create a Large 2 Stasis Crystal at the target's location.

Tier 1-2 Minor and Tier 1 Elite Combatants only spawn a Medium 3 Stasis Crystal.

Creating 5 4 Crystals within ? seconds prevents the perk from activating for 5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Collecting Stasis shards gradually overflows the magazine.

entries.title: Firepower
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power on Grenade Kills that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)

10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations.
entries.officialDescription: Your grenade final blows create Orbs of Power.

entries.title: Ager's Scepter Catalyst
entries.description:
While at full Super Energy, Hold [Reload] to activate Will Given Form.

Will Given Form immediately takes away 20% Super Energy, then drains at a rate of 4% Super Energy per second to grant the following benefits:
• Overfills the magazine from reserves to 192
• 80% increased damage
• 20 [PVP: 0] slow stacks per hit

Effect lasts until deactivated by holding [Reload] again, or until the magazine is emptied, super energy is drained, or the weapon is stowed.

Does not count as a super for related effects or buffs.
entries.officialDescription: Alternate Weapon Action : Drain Super energy, overflowing the magazine and empowering the beam with bonus damage and the ability to slow and freeze targets until the magazine or Super energy runs out, or the weapon is stowed. Can only be activated when Super energy is full.

entries.title: Gathering Light
entries.description:
Kills grant one stack of Gathering Light. Maximum of 10 stacks.

Hold [Reload] to consume all stacks, granting 10% Melee, Grenade, and Class Ability energy per stack.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription:
Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of Gathering Light.
Alternate Weapon Action : Consume stacks, granting melee, grenade, and class ability energy based on the number of stacks.

entries.title: Binary Orbit
entries.description:
Scoring opposing Elemental Alignment Kills grants 25% increased damage for 🡅10.5 seconds.

Buff can be activated while stowed.

Elemental Alignment details:
• 0 Arc, 1 Solar, 2 Void Kills buff Kinetic, 3 Stasis, and 4 Strand Weapons
• Kinetic, 5 Stasis, and 6 Strand Kills buff 7 Arc, 8 Solar, and 9 Void Weapons

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

entries.title: LN2 Burst
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] any time after scoring a kill to load a Freezing Shot. Animation is tied to reload speed.

Freezing Shot must charge for 533ms before firing.

Buff is removed on stow once the freezing shot is loaded.
entries.officialDescription: Alternate Weapon Action : Swap firing mode after a final blow to enable a charged shot.

entries.title: Tunnel Vision
entries.description:
Grants the following for 5 seconds upon finishing a Reload within 3.6 seconds of a Weapon Kill:
• 20 Aim Assist
• ? ADS Handling
• ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth

🡅 Buff Duration is increased.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for an improved duration.

entries.title: Loss
entries.description:
Reaching critical health or having an ally die within ? meters of you grants one stack of 'Loss'. Maximum of 10 stacks.

Loss grants the following benefits for each stack:
• ? Stability
• ? Handling
• ? Aim Assistance

Stacks remain active until you die.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and aim assist whenever your shields are broken or when a friendly Guardian is defeated. Effect lasts until you are defeated.

entries.title: The Perfect Fifth
entries.description:
Precision Hits refill 1 ammo.

Scoring 4 Precision Hits loads a delayed Solar Explosive. Solar Explosive is removed after 6 seconds.

Solar Explosive detonates after a 0.5? second delay, dealing 215 [PVP: 78] damage and applying 0 40 Scorch stacks (60 with 1 Ember of Ashes) in a 4 meter radius. Damage falls to 0% at the edge of the radius.
entries.officialDescription: Precision hits return ammo to the mag. Landing 4 precision hits loads a delayed Solar explosive round that scorches targets for your next shot.

entries.title: Disaster Plan
entries.description: Firing/Swinging the weapon after collecting an Ammo Brick grants 15 Range and 15% Flinch Resistance for 1.5 seconds. Swords receive 100 Charge Rate instead.
entries.officialDescription:
Picking up ammunition increases this weapon's flinch resistance and range, which lasts until it is fired again.

Swords gain a large increase to charge rate instead.

entries.title: Cornered
entries.description:
Grants 15% decreased Charge/Draw Time while within 15 meters of 2 enemies.

Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.

🡅 Grants 10 Stability while the perk is active.
entries.officialDescription: Faster charge time or draw time and increased stability when surrounded by combatants.

entries.title: Stopping Power
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits against low (under 🡅33%) Health targets. Ignores Shield HP:

• Increased Stagger Force
• 7% to 15% increased damage, scaling with remaining Health
• ? Increased Target Acquisition

🡅 Benefits activate at a higher remaining health percentage.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon's Kinetic ordinance can more easily stagger combatants, and grant increased target acquisition and damage against low-health targets within an improved range.

entries.title: Sharpshooter
entries.description:
Possesses inherently increased weapon stats, which are boosted further during Cayde's Retribution.

Increased benefits while Cayde's Retribution is active:
• 18% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 60% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• ? Aim Assist, ?% decreased ADS Animation Duration, ?% Flinch Resistance
entries.officialDescription: This weapon gains passive bonuses to target acquisition, aim down sight speed, and flinch resistance. The bonus increases when this weapon's super mode is active.

entries.title: Kill Clip
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a kill grants 25% increased damage for 🡅5.5 seconds.

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading after defeating a target grants increased damage for an improved duration.

entries.title: Blast Distributor
entries.description:
Dealing Explosive Weapon damage grants a stack of 'Blast Distributor' for 5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

'Blast Distributor' grants 🡅13 Grenade Stat per stack.

🡅 Grants 3 more Grenade Stat per stack.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing splash damage grants an improved bonus to Grenade stat.

entries.title: Latent Power
entries.description:
Direct Hits, Precision Hits, and Kills with this weapon charge 'Latent Power'. The amount of charge granted varies by source:
• Hits: 4%
• Precision Hits: 8%
• Kills: 25%

Upon reaching 100% Progress towards Latent Power, hold [Reload] to enter 'Unleashed Power' and gain the following benefits for 13 seconds:
• Instantly refill the magazine
• Increase RPM to 225
• Significantly improved Hip-Fire Accuracy
• ? Stability and ? Aim Assist
• Shots fired are immediately returned to the magazine, effectively granting infinite ammo

Every shot fired in this mode also 0 Weakens targets for 6 seconds on hit and gain Explosive Payloads that deal an additional 87 [PVP: ?] damage on hit.

After 3 seconds, Unleashed Power changes into Overwhelming Power, which drains 13 HP every second for the remaining 10 seconds of the buff.

Special Note: While Empowerment is active and this weapon is readied, Rocket Launchers and Micro-Missile damage is increased by 30%. Hazardous Propulsion Rockets deal 200% increased damage.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing damage builds Latent Power; precision hits and final blows build more. At full power, hold Alternate Weapon Action to trigger Unleashed Power, empowering the weapon with increased rate of fire and hip-fire accuracy and causing shots to weaken targets. After a short time, it becomes Overwhelming Power, which deals damage to you over time. Reload or stow the weapon to end these effects.

entries.title: High-Impact Frame
entries.description: Slow-firing and high-damage. This weapon is more accurate when stationary and aiming down sights.
entries.officialDescription: Slow firing and high damage. This weapon is more accurate when stationary, moving slowly, and aiming down sights.

entries.title: Unflinching Solar Aim
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights with 0 Solar Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.
entries.officialDescription: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a Solar weapon.

entries.title: Cryosthesia 77K Catalyst
entries.description: 0 Shattering a 1 Frozen enemy instantly refills the magazine.
entries.officialDescription: Shattering a frozen target refills this weapon's magazine from reserves.

entries.title: Banned Weapon
entries.description:
Fires a 3-round burs-...

[This tooltip has been redacted in accordance with Official Vanguard Policy]
entries.officialDescription: This weapon fires a 3-round burst.

entries.title: Cold Fusion
entries.description:
Linearly grants up to 80% increased damage as the beam is charged to 100% power.

Beam Energy is generated in two ways:
• Dealing damage grants 40% energy over 1 second. Initially has a 0.267 second delay before this starts granting energy.
• Collecting an 0 Ionic Trace grants 50% energy over 0.5 seconds

Not generating energy for 1.05 seconds rapidly cools the weapon down to 0% over 0.2 seconds.

Reaching maximum energy grants 100 Stability and 100 Reload Speed.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon shoots a steady cold-fusion-powered Arc laser, dealing more damage the longer it remains on a target.

entries.title: Hands-On
entries.description:
Melee Kills grant additional Super energy based on Enemy Rank with 1|2|3 mods:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: ?% | ?% | ?%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 1.33?% | ?% | ?%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?% | ?% | ?%
• T4 Minors, T3-T4 Elites, and higher: 5?% | ?% | ?%
• Players: ?% | ?% | ?%

Kill can only trigger either Hands On or Ashes to Assets but not both.
entries.officialDescription: Gain bonus Super energy on melee kills.

entries.title: Orbs of Restoration
entries.description:
Grants 10%|13%|15% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability on Orb of Power pickups.

Abilities with multiple charges do not receive any energy if they already have a full charge.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a small amount of energy to your ability with the least energy.

entries.title: Heirloom Catalyst
entries.description:
0 Scorch and 1 Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 5% increased damage.

Direct Hits with Charged Shots apply 2 20|40|60 Scorch Stacks at Charge Level 1|2|3. Scorch application is unaffected by 3 Ember of Ashes.

Grants 10% increased damage to 4 Scorched enemies.

Weapon Kills trigger a 5 Solar explosion that applies 30 6 Scorch Stacks (40 with 7 Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more 8 Scorch Stacks.

9 Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.
entries.officialDescription: Direct hits with charged shots scorch the target. This weapon deals more damage against scorched targets.

entries.title: Utility Kickstart
entries.description:
When a Class Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Class Ability Energy.

Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Class Ability Energy refunds.

Class Ability Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%
entries.officialDescription: When your class ability energy is fully expended, your Armor Charge is consumed and you gain class ability energy for each Armor Charge used.

entries.title: Full Choke
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights:
• Decreases Shotgun Pellet Spread by 5%
• Reduces Precision Multiplier by 7.6% (1.1078x🠚1.0294x)
entries.officialDescription: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

entries.title: Adaptive Munitions
entries.description:
Hits against Barrier Champion or non-matching Elemental Shields deal increasingly higher damage.

Buff is removed upon hitting a matching shield or an unshielded enemy.

Damage increase by Weapon Archetype:
• Fusion Rifles: untested
• Machine Guns, Auto/Pulse/Trace Rifles: 🡅14% per hit, up to 🡅70%
• Linear Fusion Rifles: 🡅30.8% per hit, up to 🡅61.6%
• Bows, Glaives, Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 🡅35% per hit, up to 🡅70%

🡅 The damage buff is increased by ~40%.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon adapts its damage output to be more effective against energy shields that don't match its damage type. Improves damage increase.

entries.title: Wild Card
entries.description:
Kills release a varying number of Submunitions on top of where the enemy died. 6? second cooldown between activations.

The number of Submunitions spawned is tied to Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 1 Submunition
• Elites and Players: 3 Submunitions
• Minibosses and Bosses: 7 Submunitions

Submunitions:
• Identical to Telesto Bolts in behavior, exploding on proximity or contact and last up to 10.5 seconds after attaching to a surface.
• Deal up to 39.5? [PVP: ?] damage and inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

entries.title: MIDA Synergy
entries.description: Superb handling. Move faster with this lightweight weapon equipped. This weapon grants additional speed benefits when MIDA Multi-Tool is also equipped.
entries.officialDescription: Superb handling. Move faster with this weapon equipped. When MIDA Multi-Tool is equipped, this weapon grants additional speed benefits and final blows grant modification progress to MIDA Multi-Tool.

entries.title: Pyrogenesis
entries.description: Charged Laser applies 0 20 Scorch (30 with 1 Ember of Ashes) for every hit and triggers an 2 Ignition on every kill.
entries.officialDescription: Solar laser scorches targets hit and ignites them when defeated.

entries.title: The Queenbreaker Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants the Rewind Rounds trait:
Upon emptying the Magazine:
Refills 60% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.

Hits are counted from either your last reload or the last time the perk was triggered. Does not require Direct Hits.

Requires firing 28.75% of the Magazine Capacity for the refill to activate.

Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.

Hits after triggering a refill do not count while the Rewind Rounds buff is active (1? second).

Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifle behavior:
• Each individual bolt in the burst counts as a Hit
• Refill amount is uniquely 14% of the number of Hits rounded up (numbers are subject to change once we get more data points)
entries.officialDescription: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

entries.title: Cranial Spike III
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Cranial Spike' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Cranial Spike's benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 3.5%|7%|10%|14%|17% increased damage against Combatants
• 1|2|3|4|5 Rounds added each reload
• 8|16|24|32|40 Range
• 2|4|6|8|10 Stability
• 4|8|12|16|20 Aim Assist
• 3%|6%|9%|11%|14% decreased Reload Animation Duration
entries.officialDescription: Chaining precision hits grants bonus target acquisition, range, rounds reloaded, and damage against combatants.

entries.title: Cranial Spike II
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Cranial Spike' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Cranial Spike's benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 3.5%|7%|10%|14%|17% increased damage against Combatants
• 1|2|3|4|5 Rounds added each reload
• 8|16|24|32|40 Range
• 2|4|6|8|10 Stability
• 4|8|12|16|20 Aim Assist
• 3%|6%|9%|11%|14% decreased Reload Animation Duration
entries.officialDescription: Chaining precision hits grants bonus target acquisition, range, rounds reloaded, and damage against combatants.

entries.title: Cranial Spike IV
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Cranial Spike' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Cranial Spike's benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 3.5%|7%|10%|14%|17% increased damage against Combatants
• 1|2|3|4|5 Rounds added each reload
• 8|16|24|32|40 Range
• 2|4|6|8|10 Stability
• 4|8|12|16|20 Aim Assist
• 3%|6%|9%|11%|14% decreased Reload Animation Duration
entries.officialDescription: Chaining precision hits grants bonus target acquisition, range, rounds reloaded, and damage against combatants.

entries.title: Honed Edge
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to consume up to 4 ammo. Gain one stack of 'Honed Edge' per ammo consumed to create a single shot with increased damage.

Damage increase based on stacks of Honed Edge:
Honed Edge x2:
• 12% [PVP: 20%] bodyshot damage
• 79% [PVP: 91%] critical damage
Honed Edge x3:
• 25% [PVP: 45%] bodyshot damage
• 131% [PVP: 167%] critical damage
Honed Edge x4:
• 112% [PVP: 165%] bodyshot damage
• 291% [PVP: 389%] critical damage
entries.officialDescription: Alternate Weapon Action : Consume the magazine and load a round with additional range and damage.

entries.title: Solar Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a 0 Solar Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid Solar weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Embers of Light
entries.description:
Requires a 0 Solar Super to be equipped to function.

Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 18%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 26%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 40%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites: 60%
• T4 Elites, Minibosses: 80%
• Bosses: 100%
• Players: 30%

Weapon Kills while standing in a Healing Rift grant 7 seconds (10 with 1 Ember of Solace) of 2 Radiant to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.

Weapon Kills while standing in an Empowering Rift grant 3 Cure x1 to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.

4 Daybreak Kills grant 5 Cure x2 and 10 seconds (15 with 6 Ember of Solace) of 7 Radiant to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: While a Solar Super is equipped, weapon final blows grant class ability energy. Defeating targets with your weapon while standing in a healing rift creates a pulse that grants Radiant to you and nearby allies; an empowering rift instead grants Cure to you and nearby allies. Daybreak final blows grant both effects.

entries.title: Exhumation
entries.description:
While grounded, Charged Heavy Attacks grant 0 Void Invisibility for 6.3 seconds and release four tracking orbs 8? meters ahead of you. Each orb deals 507 [PVP: 363] damage in a ? meter radius with no falloff.

Void Orbs deal 30% increased damage to Minor combatants.
entries.officialDescription: Heavy attacks made with full Sword energy turn you invisible and fire exploding Void projectiles.

entries.title: Harmonic Ammo Generation
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Weapons matching your Super Element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).
entries.officialDescription: Increases the ammo generation of Arc weapons.

entries.title: Paracausal Pellets
entries.description: Landing 10 out of 12 pellets instantly 0 Freezes or 1 Ignites the target, matching on the element of the shot.
entries.officialDescription: Landing nearly all Stasis pellets will freeze targets; landing nearly all Solar pellets will ignite targets.

entries.title: Unflinching Stasis Aim
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights with 0 Stasis Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.
entries.officialDescription: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a Stasis weapon.

entries.title: Arc Loader
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Arc Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier
entries.officialDescription: Increases reload speed of Arc weapons.

entries.title: Utility Finisher
entries.description:
Finisher consume 3 or more Stacks of Armor Charge and grant Class Ability Energy.

Energy Gains with 3|4|5|6 Stacks Consumed:
70% | 80% | 90% | 100%

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription:
Finishers restore class abilities.

Consumes 3 or more stacks of Armor Charge, granting additional energy for each charge consumed.

entries.title: Threat Remover
entries.description:
Hitting a target with 🡅10 of the 12 Pellets in the spread grants ? Stability, ? Handling, and 60 Reload Speed for 7 seconds.

🡅 Requires hitting with 1? fewer Pellet to activate.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing damage with nearly all pellets in a spread increases reload speed, handling, and stability.

entries.title: Unyielding Handle
entries.description: Grants 15% Damage Resistance for 5 seconds upon scoring 2 Light Attacks within 3 seconds of each. Buff can be refreshed.
entries.officialDescription: Traditional guarding is disabled in favor of offensive capabilities. Gain damage resistance from being in combat for a short duration.

entries.title: Super Font
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Super stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.
entries.officialDescription: You gain a bonus to your Super stat while you have any Armor Charge. Armor Charges decay over time.

entries.title: Enhanced Athletics
entries.description:
Passively increases non-sprinting Movement Speed and non-ability Jump Height.

Grants 30|50|60 Mobility Stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Mobility as a stat is capped at 130. Warlocks and Titans inherently have 30 mobility, while Hunters have 100 [PVP: 70].

Forward (including left and right diagonally) Walk Speed with 0|1|2|3 Mods equipped by class:
• Warlocks and Titans: 5.6|6.2|6.6|6.8 m/s
• Hunters (PvP): 6.4|7|7.6|7.6 m/s
• Hunters (PvE): 7|7.6|7.6|7.6 m/s

Strafing (side-to-side and backwards movement) decreases these speeds by 15%. Strafe speed is capped at 6 m/s.

ADS decreases these speeds by 25% and cannot exceed 6 m/s. Sidearms uniquely only suffer a 15% penalty.

Crouching decreases these speeds by 45%. Crouch speed is capped at 4 m/s.

Holding a Machine Gun, Rocket Launcher, Guarding with a Sword, and certain Exotic Heavy Weapons have an additional 15% movement speed penalty.

Sprint speed is set to 8 m/s by default and is capped at 9 m/s. This cap applies to regular Forward Walk Speed as well.
entries.officialDescription: Increases your base movement speed and jump height.

entries.title: Withering Gaze
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights (ADS) for 🡅1.4 seconds without firing and staying ADS causes your next shot to apply 0 Weaken on a Direct Hit.

Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed.

🡅 Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Aiming this weapon for a shorter period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

entries.title: Edge of Action Catalyst
entries.description: Kills against 0 Void Debuffed enemies grant a 45 HP 1 Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with 2 Echo of Persistence).
entries.officialDescription: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

entries.title: Beacon Rounds
entries.description:
Kills with the weapon grant a Stack of Beacon Rounds for 🡅7 seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks.

Scoring futher Hits with the weapon can extend the buff duration up to the maximum of 4 seconds. Buff can be activated while stowed.

Each Stack grants increased projectile tracking. Projectile Tracking is only in effect while the Targeted Reticle is active.

Grants the following while you have active Stacks:
• 15 Reload Speed
• 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 45% increased Projectile Tracking Cone size

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1? second.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant your projectiles tracking and increase reload speed for an improved duration. Dealing further damage extends the duration.

entries.title: Melee Kickstart
entries.description:
When a Melee Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Melee Ability Energy.

Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Melee Energy refunds.

Melee Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%

Bug: Doesn't work if you have more recharged Melee Ability Energy than a single ability charge.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: When your melee energy is fully expended, your Armor Charge is consumed and you gain melee energy for each Armor Charge used.

entries.title: Seraph Rounds
entries.description: Combines the overpenetration from Armor-Piercing Rounds, the guaranteed ricochets from Ricochet Rounds, and the flinch increase from High-Caliber Rounds.
entries.officialDescription:
Rounds overpenetrate targets and bounce off hard surfaces.
• Slightly increases range
• Increases stability

entries.title: Planetary Torrent
entries.description:
Increases Class Ability Regeneration Rate while 3 enemies are within 15 meters:
250%|666%|1085%|1500% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate with 3|4|5|6+ enemies

1 second after casting a Rift:
The Rift releases an 0 Arc Shockwave that deals 400 [PVP: 100] damage and knocks back enemies in a 7.5 meter radius. Additional 1 Arc Shockwaves are released every 5 seconds.

Enemies killed by Shockwaves explode, dealing up to 200 [PVP: 100?] 2 Arc damage.

While you have an 3 Arc Super equipped, Shockwaves and explosions 4 Blind nearby targets.
entries.officialDescription: Rifts periodically release Arc shockwaves. Final blows with these shockwaves create an Arc explosion. While an Arc Super is equipped, the shockwaves and subsequent explosions blind nearby targets. Rift energy recharges faster when you are surrounded by targets.

entries.title: Counterattack
entries.description:
Upon receiving damage within 0.5 seconds of starting to Guard:
Grants 50% increased damage for 🡅3 seconds.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.
entries.officialDescription: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for an improved duration.

entries.title: Cobra Totemic
entries.description: Passively grants 10 Airborne Effectiveness, 35 Reload Speed, and 35 Handling to all weapons.
entries.officialDescription: Improves melee range as well as ready speed and reload for weapons. Provides a small benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.

entries.title: Stylostixis
entries.description:
Grants 0 Arcane Needles 1 Shield-Piercing properties.

Scoring an 2 Arcane Needle hit on an enemy marks them with a vertical mark for 10 seconds. Marked Enemies explode on death, releasing a 3 Suspending Blast that 4 Suspends and damages targets in a 10 meter radius.

5 Suspending Blast damage by Enemy Rank:
Players: 40, Minors: 80, Elites: 120, Minibosses: 160, Bosses: 200

Landing 2 6 Arcane Needle hits on a Marked Enemy triggers 7 Suspending Blast that deals 2x damage.

Landing 5 8 Needlestorm Hits on a single enemy triggers a 9 Suspending Blast that deals 11x damage and inherits Super damage buffs.

10 Arcane Needle Kills and Killing 11 Suspended targets grant Melee Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 15%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 22.2%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites, Enemy Players: 33%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 100%

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Targets damaged by Arcane Needle emit a suspending detonation when defeated. Landing multiple Arcane Needles or Needlestorm on the same target immediately triggers a larger, more powerful detonation. Defeating suspended targets grants melee energy. Your Arcane Needles are strong against 12 Barrier Champions.

entries.title: Merciless Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 40 Range and 40 Stability.

Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a Kill grants 0 Cure x2 to you and 1 Cure x1 to allies within 15 meters.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

entries.title: Biotic Enhancements
entries.description:
Being within 15 meters of 3+ enemies grants the 'Biotic Enhancements' buff for 5 seconds.

Biotic Enhancements benefits:
• 35 Handling and 35 Reload Speed
• 50% increased Super damage
• 165% [PVP: 100%] increased Melee damage
• 100% increased Glaive Melee damage
entries.officialDescription: When you're surrounded, gain increased melee and Super damage, as well as improved weapon handling and reload speed.

entries.title: Fury Conductors
entries.description:
Melee Hits grant 1 Stack of Armor Charge. (Each damage instance is counted separately)

Having active Armor Charges grants Melee Damage Resistance against Combatants. Receiving a Melee Attack consumes all Armor Charges and emits a 0 Jolting 1 Arc Burst in a ? meter radius.

Benefits with 1|2|…|6 Armor Charges:
• 2 Arc Burst Damage: 90|130|170|200|225|245
• Melee Damage Resistance against Combatants: 23.3% | 46.7% | 70% | 73.3% | 76.7% | 80%
entries.officialDescription: Melee hits grant Armor Charge, and you take less melee damage from combatants while you have Armor Charge. Taking melee damage causes you to emit a burst of damaging Arc energy that jolts targets, consuming your Armor Charge and dealing more damage based on the number of stacks consumed.

entries.title: Horns of Doom
entries.description:
Scoring 2 to 3 0 Void Kills within 10 seconds of each grants 1 Stack of 1 Void Weapon Surge for 11 [PVP: 6] seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks. 2 Void Kills while at 4 Stacks refresh the buff's duration.

Elemental 3 Void Melee Kills grant the following:
• 20% [PVP: 10%] Super Energy once per ability usage
• All 4 Stacks of 4 Void Weapon Surge

5 Sentinel Shield's Shield Throw Hits grant 10% Super Energy, extending the Super's Duration. 6 Sentinel Shield Light Attacks grant 100% Shield Throw energy.
entries.officialDescription:
Defeating targets with Void damage has a chance to grant an escalating bonus to damage with Void weapons. Defeating targets with Void melee grants Super energy.

While Sentinel Shield is active, defeating targets with melee attacks recharges Shield Throw, which extends your Super on hitting a target.

entries.title: Cursed Thrall
entries.description:
After a Melee Kill, for 7.5 seconds:
Weapon Kills cause the enemy to explode, dealing up to 123.5 [PVP: ?] damage over a 4.5? meter radius.

Explosions inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling and match the element of the Weapon.
entries.officialDescription: After defeating a target with a melee attack, final blows with this weapon cause targets to explode for a short duration.

entries.title: Swashbuckler
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Swashbuckler' for 🡅6.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

(Glaive) Melee Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly.

Damage increase at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
6.7% | 13.3% | 20% | 26.6% | 33.3%

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 2 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon gains increased damage for an improved duration from melee final blows and defeating targets with this weapon.

entries.title: Cauterizing Flame
entries.description:
Only works with a 0 Solar Super Ability equipped.

Reaching Critical Health consumes your Class Ability to spawn a 1 Sunspot under you.

Manually casting your Class Ability also spawns a 2 Sunspot under you.

The spawned 3 Sunspot grants the Sol Invictus buff even without having the Aspect equipped. (The Aspect is still required to extend the sunspot's duration)
entries.officialDescription: While you have a Solar Super equipped, casting your Barricade or becoming critically wounded with full class ability energy creates a Sunspot at your location.

entries.title: Imperial Allegiance
entries.description:
Grants one stack of Imperial Allegiance for each ally within 15 meters.

Benefits at 1|2|3 stacks:
• ? Charge Rate
• 3.5%|7%|10.5% increased Cooling Efficiency
• 3.5%|7%|10.5% increased damage while above 50% Weapon Heat
entries.officialDescription: Being near allies grants increased cooling or charge rate, and increased damage while at high heat or low guard energy.

entries.title: Deconstruct
entries.description:
Upon scoring multiple hits within 6 seconds of each:
• Refills 10% of the Magazine (rounded up) from reserves. Can be reactivated without a cooldown. Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.
• Grants 40% increased damage against Constructs and Vehicles for 5 seconds. Additional hits refresh the buff duration.

Number of Hits Required:
• If Magazine Size is 1: 3 Hits
• Otherwise: 2 + 50% (25% on 0 Primary Weapons) of Base Magazine Capacity rounded down

Hits against Constructs and Vehicles provide 1.5x activation progress for 1 Primary weapons and 2x progress for 2 Special weapons.

Wave Frame Grenade Launchers:
• Direct Impacts count as 2 Hits
• Doesn't receive bonus activation progress against Constructs and Vehicles
entries.officialDescription:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs for an improved duration and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.
