• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 7.14%
• Auto Rifles, Machine Guns: 8.33%
• Pulse Rifles: 9.1%
• Sidearms: 12.5%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 16.7%
• Swords: 20%
• Bows, Glaives, Grenade Launchers, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles: 34%

Additional hits provide no activation progress for 2 seconds after a Healing Pulse is triggered. 5 second cooldown between healing pulse activations. (why are these separate)

Super Abilities generate an extra Orb of Power that grants 7.14% Super Energy (regular Super Orb).

Specific Interactions:
• Roaming Supers generate an Orb with the first Kill instead of needing at least 2 Kills
• 1 Ward of Dawn generates 4 Orbs with each granting 3.57% Super Energy (up from 3 Orbs granting 2.3% each for a ~2x increase)
entries.officialDescription: Generates an additional Orb of Power from Supers. Generating a Barricade, or dealing sustained damage or defeating targets from behind one creates a healing pulse. Healing your allies grants Barricade energy.

entries.title: Auto-Loading Link
entries.description:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Auto Rifles and Machine Guns.

Refills 10% of readied Auto Rifles' and Machine Guns' magazines (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds.

Scoring Auto Rifle or Machine Gun kills grants stacks of Auto-Loading Link. Maximum of 10 stacks. Stacks expire one at a time.

Auto-Loading Link grants 1.5% increased damage, ? Stability, and 5 Ammo Generation per stack.

The 1st stack lasts 7 seconds, with each subsequent stack having a 0.5 second shorter duration. The 10th stack lasts 2.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Auto Rifle or Machine Gun's magazine from reserves. Final blows with Auto Rifles or Machine Guns boost their stability, ammo generation, and damage. Provides a moderate benefit to their airborne effectiveness.

entries.title: Void Ammo Generation
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to 0 Void Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).
entries.officialDescription: Increases the ammo generation of Void weapons.

entries.title: Roar of Battle
entries.description:
Exchanging damage at most every 0.65 seconds for at least 2 seconds grants 'Roar of Battle' for 6 seconds.

'Roar of Battle' grants 10? Stability and 10? Handling.
entries.officialDescription: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

entries.title: Harmonic Dexterity
entries.description:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Weapons matching your Super Element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.
entries.officialDescription: Faster ready and stow speed for Arc weapons.

entries.title: Worm Byproduct
entries.description:
Taking self-damage from the explosion grants 'Worm Byproduct', increasing other weapon's damage by 15%.

This damage buff stacks with all other Empowering buffs.
entries.officialDescription: Taking damage from your own worm projectile detonation empowers your weapons for a short time.

entries.title: Disruption Break
entries.description:
On Elemental, Barrier or Guardian Shield Break:
Applies Kinetic Damage Vulnerability to the enemy, increasing Kinetic damage taken by 50% for 5.5 [PVP: 5] seconds.

Stacks with all other Buffs and Debuffs (including itself).

🡅 Debuff duration is increased in PVE.
entries.officialDescription: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for an improved duration.

entries.title: Prometheus Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 20 Stability and 20 Handling.

Grants the Incandescent trait:
Weapon Kills trigger a 0 Solar explosion that applies 30 1 Scorch Stacks (40 with 2 Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more 3 Scorch Stacks.

4 Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.
entries.officialDescription:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

entries.title: En Garde
entries.description:
Readying the Sword grants 30% increased damage for 🡅2 seconds.

2? second cooldown after the buff expires.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5? seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Quick attacks immediately after swapping to this Sword do additional damage for an improved duration.

entries.title: Death at First Glance
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights, deal 32.5% increased damage for as long as you land Precision Hits or damage a Combatant Shield.

Buff reactivates after 3 seconds of not firing.
entries.officialDescription: Bonus damage when aiming down sights on the opening shot of an attack. This bonus is preserved if the shot deals precision damage or strikes an elemental shield.

entries.title: Liquid Coils
entries.description: Increases charge time by 40ms and damage by 2%.
entries.officialDescription:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
 • Increases impact damage
 • Slower charge time

entries.title: EM Anomaly
entries.description:
Precision Kills with this gun trigger a 0 Void Implosion that pulls enemies within a 9 [PVP: ?] meter radius and explodes for 341 [PVP: ?] damage.

For some 'large weight' enemies, they are pushed back instead.
entries.officialDescription: A precision final blow with this weapon creates an implosion that pulls in nearby targets and damages them with an additional detonation.

entries.title: Illegally Modded Holster
entries.description:
Passively grants the following benefits while a Hand Cannon is readied:
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance

Readying a Hand Cannon grants 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 6 seconds (for the PVE-only benefits of the perk, consider this the 0th Stack).

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants the following benefits to Hand Cannons:
• 100 Ready Speed Handling
• 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• PVE ONLY: Direct Hits grant a Stack of 'Illegally Modded Holster'. Maximum of 10 Stacks.

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants 45% increased Direct Impact damage per Stack, maxing out at 450%. Boss-Tier Enemies take 33% decreased damage from Lucky Pants shots.

• Uncivil Discourse only recieves 30% increased damage per stack.
• Sturm's Overcharged Rounds only receive 11% increased damage per Stack (110%).
• Hawkmoon's Paracausal Shot receives 5% increased damage per stack upon being fired (50%).
• Malfeasance's Explosive Shadow is unaffected by the buff.

While at 'Illegally Modded Holster x7' or higher:
Swapping to a non-Hand Cannon weapon or the buff expiring grants you the 'Out of Luck' debuff. 'Out of Luck' prevents you from reacquiring 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 10 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Improves sprint, slide, and airborne effectiveness while a Hand Cannon is equipped. For a short time after being drawn, Hand Cannons ready faster, are more accurate, and each hit against a combatant increases Hand Cannon damage.

entries.title: Uncanny Arrows
entries.description:
Deadfall returns Ability Energy per Enemy Tethered:
• X% Super Energy up to the maximum of 50%
• 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy

Moebius Quiver can fire an additional volley per Super Activation and lasts 4 additional seconds (16🠚20 Seconds)

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website. (Super Energy is unaffected)
entries.officialDescription: Provides ability energy for each target tethered by Deadfall anchors. Moebius Quiver has an additional shot.

entries.title: Hydraulic Boosters
entries.description:
Passively grants 30% Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants while Airborne.

Increases Sprint Speed by 6.25% and Slide Distance by 33%. Greatly increases the initial momentum of all Jump Abilities.
entries.officialDescription: Increases slide distance and improves High Jump, Strafe Jump, and Triple Jump. Take less damage from targets when airborne.

entries.title: Big-Game Hunter
entries.description: Bolts fire with significantly increased Stagger Force.
entries.officialDescription: Fires a massive heavy bolt that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against 0 Unstoppable Champions.

entries.title: Harmonic Loader
entries.description:
Grants the following to Weapons matching your Super Element ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier
entries.officialDescription: Increases reload speed of Arc weapons.

entries.title: Classy Contender
entries.description:
Kills grant 5% Class Ability Energy.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant class ability energy.

entries.title: Heavy Handed
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power on Elemental Melee Kills that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)

10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations.

Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.
entries.officialDescription: Your powered melee final blows create Orbs of Power.

entries.title: Adept Targeting
entries.description: Passively grants 7 Aim Assist.
entries.officialDescription: Greatly increases target acquisition.

entries.title: Delicate Tomb Catalyst
entries.description: Picking up 0 Ionic Traces refill 4 ammo from reserves.
entries.officialDescription: Collecting an Ionic Trace partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

entries.title: Voltshot
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within 5.3 seconds of a Weapon Kill grants Voltshot for 🡅8 seconds.

While Voltshot is active, your next Weapon Hit consumes the buff and applies 0 Jolt to the target.

Applied 1 Jolt's damage (generally) does not count as Weapon Damage.

🡅 Buff can be held 1 second longer.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for an improved short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

entries.title: Edge of Concurrence Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants the following after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon readied:
• 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• ? Handling
• 0.95x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier

Sprinting refreshes the buff duration.

Being 0 Amplified removes the sprinting requirement and increases the Reload Speed stat bonus to 60.
entries.officialDescription: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.

entries.title: Clenched Fist
entries.description:
Passively grants 100 Guard Resistance and Guard Endurance to Swords.

While Guarding:
• Grants 50% [PVP: 10%] Damage Resistance (Stacks multiplicatively with the Damage Resistance provided by Sword Guard against blocked attacks)
• Blocking a hit grants 2 Stacks of Perfect Guard. Maximum of 100 Stacks. (Cannot gain stacks while you have the 0 Restoration buff)
• 1 Heavy Ammo Sword Energy does not decay from holding guard

All Stacks are removed if no hits have been blocked in the last 10 seconds.

Dealing Sword Damage with active Perfect Guard Stacks grants 2 Restoration x2:
4 [PVP: 3] second duration at 1 Stack, scaling up to 16 [PVP: 6] seconds at 100 Stacks. (3 Ember of Solace increases this by 50%, up to 24 [PVP: 9] seconds)
entries.officialDescription: Maximizes guard stats on equipped Heavy ammo Swords. You take reduced damage while blocking with a Sword. Rapidly damaging targets after blocking shots with a Sword grants Restoration for a duration determined by the number of shots blocked.

entries.title: SUROS Regime Catalyst
entries.description: Grants 50 Recoil Direction and doubles the healing chance (25%🠚50%).
entries.officialDescription: Increased chance for kills to regen health.

entries.title: Tilting at Windmills
entries.description:
Blocking damage with this weapon increases movement speed while Blocking by 25?% for 🡅5 seconds.

Buff is removed when you stop blocking or if Glaive/Sword Energy runs out.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1? second.
entries.officialDescription: Blocking damage with your shield increases movement speed for an improved duration while you are shielding.

entries.title: Zen Moment
entries.description:
Weapon Hits grant 1 Stack of the perk for 1 second up to the maximum of 5? Stacks.

Benefits granted per Stack:
• Grants ?% Flinch Resistance
• Reduces Visual Weapon Shake by 15%
• Reduces Reticle Bounce by 15%

Stacks gained per Weapon Hit by weapon type:
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 2?
• Pulse Rifles, Sidearms: 1.5
• Other Weapons: 1

🡅 Passively grants 5 Stability.
entries.officialDescription: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time. Improves base stability.

entries.title: Relentless Strikes
entries.description:
Scoring 3 Powered Hits within 2? seconds of each refunds 1 ammo.

Wolfpack Round Hits do not count.

🡅 Allowed time between Hits is increased.
entries.officialDescription: Light Attack : Landing three light-attack hits within an improved short time grants Sword ammo.

entries.title: Innervation
entries.description:
Grants 10%|13%|15% Grenade Ability Energy on Orb of Power Pickups with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Reduces grenade cooldown each time you pick up an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Golden Munitions
entries.description:
Generates 3 Ammo upon casting Cayde's Retribution. Wearing Celestial Nighthawk generates 1 ammo.

Ammo is added into reserves if the magazine is full.
entries.officialDescription: This magazine gains bonus ammo whenever a Golden Gun shot is acquired.

entries.title: Time Dilation
entries.description:
Extends Armor Charge decay time to 15|18|20 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Armor Charge decays at the rate of 1 Stack every 10 seconds by default with Passive Mods equipped.
entries.officialDescription: Your decaying Armor Charge has a longer duration.

entries.title: Rat King Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 20 Aim Assist and 20 Recoil Direction.

Finishing a reload within 6 seconds of a kill begins Health Regeneration.
entries.officialDescription: Improved aim assist and recoil direction. Refreshes health on Vermin invisibility trigger.

entries.title: Melee Damage Resistance
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming Damage from PVE Combatants less than 4 meters away by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.
entries.officialDescription: Reduces incoming damage from combatants that are at point-blank range.

entries.title: Enlightened Action
entries.description:
Weapon Hits grant Stacks of Enlightened Action for 2 seconds. Maximum of 12 Stacks.

Stat bonuses at 1|2|…|12 Stacks:
2|7|12|15|20|25|30|35|38|40|45|50 Handling and Reload Speed

Stacks granted per hit by Weapon Type:
• Hand Cannons: 3 Stacks
• Bows: ? Stacks
• Automatic Weapons: 1 Stack

🡅 Maximum Stat Bonus is increased by 5. (50🠚55, breakdown by Stacks currently unknown)
entries.officialDescription: Dealing damage significantly improves reload speed and handling.

entries.title: Close to Melee
entries.description:
Glaive Projectile Kills grant 60% [PVP: 30%] increased Glaive Melee damage for 🡅11 seconds.

Dealing Projectile or Melee damage extends the buff duration by 5 seconds, up to 🡅11 seconds.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.
entries.officialDescription: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage for an improved duration. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

entries.title: Crimson Catalyst
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Range.

Every 30 points of damage taken with the weapon readied grants a Stack of 'To the Pain'. Maximum of 10 Stacks. Stowing the weapon removes all Stacks.

Each Stack grants ? Handling and 2 Aim Assist, maxing out at ? Handling and 20 Aim Assist.

Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.
entries.officialDescription:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

entries.title: Explosive Shadow
entries.description:
Intrinsically 0 Anti-Unstoppable, but only Slug explosions stun 1 Unstoppable champions.

Hits embed Explosive Slugs into the target. Target death or embedding a fifth slug causes all slugs to explode, each dealing 203 [PVP: 45] damage in a 1? meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: Shoot tainted slugs that burrow into combatants. Stacking enough slugs causes them all to explode, stunning surviving combatants. Strong against 2 Unstoppable Champions.

entries.title: Judgment
entries.description:
Deals 50% less damage than Legendary Trace Rifles.

Dealing 10 [PVP: 5] hits within 0.15 seconds of each creates a 'Vex Cage' around the target for 1.25 seconds. At maximum rate of fire, this cage forms in 0.67 seconds.

Maintaining the cage does not require continuous fire.

Targets within a Vex Cage receive 15% increased damage from all sources (30% for Divinity). For sources that can deal precision damage, any damage dealt to a Vex Cage is treated as a Precision Hit.
entries.officialDescription: Sustained damage with this weapon envelops the target in a field that weakens and stuns them. Strong against 0 Overload Champions.

entries.title: Chaos Reshaped
entries.description:
Being in Combat for 🡅11.5 seconds grants a Stack of 'Chaos Reshaped' for 7 seconds. Maintaining the first Stack for 🡅11.5 seconds grants a second Stack. Buff can be activated while stowed.

For Chaos Reshaped, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 5 seconds.

Benefits at Chaos Reshaped x1 and x2:
• x1: grants 20% increased damage
• x2: grants 35% increased damage and grants a periodic burst of healing

🡅 Each Stack is gained 0.5 seconds sooner.

Healing effect is bugged!
While Chaos Reshaped x2 is active:
Stowing the weapon or keeping it readied for 7 seconds grants a continous healing effect of 5 HP per second.

Stowing this weapon grants the effect for 1 to 7 seconds (cycling, it's complicated), while keeping it readied after activation makes the healing effectively constant.

While this healing effect is active, NO OTHER SOURCE OF HEALING CAN RESTORE THE FINAL [~35 to 5] HP OF YOUR HEALTH BAR!

This unrecoverable HP segment can only be healed by Chaos Reshaped's 5/HPs effect.

For more details, visit the perk description in the Destiny Data Compendium.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time, activating faster. Remaining in combat for a slightly reduced duration rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

entries.title: Dichotomous Thinking
entries.description:
Deals 30% more damage than other High Impact Machine Guns.

Scoring hits with the gun grants 10% Healing Charge. (Unlike Support-Frame Auto Rifles, this is the only way to gain charge.)

Hip-fire to shoot Healing Rounds at 600 RPM that seek allies within the reticle. Healing Rounds restore 30 HP per hit and do not consume ammo, instead costing 2% Healing Charge each. Firing a healing round refills 2 rounds into the magazine from reserves.

Landing 6 healing rounds within 1 second of each spawns a 0 Threadling at the ally's location, and grants both you and them 'Support Frame Boost'. Support Frame Boost increases weapon damage by 10% for 6 seconds and stacks with everything.

Healing a Teeming Nest also grants you the Support Frame Boost.
entries.officialDescription: Hitting targets with this weapon builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them, does not expend ammo, and fills this weapon's magazine from reserves. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and spawns Threadlings from your allies.

entries.title: Subsistence
entries.description:
Weapon Kills refill 🡅20% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.

🡅 Refill amount is increased by an additive 10%. (3% on Submachine Guns and Auto Rifles)
entries.officialDescription: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.

entries.title: Slickdraw
entries.description:
Passively grants:
• 100 Handling
• 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 🡅15% decreased Auto Aim Cone Size (No effect on Magnetism AKA Reticle Stickiness)

🡅 Auto Aim Penalty is decreased by 25?% (20%⁠🠚⁠15%).
entries.officialDescription: Significantly increases handling, decreases target acquisition.

entries.title: Sturm Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 40 Handling and 20 Range.

Kills with Overcharged Rounds grants 2 stacks of 'Helping Hands'. Maximum of 6 stacks.

Helping Hands grants 50% decreased Stow/Ready Animation Speed while active. Readying Sturm or a Together Forevever weapon consumes one stack.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with bonus damage rounds build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow Sturm and Together Forever weapons at a massively increased rate.

entries.title: Sunshot Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 30 Range and 20 Stability.

Applying an Elemental Debuff grants the following benefits for 9 seconds:
• 50 Reload Speed and 20 Aim Assist
• 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

Buff can be activated while stowed.
entries.officialDescription: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.

entries.title: Ex Diris Catalyst
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 0 Amplified for 15 seconds.

While 1 Amplified, Direct Hits charge Enrage twice as fast (25%🠚50% per hit).
entries.officialDescription: Weapon enrages faster while amplified. Final blows with this weapon make you amplified.

entries.title: Assault Barricade
entries.description:
Replaces Towering Barricade with an Assault Barricade that allows the caster and their allies to shoot through it.

Assault Barricades take 60% increased damage from Enemy Players, effectively decreasing its HP from 500 to 312.5 in PvP.
entries.officialDescription: You and allies can shoot through your Towering Barricade. Your Towering Barricade takes increased damage from Guardians.

entries.title: Inverse Relationship
entries.description:
Hits grant ? Handling, ?% Flinch Resistance, and ?% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds. This effect stacks up to 6 times, and additional hits refresh the duration.

Gain increased damage as your Shield is depleted past 114|60|0 remaining HP.
• PvE: 10%|20%|40%
• PvP: 2%|4%|6%
entries.officialDescription:
When you deal damage with this weapon, it gains increased handling, takes reduced flinch, and movement speed is increased for a short time.

When you are at reduced health, this weapon deals additional damage.

entries.title: Arc Weapon Surge
entries.description:
Increases 0 Arc Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage

The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.
entries.officialDescription: Your Arc weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.

entries.title: Parting Gift
entries.description:
Class Ability usage drops a Parting Gift that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 440 [PVP: 121] damage over a 7.5 meter radius.

Parting Gift applies an additional effect based on the element of your equipped Super Ability:
• 0 Arc: 1 Blind for 10 [PVP: 3] seconds
• 2 Solar: 40 3 Scorch (60 with 4 Ember of Ashes)
• 5 Stasis: 40 [PVP: 20] 6 Slow Stacks for 4 [PVP: 1.5] seconds (8 [PVP: 2] seconds with Whisper of Durance)
• 7 Void: 8 Suppression for 10 seconds [PVP: Does not apply to Guardians in their Super]
• 9 Strand: 10 Sever for 10 [PVP: 5] seconds (15 [PVP: 7] with 11 Thread of Continuity)

Detonates instantly on contact with a surface or an enemy (for instant detonations, try the 4pc Dark Age Set Bonus from Warlord's Ruin).
entries.officialDescription:
Dodging leaves behind an explosive that detonates after a short delay, damaging targets around it and creating a secondary effect based on your Super's element:
• 12 Blinds targets.
• 13 Scorches targets.
• 14 Suppresses targets.
• 15 Slows targets.
• 16 Severs targets.

entries.title: Marksman Optics: High
entries.description:
Passively increases Zoom by 2.

Increasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Increased Magnification
• Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Decreased Absolute Recoil
• Narrowed Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)
entries.officialDescription: Slightly increases zoom magnification.

entries.title: Accelerated Assault
entries.description:
For single-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 1.2 seconds or at most 4 seconds between each other grants ? Reload Speed and 🡅6% [PVP: ?] increased damage for 8 seconds.

Additional hits while the buff duration is below 4 seconds refresh the timer to 4 seconds.

For multi-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 0.8 seconds or at most 1.2 seconds between each other refills 10% of the magazine and grants 🡅6% [PVP: ?] increased damage for 4 seconds.

🡅 Damage bonus is increased by 20% (5%🠚6%).
entries.officialDescription: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon further increases reload speed and Sword charge rate and increases damage.

alternateDescriptions.text:
For single-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 1.2 seconds or at most 4 seconds between each other grants ? Reload Speed and 5% [PVP: ?] increased damage for 8 seconds.

Additional hits while the buff duration is below 4 seconds refresh the timer to 4 seconds.

For multi-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 0.8 seconds or at most 1.2 seconds between each other refills 10% of the magazine and grants 5% [PVP: ?] increased damage for 4 seconds.

entries.title: Invigoration
entries.description:
Grants 10%|13%|15% Melee Ability Energy on Orb of Power Pickups with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Reduces melee cooldown each time you pick up an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Business Time
entries.description:
Holding down the trigger progressively grants up to 60% increased Rate of Fire and ? Range after 1.38 seconds.

As long as the trigger continues to be held, an explosive projectile is added every 18 shots, dealing 56 [PVP: 21] damage with no damage falloff.

Achieving maximum fire rate increases the frequency of these projectiles to once every 8 shots.
entries.officialDescription: Sustained fire boosts range and rate of fire.

entries.title: Blastwave Striders
entries.description:
Passively grants 75% Damage Resistance against explosive self-damage.

The following actions charge up Blastwave Striders:
• Minor PVE Combatant Kills: 10%
• Elite or higher tier PVE Combatant Kills: 25%
• Enemy Guardians: 20%
• Collecting Alethonym's Vestiges: 10%

While at 100% charge, deal damage with 0 Shiver Strike, 1 Howl of The Storm, or explosive self-damage to propel yourself backwards in an explosive jump, releasing 8 2 Stasis Shrapnel Projectiles and granting 5 3 Frost Armor Stacks. Each Projectile deals 623 [PVP: ?] damage and spawns a 4 Stasis Crystal on impact.

This explosive jump also releases an expanding ? meter radius 5 Stasis Wave that 6 Freezes enemies on contact [PVP: Slows for ? seconds].

Shrapnel Kills do not charge Blastwave Striders.
entries.officialDescription: Gain resistance to your explosives. Defeat targets to charge this armor. Once charged, land a Shiver Strike melee attack or deal explosive self-damage to rocket jump backward and release a blast wave with deadly shrapnel projectiles. The wave freezes combatants and slows Guardians. Charged rocket jumps grant Frost Armor.

entries.title: Mark of the Devourer
entries.description:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.

Shots fired overpenetrate unlimited targets.

Direct hits with this weapon apply Corruption (DoT Poison), dealing 30 [PVP: 0.4] damage every 0.5 seconds for 2 seconds. Multiple instances of Corruption can be stacked on the same target.

Kills create a Remnant which tracks towards you when within a 15 meter radius. Remnants last for 8 seconds in the world before despawning.
entries.officialDescription: Rounds pierce targets and inflict corruption. Final blows with this weapon leave behind Remnants.

entries.title: Hard Light Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 25 Stability.

While 0 Amplified, 1 Radiant, or 2 Devour is active:
• ? Handling
• ? Reload Speed
• ?% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• ?% decreased ADS Animation Duration
entries.officialDescription: This weapon gains reload speed, handling, and aim down sight speed when you are amplified, radiant, or have Devour.

entries.title: Hip-Fire Grip
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits while hipfiring:
• 25 Stability and 15 Aim Assist
• 2.7° larger Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 20% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 20% increased Damage Falloff Distance

The Damage Falloff increase does not apply to The Last Word, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles, and Fusion Rifles.

PvP-specific note: the Precision Aim Cone Angle increase essentially just allows you to hit Crits while aimed above or slightly to the side of the head. (This is already the default behavior of Submachine Guns, Sidearms, Bows, Machine Guns, and Linear Fusion Rifles so it does not affect them)

🡅 Stronger Effect.
entries.officialDescription: Greatly increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

entries.title: Bleak Domain
entries.description:
Enhances 0 Bleak Watcher:
• Targeting Range is increased to 50 meters
• Creates 4 outward-tilted Medium 1 Stasis Crystals around where it spawns (these respawn after 15 seconds)
• Releases a 2 Stasis Storm in a 3 meter radius

Standing in the 3 Stasis Storm grants a Stack of 'Icicle' every second. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

Shooting consumes a Stack of Icicle, releasing a 4 Stasis Projectile that deals 50 [PVP: ?] damage and applies 50 [PVP: 20] 5 Slow Stacks for ? seconds.

Icicle can fire every 0.2 seconds. Icicle Stacks expire if you leave the 6 Stasis Storm for more than 2 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Your Bleak Watcher turrets are enhanced with extended range and are surrounded by Stasis crystals and a storm. While standing in the storm, you are granted icicles over time. Icicles activate when you fire your weapons, applying Slow to targets they hit.

entries.title: Collective Purpose
entries.description:
Grants a stack of 'Collective Purpose' for each ally within 15 meters. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Collective Purpose grants the following benefits while at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 5?|10?|15?|20?|25? Range
• 5?|10?|15?|20?|25? Handling
• 0.975x?|0.95x?|0.925x?|0.9x?|0.875x? Draw Time Multiplier
• 5|10|15|20?|25? Charge Time Stat (For reference, 10 Charge Time stat is the benefit of a Charge Time Masterwork)
entries.officialDescription: Gain bonus range and handling when near allies. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate. The effect scales with the number of nearby allies.

entries.title: Arbalest Catalyst
entries.description:
Passively grants:
• 20 Handling
• Increases Magazine Size by one (5🠚6)

Refills magazine from reserves upon breaking a PVE Combatant, Barrier Champion, or Player Shield.
entries.officialDescription: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.

entries.title: Tension
entries.description: Passively grants 6 Draw Time Stat and 6 Accuracy.
entries.officialDescription: Grants increased draw time and accuracy.

entries.title: Adept Draw Time
entries.description: Passively decreases Draw Time by 40.
entries.officialDescription: +10 Draw Time

entries.title: Collective Pugilism
entries.description:
Collecting an Elemental Pickup enables Weapon Damage to generate Melee Ability energy per hit for 8 seconds.

0 Ionic Traces, 1 Stasis Shards, and Shot 2 Tangles extend the timer by 4 seconds. 3 Firesprites, 4 Void Breaches, and Thrown 5 Tangles extend the timer by 8 seconds.

Timer can be extended to a maximum of 16 seconds.

Melee energy granted by weapon type:
Spreadshot HC: 🡅0.55%
Burst Sidearm: 🡅0.86%
Fusion Rifle: 🡅1.27%
Rocket Pulse: 🡅2.15%
Sidearm: 🡅2.57%
Scout: 🡅3.67%
Rocket Launcher: 🡅14.19%

Elemental Pickups include 6 Firesprites, 7 Ionic Traces, 8 Stasis Shards, 9 Tangles, and 10 Void Breaches.

🡅 Melee Energy generated is increased by 10%.
entries.officialDescription:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include 11 Firesprites, 12 Void Breaches, 13 Ionic Traces, 14 Stasis Shards, and 15 Strand Tangles.

entries.title: Suspending Blast
entries.description:
Manually detonating at least 6 rounds that are embedded into a target 0 Suspends them for 6 seconds (8 with 1 Thread of Continuity).

Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.
entries.officialDescription: Detonating a large number of rounds embedded in a single target suspends them.

entries.title: Edge of Action
entries.description:
Glaive Melee Hits grant one stack of 'Charged Edge'. Projectile Hits grant two stacks. At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to generate 1 ammo from thin air and make the next shot fire a small protective 0 Void Dome.

Weapon Kills apply 1 Volatile to enemies in a 7 meter radius around the target and grant 2 Volatile Rounds for 3 seconds.

1.5 second cooldown between activations.

Only applies to Glaive Projectiles.
entries.officialDescription: Melee and projectile damage charge this weapon. When fully charged, Alternate Weapon Action to enable a special projectile attack. Projectile final blows create a volatile detonation and grant Volatile Rounds.

entries.title: Weapons Font
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Weapons stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.
entries.officialDescription: You gain a bonus to your weapons stat while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge decays over time.

entries.title: All at Once
entries.description:
Shots dissipate after 50 meters.

Holding down the trigger for 0.5 seconds begins loading a burst of 10 shots and marks enemies within 24 meters of you. Shots load over the course of 0.9 seconds.

Grants 30 Stability during the burst. Fully charged bursts apply 0 Unravel to marked targets.
entries.officialDescription: Holding down the trigger marks targets within range and loads multiple bullets, which fire in a burst with increased stability on trigger release. Hitting a marked target with a fully charged burst will unravel them.

entries.title: To Excess
entries.description: Weapon kills while your Super Ability is charged grant 20 Grenade stat and 20 Melee stat for 12 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon while your Super is full grant a bonus to melee and grenade stat for a moderate duration.

entries.title: Full Court
entries.description:
Starts linearly increasing Detonation and Burn (DoT) damage 0.2 seconds after the grenade projectile is fired.

Reaches maximum strength after 1.1 seconds at a 35% damage increase.

The damage increase is finalized at the point of detonation and any lingering effects left will not increase it further.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Blast Radius.
entries.officialDescription: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels farther before exploding. Increases blast radius.

entries.title: Exhaustive Research
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights at an enemy within 60 meters loads up a Micro-Rocket over 0.6 seconds.

Micro-Rocket replaces a regular bullet, firing a tracking missile that matched the weapon's element and deals up to ? Explosive Damage in a ? meter radius.

5.5 second cooldown before a new rocket can be loaded.
entries.officialDescription: Aiming down sights at a target for a short time loads a homing micro-missile.

entries.title: Demolitionist
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 🡅11% Grenade Ability Energy.

Kills with Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaives, and Fusion Rifles grant 🡅22%.

Using your Grenade Ability refills the Magazine with a 3 second cooldown.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

🡅 Grenade Ability Energy gains are increased by 10%. (e.g. 10%⁠🠚⁠11%)
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

entries.title: Thermal Atomization
entries.description:
While above 50% Heat:
• Grants 8.25% [PVP: 3.5] to 14% [PVP: ?] increased weapon damage as Heat increases from 50% to 100%
• Enemies explode on direct damage kills, dealing up ? damage matching the weapon's element in a 7.5 meter radius.

Detonation damage by weapon type:
• Hand Cannons: 74 (lol) [PVP: 77?]
• Submachine Guns: 289 [PVP: ?]
• Sniper Rifles: 552 [PVP: ?]

Detonation damage falls off to 0% damage at the edge of the radius.

Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

🡅 Unknown Benefit
entries.officialDescription: While at high heat, this weapon deals increased damage and causes targets to explode when defeated.

entries.title: Built to Blast
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits while 0 Void Overshield, 1 Frost Armor, or 2 Woven Mail is active:
• 30 Stability
• ? Aim Assist
• ?% Flinch Resistance

🡅 Effect lingers for 2 seconds once conditions are no longer met.
entries.officialDescription: Gain lingering aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

entries.title: Overflowing Light
entries.description:
Grenade or Class Ability usage and dealing Elemental Melee damage grants the 'Empowered Abilities' buff to the other two abilities for 5 seconds (e.g.: Barricade usage 🠚 Empowered Grenade and Melee Abilities). Casting your super removes all stacks.

Buff display on the HUD is nonsensical and does not accurately represent the buff's behavior when chaining multiple abilities together.

Empowered Melee x1|x2 benefits:
• 10% | 50% increased Melee damage
• 400% [PVP: 100%] | 800% [PVP: 200%] Additional Base Melee Regeneration Rate

Empowered Grenade x1|x2 benefits:
• 20% [PVP: 10%] | 35% [PVP: 20%] increased Grenade damage
• 400% [PVP: 100%] | 800% [PVP: 200%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate

Empowered Class Ability x1|x2 benefits:
• 25%|50% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate
• Does not grant any measurable benefit to Barricade HP despite stating it does
entries.officialDescription: Using an ability (grenade, melee, or Barricade) empowers the other two abilities. Empowered means abilities have faster regen, melees and grenades do more damage, and Barricades have more hit points.

entries.title: Grenade Kickstart
entries.description:
When a Grenade Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Grenade Ability Energy.

Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Grenade Energy refunds.

Grenade Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: When your grenade energy is fully expended, your Armor Charge is consumed and you gain grenade energy for each Armor Charge used.

entries.title: Destabilizing Rounds
entries.description:
Weapon Kills apply 0 Volatile to enemies in a 7 meter radius around the target and grant 1 Volatile Rounds for 🡅4.5 seconds.

1.5 second cooldown between activations.

🡅 2 Volatile Rounds duration is increased by 1.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.

entries.title: Unplanned Reprieve
entries.description:
Fires seven bolts that deal impact damage and then explode after 5 seconds or when within 3 meters of an enemy.

Due to repeated bugs and exploits, these bolts are immune to all forms of premature destruction.

Upon detonation, each bolt deals 236 [PVP: 47] damage in a 4 meter radius, down to a minimum of 12.5% damage at the edge of the radius.
entries.officialDescription: Fusion projectiles attach and detonate with a delayed Void blast.

entries.title: Necrochasm Catalyst
entries.description:
Damaging 3 enemies within 3 seconds of each other grants the following benefits for 10 seconds:
• 35% increased damage
• ? Handling
• ? Range
• ? Aim Assist

Buff can be refreshed.
entries.officialDescription: Hitting three separate targets increases damage, range, handling, and aim assist for a moderate duration.

entries.title: Subsistence Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Subsistence trait:
Weapon Kills refill 10% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.

Submachine Gun and Auto Rifle Kills refill 17% of the magazine.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

entries.title: Destabilizing Rounds Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Destablizing Rounds trait:
Weapon Kills apply 0 Volatile to enemies in a 7 meter radius around the target and grant 1 Volatile Rounds for 3 seconds.

1.5 second cooldown between activations.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

entries.title: Onslaught Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Onslaught trait:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Onslaught' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of Onslaught:
• 16.7% | 28.6% | 37.5% decreased Firing Delay
• 15 | 25 | 35 Reload Speed
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon increase its rate of fire.

entries.title: Close Enough
entries.description:
Collecting 0 Ionic Traces grants 4% 1 Chaos Reach Super Energy.

While at 5 Stacks of 2 Bolt Charge or higher, after having sprinted for at least 1.5 seconds, maintaining sprint grants you a Stack of 3 Bolt Charge every 0.33 seconds.

4 Chaos Reach refunds 10% Super Energy on hit.
0.75 second cooldown between refunds. This can increase 5 Chaos Reach duration by up to ~120%.
entries.officialDescription: Damaging targets with Chaos Reach extends its duration. Collecting Ionic Traces grants you energy for Chaos Reach. Sprinting while near max Bolt Charge will grant stacks over time.

entries.title: Rimestealer
entries.description:
Killing 0 Frozen Enemies or 1 Shattering a 2 Stasis Crystal with the weapon grants 🡅2 Stacks of 3 Frost Armor.

🡅 Grants an additional stack of 4 Frost Armor.
entries.officialDescription: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you an improved amount of Frost Armor.

entries.title: Balanced Grip
entries.description:
Scoring 3 Melee Attack kills within 5 seconds of each grants 1 ammo.

Passively grants:
• 2 Impact (~1.2% increased damage)
• 10 Charge Rate
• 40 Guard Resistance
• 40 Guard Endurance
entries.officialDescription: Channel a paracausal grip, balanced between defense and attack.

entries.title: Wolfpack Rounds
entries.description:
Light attacks spawn 1 Wolfpack Round.

Grounded Powered Heavy Attacks grant 'Pack Hunter' to you and allies in a ? meter radius for 10 seconds.

Pack Hunter buffs all Ergo Sum and Non-Exotic Swords. Pack Hunter causes sword swings to release 3 tracking submunitions that deal 90 [PVP: 33] damage each.

Wolfpack Rounds count as sword hits, and can benefit from both sword perks and Empowering buffs.
entries.officialDescription: Powered heavy attacks cause nearby Sword-wielders to emit tracking micro-missiles with every attack.

entries.title: Panic Response IV
entries.description:
Magazine is refilled every 0.2 seconds based on currently remaining ammo while not firing the weapon.

Refill amount by currently remaining ammo:
• 1-2 Ammo: 4 shots
• 3-8 Ammo: 3 shots
• 9-16 Ammo: 2 shots
• 17 Ammo: 1 shot

Generates 2% Blight per hit. Not firing for 1.3 seconds drains 3.33% Blight every 1.2 seconds.

Performing a manual reload creates Blighted Seekers for 7 seconds, granting 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight converted. Maximum of 6 Seekers. Blight always rounds up to the next full Seeker.

Grants ? Reload Speed based on the amount of Blighted Seekers prepared.

Blighted Seekers are fired at 720 RPM while aiming down sights or 450 RPM if fired from the hip.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon generates blight as it deals damage. While not firing, blight depletes, and the magazine is gradually refilled. Reload the weapon to convert stored blight into Blighted Seekers.

entries.title: Heavy Metal
entries.description: Holding down the trigger for 4 rounds makes the 4th round apply 0 Volatile for 10 Seconds.
entries.officialDescription: While holding down the trigger, every fourth bullet becomes a heavy projectile that makes targets volatile on impact.

entries.title: Command Frame II
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights consumes one ammo to fire a single hit-scan projectile that can deal precision damage.

Projectile deals 243 [PVP: 40.25] bodyshot damage and 435 [PVP: 72] precision damage.
entries.officialDescription: Fires extended-range, heavy-caliber projectiles at a reduced rate of fire. Deals increased precision damage when aiming down sights.

entries.title: Command Frame III
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights consumes one ammo to fire a single hit-scan projectile that can deal precision damage.

Projectile deals 243 [PVP: 40.25] bodyshot damage and 435 [PVP: 72] precision damage.

entries.title: Armor-Piercing Rounds
entries.description:
Grants 5% increased damage against Elemental and 0 Barrier Champion Shields.

Allows bullets to overpenetrate enemies once.
entries.officialDescription:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets.
 • Slightly increases range

entries.title: Hammer of the Gods
entries.description:
Casting 0 Thunderclap refunds Melee Ability Energy after use. Refund amount is FPS-based, granting 10|18|32|41|77% Melee Ability Energy at 30|60|120|144|300 frames.

Kills with Thunderclap and this exotic's Lightning Strikes refund additional melee energy per kill, up to a maximum of 50%.

Upon activating and upon discharging 1 Thunderclap, summon 2 Jolting Lightning strikes in a 15 meter radius around you, dealing 181 [PVP: 50] damage. Lightning Strikes instantly trigger their 3 Jolt chains during both events, and their damage is doubled while 4 Amplified.

Lightning Damage can be further increased by up to 200% by fully charging 5 Thunderclap, which stacks multiplicatively with the damage bonus from being 6 Amplified.

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Defeating targets with your Thunderclap melee restores melee energy. Targets near you when you use your Thunderclap suffer lightning strikes and become jolted; being amplified increases the damage of these lightning strikes.

entries.title: The Fourth Magic
entries.description:
Kills with Weapons matching your Grenade Element grant a Stack of Death Throes. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

Stacks decay one at a time over 8|7|6|5|4 seconds for the 1st|...|5th Stacks.

Death Throes benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 0.5%|1%|1.5%|2%|2.5% Grenade Energy per second
• PVE: 40%|55%|70%|85%|100% increased Grenade damage
• PVP: 20%|40%|60%|80%|100% increased Grenade damage

0 Grapple Grenade is uniquely tuned and receives an additive buff instead (170% at maximum stacks).

On Grenade Ability usage with active Death Throes Stacks, for 5 seconds:
Allies receive 'Feel The Flames' while within 20 meters of you.

'Feel the Flames' grants 10x Grenade Recharge Rate.

(Grenade Regeneration Rate Multiplier is applied after all additive Grenade Recharge Rate modifiers.)
entries.officialDescription: Weapon final blows with a damage type matching your grenade grant Death Throes, which provide a grenade damage bonus and grant you grenade energy. When you have Death Throes and throw a grenade, nearby allies gain greatly increased grenade regeneration for a short time.

entries.title: Blades of Unmaking
entries.description:
Replaces your melee ability with a 2-hit combo blade attack. Each stab deals 543 [PVP: 84] damage and has an extended lunge range of 7 meters.

Scales with the Melee Stat and Melee-Damage Buffs. Despite its behavior, this is not considered a "Glaive Melee".
entries.officialDescription: [Melee] Press : Perform a melee attack using this weapon's frontal blades. Capable of performing a swift two-hit combo.

entries.title: Dealer's Choice
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant additional Super Ability Energy. Equipping multiple Pale Heart Weapons increases the amount granted.

Extra Super Energy gains with 1|2|3 equipped Pale Heart Weapons: 0.3%|1.6%|3%

Pale Heart Weapons include:
• Weapons with the Dealer's Choice Origin Trait
• Ace of Spades, Khvostov 7G-0X, and Still Hunt
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of Super energy. Equipping multiple weapons from the Pale Heart increases this effect.

entries.title: Anti-Taken Fletching
entries.description:
Grants 10% increased damage to Taken Combatants.

Also grants 25% increased damage to Combatants blighted by Witherhoard.
entries.officialDescription:
Specialized to fight Taken targets.
 • Increases accuracy

entries.title: Loyal Moths
entries.description:
Kills or 2 Direct Hits within ? seconds of each other spawn a seeking Hive Moth.

Hive Moths deal 525 [PVP: 31] damage with a blast radius of 7 meters and 0 Blind for 10 seconds.

Wearing Mothkeeper's Wraps spawns an additional Hive Moth that grants 22.5 HP 1 Void Overshield to the nearest ally.

3 second cooldown between activations.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows and rapid direct hits with this weapon create a loyal moth. The moth will seek out nearby targets and detonate, damaging and blinding them.

entries.title: Malevolent Grasp
entries.description:
Only works while a 0 Strand Super is equipped.

Casting a Rift 1 Suspends all combatants within 6 meters. Killing 2 Suspended Enemies restores 15 HP.

Targets you 3 Suspend take ticks of damage every 0.467 [PVP: 0.3] seconds. Each damage tick restores 5 HP.

Damage over time starts at 23 [PVP: 9] damage, increasing by ~5.5% [PVP: ?%] per tick.

Enemies breaking free from 4 Suspension take an additional 64 [PVP: 34?] damage.

Targets 5 Suspended with a Rift cast take ~112.5% increased damage from the the above sources.
entries.officialDescription: While a Strand Super is equipped, casting Rift will suspend nearby combatants. Suspend deals damage over time, which heals you in the process. Targets who break free from suspension suffer additional damage. Defeating suspended targets heals you a moderate amount.

entries.title: Turnabout
entries.description:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Elemental Shield or the Shield of a Guardian in their Super:
Grants a 30 HP Overshield for 🡅11.4 seconds.

🡅 Increases the Overshield duration by 1.4 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield for an improved duration.

entries.title: Hail Storm
entries.description:
0 Stasis arrows create Large 1 Stasis Crystals on impact, and 2 Freeze on direct hits.

In PvP, direct hits apply 3 [PVP: 50 Slow] for 1 second (2 seconds with 4 Whisper of Durance).

This weapon deals 50% increased damage to 5 Frozen enemies and 6 Stasis Crystals (damage increase stacks with 7 Whisper of Rending).
entries.officialDescription: Direct hits with Stasis arrows freeze combatants and slow opposing Guardians. Stasis arrows that impact the environment create Stasis crystals.

entries.title: High-Impact Reserves
entries.description:
Increases damage by 12.1% [PVP: 3%] to 25.6% [PVP: 6%] as the Magazine drops from 🡅55% of its base capacity to empty.

The buff in PVE ranges between 10.3% and 22.9% instead on Fusion Rifles and Aggressive Frame Linear Fusion Rifles.

Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

🡅 Activates with 5% more of the Magazine Capacity remaining.
entries.officialDescription: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage. Improved damage starts earlier in the magazine.

entries.title: Thin the Herd
entries.description:
Deal 24.5% increased impact damage to Combatant Shields.

Dealing damage grants 70 Reload Speed for 7 seconds. Direct Hits apply 0 Volatile to the target and enemies in a 7.5 meter radius.

For 6 seconds after either scoring a kill with another weapon or dealing Fighting Lion damage, performing the other action refills Fighting Lion's magazine.
entries.officialDescription: Direct hits do increased damage to combatant shields and cause a volatile detonation. Dealing damage increases reload speed. Rapid final blows against grenade-damaged combatants refill the magazine.

entries.title: Nucleosynthetic Magazine
entries.description:
Fires Hive-Knight 0 Arc Projectiles that deal 372 [PVP: 21] impact damage and 355 [PVP: 119] explosive damage in a 4.5 meter radius.

Damage is decreased by 70% at the edge of the radius.
entries.officialDescription: This magazine continuously draws ammo from reserves. The magazine also enables firing Arc projectiles that detonate on impact.

entries.title: Ambitious Assassin
entries.description:
Reloading after scoring Kills with the weapon overfills the magazine from reserves based on the number of Kills scored.

Overfill amount maxes out at 150% of the Magazine Capacity. Always rounds up. Kill counter persists through stow.

Overfill amount per Kill scored:
• 0 Primary Weapons: 20%
• 1 Special and 2 Power Weapons: 10%

🡅 Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.
entries.officialDescription: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

entries.title: Lodestar Catalyst
entries.description:
While 0 Amplified:
• 10 Aim Assist
• ? Reload Speed
• ?% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
entries.officialDescription: While amplified, this weapon gains greatly increased reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights.

entries.title: Serve the Colony
entries.description:
Grants the Auto-Loading Holster trait:

Refills stowed weapon from reserves after 3.5 seconds of it being stowed.
entries.officialDescription: Insectoid robot grenades quickly repopulate the magazine from reserves while the Colony is unequipped.

entries.title: Property: Irreducible
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to consume your grenade charge over a 2.3 second animation that refills the magazine and prepares an explosive [projectile | shape | language]. Can consume both Transcendence Grenades and Song of Flame Wisps.

The explosive's damage type always matches your equipped grenade, and deals 3,311 [PVP: 223] damage in a 6 meter radius on impact. Kills trigger a second explosion for 67.2? [PVP: 44.8?] damage in a 2.4? meter radius.

The [projectile | shape | language]'s damage is increased by 19% if you are Transcendent.
entries.officialDescription: Alternate Weapon Action : Consume your grenade to load a large projectile|shape|language that generates an elemental explosion on impact and deals increased damage while Transcendence is active.

entries.title: Energy Transfer
entries.description:
Every point of damage taken while Guarding grants Class Ability Energy:
• 🡅1.56% when Melee Damage is Blocked
• 🡅1.5% when non-Melee Damage is Blocked
• 🡅0.63% when damage isn't Blocked (getting hit from behind)

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

🡅 Increases Class Ability Energy gains by an additive 0.055%, 0.5%, and 0.125% in that order.
entries.officialDescription: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy at an improved rate.

entries.title: Momentum Transfer
entries.description:
Grants Melee Ability Energy upon dealing Grenade Ability damage. 7 second cooldown between activations.

Melee Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [PVP: 6%] | 17% [PVP: 8.5%] | 20% [PVP: 10%]

Attaching to targets with a 0 Grapple triggers the mod but 1 Grapple Melees do not.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Causing damage with a grenade reduces your melee cooldown.

entries.title: Controlled Burst
entries.description:
Scoring a Kill or hitting every shot in a burst grants 20% increased damage and 10% decreased Charge Time for 🡅2.5 seconds.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for an improved duration.

entries.title: Edge of Intent Catalyst
entries.description: Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a Kill grants 0 Cure x2 to you and 1 Cure x1 to allies within 15 meters.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

entries.title: Slideways
entries.description:
Sliding refills 15% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves and grants 🡅17? Stability and 🡅33 Handling for 3 seconds.

0.5 second cooldown between activations. Buff is removed on stow.

🡅 Stat bonuses are increased by 10?%.
entries.officialDescription: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability greatly.

entries.title: Cooling Baubles
entries.description:
Collecting an Orb of Power or Elemental Pickup dissipates 🡅35% Weapon Heat.

Elemental Pickups include 0 Firesprites, 1 Ionic Traces, 2 Stasis Shards, 3 Tangles, and 4 Void Breaches.

🡅 Dissipates 2% additional Heat per activation.
entries.officialDescription:
Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces slightly more heat.

Elemental pickups include 5 Firesprites, 6 Void Breaches, 7 Ionic Traces, 8 Stasis Shards, and 9 Strand Tangles.

entries.title: Dark Ether Reaper
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Kills with the weapon spawns a Dark Ether Charge at the target's location. ? second cooldown between Charge spawns.

Charge spawning progress on Kill by Enemy Rank:
Minors and Players: 25% | Elites: ?% | Minibosses and higher: 100%

Dark Ether Charges last 5? seconds and can be detonated by shooting or coming into contact with them.

Detonations deal up to 386 [PVP: 50] elemental damage in a 3? meter radius and match the weapon's element. Detonations inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.

Damage is always attributed to the Charge's creator regardless of who destroys them.

Detonating Charges refills and overfills the magazines of all equipped Dark Eather Reaper weapons from reserves up to 140% capacity (rounded up).
entries.officialDescription:
Final blows with this weapon periodically spawn Dark Ether charges.

Charges can be detonated early with weapons fire or by coming into contact with them. Doing so refills this weapon from reserves.

entries.title: Unsated Hunger
entries.description:
Grants 20 Stability, 60 Handling, and 60 Reload Speed while Grenade, Melee, and Class Abilities are all uncharged.

Swords receive 50 Charge Rate and 40 Guard Endurance instead.
entries.officialDescription:
Increased handling, reload speed, and stability when no abilities are fully charged.

Swords gain increased guard resistance and charge rate instead.

entries.title: Lucky Shot
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Precision Kill grants 'Lucky Shot Ready'.

Scoring a Precision Hit while you have Lucky Shot Ready refills the magazine by 1 from reserves and begins a 7 second timer. Additional precision hits during this timer continue to refill the magazine from reserves.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading after a precision final blow causes precision hits to refill a round from reserves.

entries.title: Meaning-Making
entries.description:
Kills with this weapon create a 0 'Teeming Nest'. Killing an enemy within 30 meters of a Teeming Nest will instead spawn a 1 Threadling at the enemy's location.

Teeming Nests spawn 2 Threadlings every 5 seconds and last for 17.5 seconds at base. Nests lose 6.7% of their health per second after being at full health for 1.5 seconds.

Nests can be targeted by Service of Luzaku's healing shots, which heal them for 11.5% HP each shot. Landing 6 healing shots on a Teeming Nest fully restores its health.

3 Threadlings spawned from Teeming Nests interact with Strand Fragments, count as weapon damage, can trigger Armor Mods, and benefit from Empowering Buffs.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon create a Threadling nest that periodically spawns Threadlings. Final blows with this weapon near an existing Threadling nest create a Threadling instead.

entries.title: Arc Dexterity
entries.description:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to 0 Arc Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.
entries.officialDescription: Faster ready and stow speed for Arc weapons.

entries.title: Lone Wolf
entries.description:
Passively grants 🡅6 Aim Assist, 🡅16 Airborne Effectiveness, and a 🡅15% decreased ADS Animation Duration.

While no allies are within 15 meters:
Bonuses are increased to 🡅11 Aim Assist, 🡅32 Airborne Effectiveness, and a 🡅25% decreased ADS Animation Duration.

🡅 Aim Assist bonus is increased by 1, Airborne Effectiveness bonus is increased by 1 (2 with no nearby allies), and the ADS Animation Duration is decreased by a further 5 percentage points.
entries.officialDescription: Improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

entries.title: Crystalline Corpsebloom
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 'Crystalline Corpsebloom' for 4 seconds.

Kills while Crystalline Corpsebloom is active spawn a 0 Stasis Crystal 3 meters away from the enemy death location in a random direction.

🡅 Stasis Crystal is bigger.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid final blows spawn a larger Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

entries.title: D.A.R.C.I. Catalyst
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Stability.

Hits on Highlighted targets grants one stack of 'Networked Targeting' to you and allies within a 15 meter radius for 10.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Networked Targeting buffs D.A.R.C.I and Non-Exotic Sniper Rifles.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2.8%|6.1%|9.1%|12.5%|15.9% increased damage
• ? Stability, Handling, Aim Assist, Flinch Resistance

Granting the 5th stack to an ally increases D.A.R.C.I's damage by an additional 15%.
entries.officialDescription: While Personal Assistant is active, hits grant this weapon and nearby allies' non-Exotic Sniper Rifles increased overall weapon performance and precision damage. Granting maximum stacks of the effect to an ally grants this weapon bonus damage.

entries.title: Borealis Catalyst
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Reload Speed.

On Matching Elemental Shield Break:
Explosion disorients enemies within 7 meters for 5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Energy matched shield explosion disorients nearby combatants.

entries.title: Grand Overture Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 20 Handling and 20 Stability.

Arc Missiles apply 0 Blind for 2 seconds. Kills trigger an explosion dealing ? damage in a ? meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: Omega Strike hits blind combatants. Defeating combatants with Omega Strike causes them to explode.

entries.title: Charged with Blight
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Charged With Blight'. Each stack grants ? Stability and ? Reload Speed, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.

At 10 stacks, hold [Reload] to load a 'Taken Blight'. Animation speed is scaled by reload stat. Entering this mode immediately triggers the 105 HP heal and health regeneration.

Taken Blight deals 220 [PVP: 113] 0 Arc Damage on direct impact with a poisoning field around it that inflicts Corruption and applies 1 Blind in a ? meter radius. Corruption deals 27 [PVP: 0.375] 2 Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds for 3.5 [PVP: 2] seconds.

Any target hit by the Blight takes 50% increased damage from all Weapons of Sorrow for 5 seconds.

Blight can benefit from the final round damage bonus.
entries.officialDescription: Precision hits increase stability and reload speed and drain combatants' life force to charge a ball of Darkness. Alternate Weapon Action to restore health and fire the charged projectile, shrouding combatants in Darkness to temporarily blind them and inflict corruption.

entries.title: Desperate Measures
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 'Desperate Measures x1' (DMx1), increasing damage by 10% for 🡅7.5 seconds.

Grenade or Melee Kills grant 20% increased damage for 🡅7.5 seconds (DMx2). Scoring another Grenade or Melee Kill with DMx2 active increases this to 30% (DMx3).

Can be activated while stowed. Weapon, Grenade, and Melee Kills refresh the buff duration.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

entries.title: Xenophage Catalyst
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Rampage. Maximum of 3 Stacks. Stacks expire one at a time every 🡅4.5 seconds.

Grants a 10%|21%|33.1% damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks.

Weapon Kills trigger a solar elemental explosion, dealing up to 109 [PVP: 72.8] damage in a 3 meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

entries.title: Full Auto Trigger System
entries.description:
Weapon fires Full Auto. (Identical to the setting)

Decreases Firing Delay by 10% on Shotguns.
entries.officialDescription: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.

entries.title: Vanishing Shadow
entries.description:
0 Void Invisibility lasts 2 seconds longer.

Entering 1 Void Invisibility grants one stack of “Vanishing Shadow” for 7 seconds. Vanishing Shadow's timer does not decrease while 2 Invisibile. Vanishing Shadow stacks up to 3 times. Additional stacks can only be gained after exiting 3 Invisibility.

Each stack of Vanishing Shadow grants improved base ability regeneration rate at 1|2|3 stacks.
• Class Ability: 67%|133%|200%
• Grenade: 166%|333%|500%
• Melee: 166%|333%|500%

Reaching Vanishing Shadow x3 or gaining 4 Void Invisibility while at Vanishing Shadow x3 grants you a 15HP 5 Void Overshield for 7 seconds (10 seconds with 6 Echo of Persistence).
entries.officialDescription: Increases the duration of any invisibility effects. When you gain invisibility, your grenade, melee and class abilities recharge faster. At maximum stacks, you gain a Void Overshield as well.

entries.title: Field-Tested
entries.description:
Hits and Kills with your Weapon grant you 'Points'. Hitting Point thresholds grants Stacks of Field Test.

Maximum of 5 Stacks. Buff is only removed on death.

Stat Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 3 | 6 | 9 | 12 | 20 Range
• 5 | 10 | 20 | 35 | 50 Reload Speed
• ? | ? | ? | ? | 30? Stability
• ? | ? | ? | ? | ? Handling
• 5 | 10 | 20 | 35 | 55 Charge Rate (Swords)
• 5 | 10 | 20 | 30 | 40 Guard Resistance (Swords)

Points required for 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 0 Primary Weapons: 51|151|351|651|1001
• 1 Special Weapons: 26|76|176|326|501
• 2 Power Weapons: 11|31|71|131|201

Each Hit grants 1 Point regardless of Weapon Archetype and Enemy Rank. Does not require Direct Hits.

Points granted by Kills are based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1-2 Minors: 1 Point
• Tier 3-4 Minors, Tier 2+ Elites, and higher: 4 Points
• Tier 1 Elites: 5 Points
• Enemy Players: 10 Points

Kill Point Multipliers by Weapon Archetype:
• 3 Primary Weapons and Shotguns: 5x
• Sniper Rifles: 2.5x
• Breech-Loaded Grenade Launchers: 2x
entries.officialDescription:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

entries.title: Rat Pack
entries.description:
Gain 1 stack of 'Rat Pack' for each ally within 20 meters that is currently holding Rat King. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Rat Pack benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 0|13%|20%|30%|40% increased Rate of Fire
• 0|2|4|6|9 increased Magazine Size
entries.officialDescription: This fully automatic weapon becomes stronger when nearby allies also have it equipped. Stacks up to 6 times.

entries.title: Taken Predator
entries.description: Deals 25% increased damage against Taken combatants, Invaders in Gambit, and targets blighted by Witherhoard.
entries.officialDescription: Bonus damage against Taken enemies and Gambit invaders.

entries.title: Eyes Up, Guardian
entries.description:
Collecting an Orb of Power grants 7 stacks of 'Eyes Up, Guardian'.

Firing a ricochet round consumes one stack, increasing the number of richochets to 7 and the seeking radius to a 12 meters. Enemies can only be damaged by the same ricochet twice.
entries.officialDescription: Collecting Orbs of Power strengthens this weapon's next several ricochet shots, providing more damage and more bounces between targets.

entries.title: High Ground
entries.description:
Scoring a Kill grants 1 [PVP: 2] Stacks of 'High Ground' for 7 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Weapon damage increases at 1|2|3 Stacks:
10% [PVP: 5%] | 17.5% [PVP: 10%] | 25% [PVP: 15%]

While you are not airborne:
Damaging targets that are 2 meters [PVP: 5 for Primary weapons] lower in elevation than the ground you stand on immediately grants all 3 Stacks [PVP: Primary weapons only grant 1 Stack] of the buff. The damage increase is applied to the shot triggering the perk as well.

The reference point of enemies' elevation is generally their lowest point.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks. Increases reload.

entries.title: Noble Rounds
entries.description:
Kills create a Remnant which tracks towards you when within a 15 meter radius. Remnants last for 8 seconds in the world before despawning.

Remnants refill 4 rounds into the magazine and grant one stack of 'Noble Rounds'. Maximum of 6 stacks.

Receiving a 'Noble Seeker' from a rift empowered by Boots Of The Assembler also grants one Noble Round.
entries.officialDescription: Kills with this weapon leave behind Remnants. Absorbing a Remnant converts your next hipfired shot into an ally-seeking Noble Round and partially refills the magazine.

entries.title: Tri-Planar Mass Driver
entries.description:
Fires a spread of four 0 Void projectiles per shot.

Aiming Down Sights tightens the spread into a compressed high-damage shot.
entries.officialDescription: Fires a spread of Void energy projectiles. Aiming down sights narrows the spread.

entries.title: No Time to Explain Catalyst
entries.description: Delay between Time-Slip Portal bursts is 47% shorter (1.25/s🠚0.85/s).
entries.officialDescription: Projectiles from the time portal shoot more frequently.

entries.title: Perpetual Loophole
entries.description:
While 0 Void Overshield is active, Glaive Melee attacks deal 20% increased damage.

Glaive Melee kills grant 100% Glaive Energy, fully refill 1 Void Overshield Health, and extend Overshield duration to 8 seconds (12 with 2 Echo of Persistance).
entries.officialDescription: Deal additional melee damage while protected by an overshield. Defeating targets with melee final blows while the overshield is active will refresh it.

entries.title: Arc Alignment
entries.description:
Dealing 0 Arc Damage charges 'Arc Alignment'.

Energy is granted by the following on a per-hit basis:
• Pulse Rifle Mode: 3%
• Trace Rifle Mode: 1%
• All other 1 Arc-damage sources: 1%

At full energy, hold [Reload] to enter Arc Alignment. Doing so instantly refills the magazine and grants 75% reduced recoil.

Arc Alignment energy drains at a rate of 14% per second, and causes hip-fired shots to apply 2 Jolt. Aiming Down Sights reduces energy drain by 67%, down to 4.62% per second.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing Arc damage from any source aligns the battery's coils. When alignment is complete, Alternate Weapon Action to disengage the safety and enable hip-fired Starlight Beam to apply Jolt to any targets damaged for a short time. Aim down sights to slow the rate at which the battery drains.

entries.title: Powerful Friends
entries.description: Allies within 18 meters receive 1 Armor Charge on Orb of Power Pickup.
entries.officialDescription: Collecting an Orb of Power causes nearby allies with at least one Armor Charge to gain an additional one.

entries.title: Roast 'Em
entries.description:
Grants 625% Additional Base Melee Recharge Rate while Proximity Knife remains unexploded.

0 Proximity Explosive Knife applies 60 1 Scorch on detonation. (Unaffected by 2 Ember of Ashes). Proximity Explosive Knife kills trigger an 3 Ignition.

4 Ignition kills (on any subclass) grant a full Melee Ability Charge. This can overflow into one additional 5 Solar Knife charge (any knife) or one additional 6 Withering Blade charge beyond capacity.

On Prismatic, this can overflow into two additional 7 Knife Tricks or 8 Withering Blades beyond capacity.

9 Scorch grants 7% Melee Ability Energy per tick. (Due to chunk ability scaling, this grants ~5% energy to Proximity Knife).
entries.officialDescription:
Your Proximity Knife scorches targets it damages with its explosions, or ignites targets on final blow.

After throwing a Proximity Knife, you gain increased melee regeneration until the knife explodes. Gain a small amount of melee energy when your Scorch damages a target, and Ignition final blows fully refund melee energy and can overflow into an additional knife charge.

entries.title: Banshee's Wail
entries.description:
Holding [Block] grants one stack of 'Banshee's Wail' and charges the blade. Maximum of 9 stacks. Depleting your Sword Energy or ending your combo removes all stacks.

'Charged' Light Attacks consume 20% Sword Energy, dealing 539 [PVP: 389] damage followed by two hits of 135 [PVP: 95] damage. Continued attacks increase the damage of the main hit by 33% and grant one stack of 'Banshee's Wail' per damage instance (3 stacks per landed swing).

Performing a Heavy Attack while Banshee's Wail is active consumes all stacks and performs an overhead strike, dealing 1054 [PVP: 811] damage followed by two hits of 198 [PVP: 152].

Heavy Attack Damage is increased based off the number of Banshee's Wail stacks:
• 1-3 Stacks: 0% increased damage
• 4-6 Stacks: 54% increased damage
• 7-9 Stacks: 109% increased damage
entries.officialDescription:
Block : Hold to rev the blade.
 • Increases damage and adds 0 shield piercing to all attacks.
 • Gain stacks when dealing damage with revved attacks.
 • Additional stacks increase the damage and damage resistance of heavy attacks.

entries.title: Poison Arrows
entries.description:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Only the Poision Burst is intrinsically 0 Anti-Overload. Regular arrows do not stun Champions.

Arrows released within the Perfect Draw window apply poison on hit. Poison deals 70 [PVP: 2.5] damage every 0.25 seconds for 1.35 seconds, totalling 420 [PVP: 15] damage.

Precision Hits within the Perfect Draw window trigger a burst of poison in a 5 meter radius around the target.
entries.officialDescription: Arrows fired while perfectly drawn become poison arrows. Precision hits with poison arrows stun the combatant and spread poison to nearby ones. Strong against 1 Overload Champions.

entries.title: Roving Assassin
entries.description:
Leaving 0 Void Invisibility while within 15 meters of an enemy releases a cloud of smoke that lasts 7 seconds and 1 Weakens enemies. 5 second cooldown between uses.

While in 2 Spectral Blades:
Refunds Super Energy on Heavy Attack based on the number of 3 Spectral Blade Hits and Kills scored before doing so.
entries.officialDescription:
Each Spectral Blades hit or final blow you make before becoming invisible will restore more of your Super energy.

Exiting invisibility while near a target creates a cloud of weakening smoke around you.

entries.title: Double Dodge
entries.description:
Grants an extra Class Ability Charge.

Acts as a copy of the Reaper armor mod.
entries.officialDescription: Gain a second dodge charge. Shortly after dodging, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Better Already
entries.description:
Orb of Power Pickups immediately start Health Regeneration.

Equipping multiple copies provides no benefit.
entries.officialDescription: Your health begins to regenerate immediately after picking up an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Radiant Light
entries.description:
Grants 1 Armor Charges to Allies within 21 meters on Super Cast. Allies on a different Subclass Element are granted 2 Charges.

Caster receives 1 Armor Charge if already charged.
