entries.officialDescription: Casting your Super causes nearby allies with at least one Armor Charge to gain an additional one. Allies that have a different Super element than you gain an additional Armor Charge.

entries.title: Buried Bloodline Catalyst
entries.description:
While 0 Devour is active, grants the following benefits:
• Hits apply 1 Weaken for 6 seconds
• ? Reload Speed
• ? Decreased Reload Animation Duration
entries.officialDescription: While Devour is active, this weapon weakens on hit.

entries.title: Eyes on All
entries.description:
Tracks up to six targets, releasing a volley of rockets divided among the tracked targets.

Each rocket deals damage in a 9 meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon is capable of tracking and firing at multiple targets simultaneously.

entries.title: Crystalline Transistor
entries.description:
0 Kinetic Weapon Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to 252 [PVP: 100] elemental damage matching your equipped Super in a 4 meter radius. Precision Kills increase the radius to 8 meters.

Elemental Kills grant one stack of 'Crystalline Transitor' for 11 seconds. Maximum of 2 stacks. Stacks expire one at a time.

Crystalline Transitor increases the radius of the explosion to 6|8 Meters, at 1|2 stacks.

Enemies hit by the explosion receive an elemental debuff corresponding to your equipped Super:
• 1 Arc: Blinds for ? [PVP: 1] seconds
• 2 Solar: Applies 15 Scorch (20 with 3 Ember of Ashes)
• 4 Stasis: Applies 30 Slow Stacks for 7 seconds (8 with 5 Whisper of Durance)
• 6 Strand: Severs for 6 seconds (8 with 7 Thread of Continuity)
• 8 Void: Weakens for 4 seconds
entries.officialDescription:
Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super that deals damage and applies a matching elemental effect:
• 9 Blinds targets.
• 10 Scorches targets.
• 11 Weakens targets.
• 12 Slows targets.
• 13 Severs targets.
Elemental final blows temporarily increase the explosion's size. Precision final blows always maximum the explosion's size.

entries.title: Battle-Hearth
entries.description:
Grants additional Super Energy on Kills (by either you or allies) while inside your 0 Well of Radiance and below 50% Super Energy.

Amount of Super Energy gained is decreased by 1.5% for each successive Kill, down to a minimum of 4% Super Energy per Kill:
10% 🠚 8.5% 🠚 7% 🠚 5.5% 🠚 4% 🠚 4% ...
entries.officialDescription: Kills and assists you make while standing in your Well of Radiance return Super energy.

entries.title: Häkke Heavy Burst Fire
entries.description: Becomes a Heavy-Burst Frame Pulse Rifle.
entries.officialDescription: Fires a less stable burst of two high-damage, high-range rounds.

entries.title: Kinetic Targeting
entries.description:
Grants the following to Kinetic Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier
entries.officialDescription: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Kinetic weapons.

entries.title: Shot Swap
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 2 Stacks of Shot Swap. Maximum of 6 Stacks.

Grants 100? Ready/Stow Handling and 🡅35% decreased Ready/Stow Animation duration while you have active stacks.

Stowing the weapon consumes 1 stack.

🡅 Stronger effect.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at an additionally improved rate.

entries.title: Ruinscribe's Beacon
entries.description:
While a turret is deployed, Ruinscribe Turret Mode is replaced with a laser designator that marks enemies for 30 seconds.

Firing at a target marks them; firing at a surface marks all enemies within a 6 meter radius. Turret prioritizes marked targets, firing three 274 [PVP: ?] damage missiles every 1.65 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: While a Ruinscribe Turret is deployed, this weapon can paint targets with its laser projectiles. The turret prioritizes painted targets and fires more powerful munitions at them. Alternate Weapon Action to swap between normal fire and laser fire modes.

entries.title: Thunderer
entries.description:
Fires at 300 RPM.

Kills refill the magazine based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 1 ammo
• Elites: 0 ammo (???)
• Minibosses and Bosses: Full Magazine
entries.officialDescription: This weapon's rate of fire is increased significantly, and fires full auto. Final blows auto load ammo from reserves. Powerful targets fully reload the weapon.

entries.title: Unstoppable Force
entries.description:
Blocking damage with the Glaive Shield grants 20% increased projectile damage for 🡅5 seconds.

Buff is removed if you stop blocking.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.
entries.officialDescription: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for an improved duration.

entries.title: Guidance Ring
entries.description:
Direct Hits grant one Stack of 'Guidance Ring'. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Guidance Ring Seeker Hits do not grant Stacks.
entries.officialDescription: Precision hits and final blows build Guidance Ring energy. Opposing Guardians grant additional energy. At full charge, hip firing creates a Guidance Ring.

entries.title: Kinetic Loader
entries.description:
Grants the following to Kinetic Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier
entries.officialDescription: Increases reload speed of Kinetic weapons.

entries.title: Storm and Stress
entries.description:
Kills with Sturm overfill the magazine of Together Forever weapons by 1 round. Maximum of 100% increased Magazine Size.

Kills with Together Forever weapons progressively grant Overcharge Rounds. Maximum of 25 rounds.

Chaining together Forever Weapon kills within 3 seconds of each grants additional stacks per kill. The second kill grants 2 rounds, and further kills in the chain grant 3 rounds.

Sturm's Overcharge Rounds deal increased damage based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors and Elites: 300%
• Minibosses and Champions: 280%
• Bosses: 260%
• Players: 75%
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with Together Forever weapons reload this weapon and overflow bonus damage rounds into the magazine. Final blows with bonus damage rounds increase the magazine capacity of Together Forever weapons.

entries.title: Flash Counter
entries.description:
Taking damage while Guarding emits a blast in a wide, 8? meter long wide cone in front of you.

The blast disorients enemies hit by it for 🡅6 seconds and deals weapon-matching elemental damage.

The damage scales up from 75 [PVP: 14] damage at point-blank range to the maximum of 110 [PVP: 45] damage after ? meters.

The strength of the disorientation against Players similarly also scales up with distance.

2.5 second cooldown between activations.

🡅 Disorient duration is increased by 1 second.
entries.officialDescription: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets for an improved period of time.

entries.title: Proximity Ward
entries.description: Grants a 200 HP Overshield for the duration of your Finisher Animation.
entries.officialDescription: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher.

entries.title: Search Party
entries.description:
Grants the following if no allies are within 15 meters:
• 10% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
• 15% decreased ADS Animation Duration
entries.officialDescription: This weapon is granted faster aim down sights speed and movement speed while aiming down sights when no allies are near.

entries.title: Aerodynamics
entries.description: Passively grants 6 Blast Radius and Velocity.
entries.officialDescription: Grants increased blast radius and projectile speed.

entries.title: Pyrotoxin Rounds
entries.description:
Fires high-caliber explosive rounds with a splash radius of 3 meters. Damage is split into two portions (18% Impact and 82% Explosive), with the explosion damage having no falloff.

Super Good Advice: Tap-Firing reduces Xenophage's Rate of Fire. Holding down the trigger is recommended.
entries.officialDescription: Fires high-powered explosive ammunition.

entries.title: Lumina Catalyst
entries.description: Kills create an additional Remnant (1🠚2).
entries.officialDescription: Gain two Remnants per final blow instead of one.

entries.title: Explosive Light
entries.description:
Orb of Power pickups (even while the weapon is stowed) grant 1 Stack of Explosive Light. Maximum of 🡅7 Stacks.

Firing the weapon comsumes 1 Stack per Shot, granting increased damage and 100 Blast Radius.

Grenade Launchers: 60% increased Explosive damage.

Rocket Launchers: 25% increased Impact and Explosive damage. (Does not affect Wolfpack Rounds)

🡅 Maximum number of Stacks is increased by 1.
entries.officialDescription: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage. Increases the stack count limit.

entries.title: Solar Weapon Surge
entries.description:
Increases 0 Solar Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage

The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.
entries.officialDescription: Your Solar weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.

entries.title: Clown Cartridge
entries.description:
Reloading randomly overfills the Magazine from reserves by 🡅13% to 50% of the base Magazine Capacity (rounded up).

Works out to a 🡅31.5% overfill on average.

🡅 Increases the minimum overfill amount by 30%. (10%⁠🠚⁠13%)
entries.officialDescription: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves to an improved degree.

entries.title: Broadhead
entries.description:
This arrow deals 3 instances of damage.

The arrow itself deals 276 [PVP: 129] damage, which is further increased by dealing Precision Damage. Broadhead deals two [PVP: one] addition hits, each dealing 444 [PVP: 28.75] damage, and is unaffected by Precision Damage.

A single arrow can deal up to 1164 [PVP: 159] damage.
entries.officialDescription: Piercing arrowhead that damages the target on entry and exit. One shot can overpenetrate multiple targets.

entries.title: Bewildering Burst
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a kill grants 'Bewildering Burst' for 🡅7 seconds.

While Bewildering Burst is active, your next Direct Hit spawns a 0 Kinetic explosive above the target that detonates after a 0.85 second delay. The detonation deals 10 [PVP: 4] damage and Disorients enemies within a 10 meter radius for 3.5 🡅[PVP: 1.25] seconds.

🡅 Buff lasts for one additional second. Disorient lasts longer.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a longer-lasting disorienting blast.

entries.title: Microcosm Catalyst
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant an additional 1% Super Energy.

Grants the following benefits against low (under 30%) Health targets. Ignores Shield HP:

• Increased Stagger Force
• 7% to 15% increased damage, scaling with remaining Health
• ? Increased Target Acquisition
entries.officialDescription: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

entries.title: Adept Projectile Speed
entries.description: Passively grants 10 Velocity.
entries.officialDescription: +10 Projectile Speed

entries.title: Strand Ammo Generation
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to 0 Strand Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

Currently bugged and does not work with Swords.
entries.officialDescription: Increases the ammo generation of Strand weapons.

entries.title: Mega Kill Clip
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Weapon Kill grants 40% increased damage for a duration based on the number of kills achieved before reloading. Maximum of 20 seconds.

Base duration is 3 + 2 additional seconds for each kill scored before reloading (One kill is 5 seconds, two kills is 7 seconds...)

Additional kill-reloads will additively stack on top of the currently active timer, extending its duration up to the maximum.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

entries.title: Kinetic Ammo Generation
entries.description: Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Kinetic Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
entries.officialDescription: Increases the ammo generation of Kinetic weapons.

entries.title: Supercharged Battery
entries.description:
Collecting an Orb of Power grants 'Supercharged Battery' for 10 seconds and refills the magazine. Additional orbs grant 10 seconds each, extending the duration up to 20 seconds. Buff can be activated while stowed.

Supercharged Battery sets the power level to High for the duration of the buff, and dealing sustained damage for 2 seconds applies 0 Suppression for 7 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Collecting an Orb of Power grants a period of maximum power that starts with an automatic reload. Sustained fire in this mode suppresses targets.

entries.title: Harsh Truths
entries.description:
5-Round Burst Pulse Rifle.

This weapon has deterministic recoil.

If an ally dies within a 24 meter radius of you, your Health Regeneration is triggered and you gain the following benefits for 6 seconds:
• 20 Mobility
• 33% increased Slide Distance
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
entries.officialDescription: This weapon fires a 5-round burst. When a nearby ally is killed, gain health regeneration and increased movement speed.

entries.title: Field Prep
entries.description:
Grants the following while Crouched:
• 🡅55 Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 0.8x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier

Passively grants 🡅30 Ammo Generation stat. (Equivalent of 2 Ammo Generation armor mods)

🡅 Grants 5 more Reload Speed and 10 more Ammo Generation stat.
entries.officialDescription: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

entries.title: High Priority
entries.description:
Refills 4% of the magazine of Trace Rifles (rounded up) from reserves every 0.7 seconds. Works even while stowed.

Rapidly scoring 5 Trace Rifle hits on a Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Vehicle marks them for you and allies for 10 seconds.

Additional hits refresh the mark duration. Does not require Direct Hits. Multiple people cannot mark the same enemy.

Only one target can be marked at a time and the mark cannot be transferred to a different target before the duration runs out or the enemy is defeated.

Ally kills on Marked Enemies spawn a 0 Heavy Ammo Brick for allies and a 1 Special Ammo Brick for you.

Spawned Ammo Bricks grant 10.33% of your total reserves (rounded up).
entries.officialDescription: Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Trace Rifle's magazine from reserves. Damaging a vehicle, boss, or Champion with a Trace Rifle marks them as the target. When an ally defeats the marked target, Special ammo is generated for you and Heavy ammo for your allies.

entries.title: Forge's Kin
entries.description:
Kills with Black Armory Weapons, or readying a Black Armory weapon within 7 seconds of any weapon kill, grants 'Forge's Kin'. Maximum of 3 stacks. Timer begins upon readying the weapon and cannot be refreshed.

Equipping and performing the above conditions with additional Black Armory weapons increases the potency and duration of the buff.

Forge's Kin provides the following benefits with 1|2|3 Black Armory Weapons equipped:
• 5|7|9 Second Buff Duration
• 15|?|? Reload Speed
• ?|?|? Ammo Generation
• 0%|5% (🡅 7%)|10% (🡅 13%) Increased Damage Against Combatants

The exotic weapons Izanagi's Burden, Jötunn, and Le Monarque count as Black Armory weapons for the purposes of the origin trait, but do not recieve its benefits.
entries.officialDescription: Black Armory weapon final blows briefly grant ammo generation, reload speed, and damage against combatants when the weapon is redrawn. Buff potency and duration increases for each equipped Black Armory weapon.

entries.title: Impetus
entries.description:
Finishing a reload 6 seconds after a kill grants 50% increased damage for 4.5 seconds.

Buff can be refreshed.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading immediately after a kill increases weapon damage for a short time.

entries.title: Kismet
entries.description:
While at Full HP, scoring a Weapon Kill or not taking damage for 4.5 [PVP: 15] seconds continuously generates 6.6 [PVP: 1.1] 0 Void Overshield HP per second until you take damage again.

Grants the following while any Overshield is active:
• 15% increased weapon damage against Combatants (20% for Heat-Based weapons)
• 25 Stability
• 25 Handling
• 5% Decreased Accuracy Cone Size

Damage bonus stacks with other Empowering weapon buffs.

While any Overshield is active, scoring a kill enables 'Hasty Escape'. Hasty Escape activates upon the depletion of your Overshield, granting 30 Mobility for 5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription:
After landing a final blow while at full health, or when out of combat for an extended duration, your shields will slowly recharge into an overshield.

When you have an overshield, your weapons gain increased accuracy, stability, handling, and damage against combatants, and final blows will grant a short period of increased mobility once the overshield is depleted.

entries.title: Solar Rampart
entries.description:
0 Solar Kills grant 15% Class Ability Energy. 1? second cooldown between activations.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

Upon casting a Barricade Class Ability with a 1 Solar Super equipped:
Unleashes 3 2 Solar Waves from the front of the barricade that travel 18.5 meters and have tracking capabilities.

The Waves deal 480 [PVP: 100] damage and apply 60 [PVP: 30] 3 Scorch Stacks (90 [PVP: 45] with 4 Ember of Ashes).

Enemies Hit [PVP: Killed] by the Waves leave behind a 5 Sunspot at their location.

6 Solar Wave does not trigger nor is affected by 7 Roaring Flames.
entries.officialDescription: Solar final blows recharge your Barricade. While you have a Solar Super equipped, casting your Barricade unleashes waves of Solar energy that damage and scorch targets. Combatants damaged and Guardians defeated by these waves are enveloped in a Sunspot.

entries.title: Salvation's Grip Catalyst
entries.description: Killing 0 Frozen Enemies or 1 Shattering a 2 Stasis Crystal with the weapon grants a Stack of 3 Frost Armor.
entries.officialDescription: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

entries.title: Impromptu Ammunition
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 15% improved 0 Special ammo generation and 10% improved 1 Heavy ammo generation from all sources for 🡅5.5 seconds. Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration up to 7 seconds.

Buff is additive to Ammo Finder Helmet mods.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a slightly increased duration.

entries.title: Trench Barrel
entries.description:
Dealing Melee Damage grants the following for the next 3 shots within 5 seconds:
• 🡅35 Reload Speed and 🡅35 Handling
• 50% increased damage

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

🡅 Stat bonuses are increased by 5?.
entries.officialDescription: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, improved handling, and improved reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.

entries.title: Leviathan's Breath Catalyst
entries.description:
Increases Reserves by 5 (9🠚14) and Ammo Generation by 80.

Precision Hits grant 43.7% decreased Draw Animation Speed for 3 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Maximizes quiver size.

entries.title: Remote Shield
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a small 0 Void Dome.

1 Void Dome Properties:
• Lasts 20 seconds with 2400 HP
• 15% added Damage Resistance against Bosses and 85% Damage Resistance against all other Combatants
• Grants a 45 HP 2 Void Overshield for 10 seconds (15 with 3 Echo of Persistence) upon entry, with a 1 second cooldown before it can be granted again.
• Grants 'Stat Boost' for 10 seconds, granting ? Reload Speed, ? Handling, and 5% Increased Weapon Damage (which stacks with all other Empowering Sources)
• Benefits from Helm of Saint-14's defensive buffs.
entries.officialDescription: Alternate Weapon Action : When weapon is fully charged, consume charge before firing to make your next shot deploy a protective shield on impact. Passing through the protective shield provides a Void Overshield and improves weapon damage, reload speed, and handling.

entries.title: Cruel Remedy
entries.description:
Kills restore 32 HP and triggers Health Regeneration.

Precision Kills instantly refill the magazine.
entries.officialDescription: Kills with this weapon heal the wielder. Precision kills also refill the magazine.

entries.title: Umbral Sustenance
entries.description: Receiving or refreshing any 0 Void Buff (Devour, Overshield, Invisibility) instantly refills the magazine.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon's magazine is automatically reloaded when you gain Devour, a Void overshield, or become invisible.

entries.title: Leviathan's Sigh
entries.description: Fully drawn shots apply 0 Volatile to the target and knock back enemies in a ? meter radius from the point of impact.
entries.officialDescription: When fully drawn, the bolt creates a large concussive blast that knocks combatants back and makes them volatile.

entries.title: Tactical
entries.description: Passively grants 6 Handling and 6 Reload Speed.
entries.officialDescription: Grants increased reload speed and handling.

entries.title: Focused Fury
entries.description:
Scoring 35% of the Base Magazine Capacity as Precision Hits grants 25% increased damage for 🡅12 seconds.

Stowing or Reloading the weapon resets the Precision Hit counter. The buff remains active while stowed.

Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage for an improved duration. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

entries.title: Vestigial Alchemy
entries.description:
Vestiges collected by Harvester Spikes charge up 'Vestigial Alchemy'.

After collecting 7 Vestiges (50% charge):
Enables a Hold [Reload] interaction that makes your next shot fired spawn a 0 Special Ammo Brick at the point of impact for you and your allies, granting 10% of your 1 Total Special Ammo Reserves

After collecting 17 Vestiges (100% charge):
Allows you to cycle Hold [Reload] a second time, making your next shot fired spawn a 2 Heavy Ammo Brick at the point of impact for you and your allies on impact, granting 10% of your Total 3 Heavy Ammo Reserves

Creating ammo bricks consumes the energy it cost to reach that level on the meter. Ammo-Spawning spikes cannot impale targets.
entries.officialDescription:
This weapon gains energy when you pick up Vestiges and allows you to create ammo at the projectile impact point for you and your allies. Special ammo mode unlocks at 50% energy, while Heavy ammo mode unlocks at 100% energy.

To transform Vestiges into Special ammo, Alternate Weapon Action to activate Special ammo mode. Alternate Weapon Action a second time to activate Heavy ammo mode.

entries.title: Wardcliff Coil Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants some tracking to the rockets I guess?

(Good luck on figuring that one out!)
entries.officialDescription: Improved tracking on projectiles.

entries.title: Offhand Strike
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant the following benefits to hip-firing for 🡅8 seconds:
• 30 Stability
• 45% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• ~3° larger Precision Aim Angle
• 95%? decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 95%? decreased Accuracy Cone Growth.

Buff is removed on stow.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for an improved duration.

entries.title: Bandolier
entries.description: Weapon Kills provide 10% more activation progress to 0 Special Ammo Finder mods.
entries.officialDescription: Grants slightly increased ammo generation and magazine size.

entries.title: Tex Balanced Stock
entries.description:
Scoring 4 Hip-Fire Hits within 4? seconds of each grants the following benefits for 4 seconds:
• 20 Range, Handling, and Reload Speed
• 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 1.5° larger Precision Aim Cone
• 10% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

Scoring additional Hip-Fire Hits refreshes the buff duration.
entries.officialDescription: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.

entries.title: Composite Propellant
entries.description:
Rockets embed into targets, spewing three Napalm Pools every 0.75 seconds until detonation. Napalm Pools rapidly apply 0 40 Scorch (60 with 1 Ember of Ashes) every ? seconds for 5 seconds.

Gain one stack of 'Composite Propellant' every 6 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. Firing this weapon triggers a 3 second cooldown on passive stack generation.

Composite Propellant benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 1.5|2.25|3|3.75|4.5 second delay before detonation
• 3|6|9|12|15 released incendiary pools
• 0%|7%|14%|21%|29% increased detonation damage

At 5 stacks of Composite Propellant, rockets leave a trail of Napalm behind them, applying 2 50 Scorch (70 with 3 Ember of Ashes) every ? seconds for 2 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Rockets embed themselves in struck targets and periodically eject incendiary fuel that inflicts Scorch. The longer this weapon goes without firing, the more fuel the next rocket contains. Strong against 4 Unstoppable Champions.

entries.title: Barri-nade
entries.description:
Passively grants 45% faster Base Class Ability Regeneration (does not function with 0 Thruster).

Replaces Grenade Ability with Barri-Nade on Class Ability usage. Barri-Nade is lost if Class Ability fully recharges.

Barri-Nade spawns your selected Barricade type on the impact location and inherits the benefits of Aspects such as 1 Bastion and 2 Drengr's Lash. Non-barricade class abilities default to Towering Barricade and match its cooldown.

Enemies within 5? meters of the Barri-Nade's impact location are disoriented. Spawned Barricade deals no Contact damage within 2 seconds of its creation.

Collecting three Orbs of Power grants 'Enhanced Barri-Nade', causing the next Barri-Nade to spawn three Barricades in a circular formation on impact.

Aspect effects of barricades stack outside of the 3 Storm's Keep's 4 Bolt Charge generation.

Barri-Nade has no collision with enemies.
entries.officialDescription: Using your class ability channels defensive Light inward, providing a grenade that creates a barricade on impact. Picking up Orbs of Power enhances your next Barri-nade, spawning more barricades on impact.

entries.title: Killing Wind
entries.description:
On Weapon Kill, for 🡅5.5 seconds:
• 50 Mobility
• 40 Handling and 20 Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance

Additional Kills extend the duration by 5 seconds, up to 8 seconds. Buff is removed on stow.

🡅 Initial Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for an improved duration.

entries.title: Amalgamation Rounds
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights charges an 'Amalgamation Round' over the course of 1 second. When charged, fire an extremely dense shot that deals 290% [PVP: 18%] increased damage and marks the target for all allies for 5 seconds.

This gun deals 95% [PVP: 6.7%] increased Spread Shot damage and 30% [PVP: 6.7%] increased Amalgamation Round damage to marked targets

Defeating a marked target with this gun or scoring a precision kill with an Amalgamation Round grants 0 Void Invisibility for 7 seconds (10.5 with 1 Echo of Persistence) and 2 Truesight for 4 seconds.
entries.officialDescription:
Aiming down sights for a short period without firing compresses the spread into a single high-density projectile. Damaging a target with this shot marks them.

This weapon deals additional damage to marked targets. Defeating a marked target or landing a precision final blow with an Amalgamation Round grants invisibility and truesight.

entries.title: Void Holster
entries.description:
After stowing 0 Void Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.
entries.officialDescription: Gradually reloads your stowed Void weapons over time.

entries.title: Multikill Clip
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of scoring 1|2|3 Weapon Kills within 3.5 seconds of each grants 17%|33%|50% increased damage for 🡅5.5 seconds.

Buff is overwritten every time it is triggered and is removed on stow.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand for an improved duration.

entries.title: Light Touch
entries.description:
While 0 Amplified, 1 Radiant, or 2 Devour is active:
• ? Handling
• ? Reload Speed
• ?% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• ?% decreased ADS Animation Duration
entries.officialDescription: This weapon gains reload speed, handling, and aim down sight speed when you are amplified, radiant, or have Devour.

entries.title: Glacial Fortification
entries.description:
While a 0 Stasis Super Ability is equipped:
Class Abilities are replaced by a 1 Stasis Crystal formation.

When used with Rally or Towering Barricade:
• Spawns a 2 Stasis Crystal Wall made of a Small 3 Crystal in the middle and 2 Medium 4 Crystals on either side of it
• Grants Rally Barricade benefits to players standing behind the middle 5 Crystal for 14 seconds, even if destroyed.
• Overrides Class Ability cooldown with Towering Barricade's

When used with 6 Thruster:
• Spawns 2 Medium 7 Crystals diagonally forward to either side of you
entries.officialDescription: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, your Barricade becomes a wall of Stasis crystals that slows nearby targets when created. Standing behind this barricade will grant you and your allies increased weapon reload speed, stability, and range.

entries.title: Mad Scientist
entries.description:
Deals 80% decreased damage to Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles.

Shoots a wildly imprecise volley of 8 rockets.

Every 2 rockets fired grant x1 0 Bolt Charge to you and nearby allies within a ? meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon fires a volley of rockets and grants Bolt Charge to all nearby allies for every other rocket that it fires.

entries.title: Longest Winter
entries.description:
At 100% Beam Energy, hits spawn an 0 Ionic Trace.

2 second cooldown between spawns.
entries.officialDescription: Periodically generates Ionic Traces while in its high-damage state.

entries.title: Indomitability
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant ability energy based on your Super's elemental alignment:
• Light Super: 5% Grenade Ability Energy
• Dark Super: 5% Melee Ability Energy

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows grant grenade energy when playing a Light subclass or melee energy when playing a Darkness subclass.

entries.title: Prototype Trueseeker
entries.description:
This rocket's tracking capabilities are stronger than other traditional tracking rocket launchers, and have a blast radius of 11 meters.

Dealing damage with 3 rockets without reloading generates 0 1 Ammo. Finishing a reload after having dealt damage with all three rockets grants 'Prototype Trueseeker'.

Prototype Trueseeker grants the following benefits:
• 80% Faster Rate of Fire
• ? Stability
• Significantly improved tracking capabilities
• Rockets now explode into 8 cluster munitions upon detonation, each cluster having a blast radius of 3 meters.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon's rockets have tracking. Lock onto targets when aiming down sights. Landing hits with a full magazine grants ammo and boosts the next magazine with increased tracking strength, stability, fire rate, and cluster bombs.

entries.title: Resurgence Directive III
entries.description:
Light Attack Hits grant 10% Sword Energy. Kills grant 30%. Kills or 3 Light Attack Hits spawn 3 Nanites.

Heavy Attacks with at least 10% Sword Energy consume 3 ammo and launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters. Aerial Heavy Attacks always spawn a wave.

Wolfsbane's damage is increased against enemies with Outbreak Perfected Nanites on them, up to a maximum increase of 25% at maximum Outbreak nanites.

Nanites restore ? HP as they attach to you.
entries.officialDescription: Light attacks generate Sword energy and have the chance to spawn seeking Quicksilver nanites that heal the wielder upon attaching.

entries.title: Resurgence Directive II
entries.description:
Light Attack Hits grant 10% Sword Energy. Kills grant 30%. Kills or 3 Light Attack Hits spawn 3 Nanites.

Heavy Attacks with at least 10% Sword Energy consume 3 ammo and launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters. Aerial Heavy Attacks always spawn a wave.

Wolfsbane's damage is increased against enemies with Outbreak Perfected Nanites on them, up to a maximum increase of 25% at maximum Outbreak nanites.

Nanites restore ? HP as they attach to you.
entries.officialDescription: Light attacks generate Sword energy and have the chance to spawn seeking Quicksilver nanites that heal the wielder upon attaching.

entries.title: Resurgence Directive IV
entries.description:
Light Attack Hits grant 10% Sword Energy. Kills grant 30%. Kills or 3 Light Attack Hits spawn 3 Nanites.

Heavy Attacks with at least 10% Sword Energy consume 3 ammo and launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters. Aerial Heavy Attacks always spawn a wave.

Wolfsbane's damage is increased against enemies with Outbreak Perfected Nanites on them, up to a maximum increase of 25% at maximum Outbreak nanites.

Nanites restore ? HP as they attach to you.
entries.officialDescription: Light attacks generate Sword energy and have the chance to spawn seeking Quicksilver nanites that heal the wielder upon attaching.

entries.title: Ensemble
entries.description:
Grants 🡅35 Handling and 🡅45 Reload Speed while within 15 meters of an ally.

Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once you're no longer near allies.

🡅 Stat bonuses are increased by 5.
entries.officialDescription: Substantially improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

entries.title: Bullwhacker
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights generates 3% Heat per second, building up to Charge Level x1|x2|x3 after 0.5|1.2|1.8 seconds.

Each Charge Level generates 20%|30%|34% heat upon firing and increases impact damage, explosion damage, and detonation radius.

Benefits at Charge Level x1|x2|x3:
• 36.5%|91%|145% increased Impact damage
• 17%|27%|91% increased Explosion damage
• 5|6|9.5 meter Detonation Radius
entries.officialDescription: Aim down sights for a period of time to overcharge the next bolt fired. Increases damage and area of effect for each charge level.

entries.title: Firewalker
entries.description:
Increases 0 Solar Weapon and 1 Ignition damage while 2 Roaring Flames currently active.

Benefits at 3 Roaring Flames x1|x2|x3:
• 6%|9.2%|12.4% increased Weapon Damage
• 15%|20%|24.9% increased Ignition Damage

The number 4 Slow stacks and their duration, as well as the duration of 5 Suspend applied to you are halved. Damage from 6 Stasis Breakout is removed.

7 Stasis or 8 Suspend Breakout creates a burst of 9 Solar Energy, dealing up to 105 damage in a 9 meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: Increase the damage of Solar weapons and Solar Ignitions based on the amount of Roaring Flames stacks you have. You are harder to suspend, slow, or freeze, and when you break out, you take no damage from doing so, creating a burst of Solar energy around yourself.
entries.extraInfo: Item: The Path of Burning Steps

entries.title: Nadir Focus
entries.description:
Firing or swinging the weapon grants a stack of Nadir Focus for 2 seconds. Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

Maximum number of Stacks by Weapon Type:
• Auto Rifles, Submachine Guns?: 11 stacks
• Sidearms, Swords: 5 stacks
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 stacks
• Grenade Launchers: ? stacks

Benefits scale linearly? with each stack, equalizing between Weapon Types at max stacks. (E.g.: you would gain 1/4 of the maximum benefit per stack with Hand Cannons)

Benefits at max Stacks:
• 10 Range
• 7.5%? decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 100%? increased Lunge Distance (Swords)
• ?% increased Projectile Velocity (Grenade Launchers)
entries.officialDescription: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers.

entries.title: Arc Conductor
entries.description:
Recieving 0 Arc Damage activates 'Arc Conductor' for 6 seconds. Direct Weapon Kills extend the buff by 3 seconds, up to 6 seconds.

While Arc Conductor is active, gain 50% [PVP: 15%] 1 Arc Damage Resistance.

Arc Conductor can be activated and grants its benefits even while stowed.
entries.officialDescription: When taking Arc Damage, this weapon becomes more powerful and resists incoming Arc Damage. Kills extend the time in this overcharged state.

entries.title: Gjallarhorn Catalyst
entries.description:
Increases Magazine Size by 1 (1🠚2).

Kills with Wolfpack Rounds spawn an upgraded Wolfpack Round that seeks targets ?% faster and deals 126.5% increased damage.
entries.officialDescription: Increases magazine size. Final blows with Wolfpack Rounds spawn a faster, more powerful micro-missile at the target's location.

entries.title: Stasis Weapon Surge
entries.description:
Increases 0 Stasis Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage

The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.
entries.officialDescription: Your Stasis weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.

entries.title: Tessellation Catalyst
entries.description:
Your explosive [projectile | shape | language] inherents subclass debuffs based on its element.

Deals an additional instance of 165 [PVP: 10] damage in a 10 meter radius and applies a debuff matching its element:
•0 70 Scorch Stacks (80 with 1 Ember of Ashes)
•2 Weaken for 6 [PVP: 2.5] seconds
•3 Blind for 9 seconds
•4 80 Slow Stacks
•5 Sever for 5 seconds (7.5 with 6 Thread of Continuity)

Effects are applied after the explosion.
entries.officialDescription: Targets near the blast of Property: Irreducible are afflicted|burdened|cursed with an elemental effect matching your equipped grenade's damage type.

entries.title: Ravenous Beast
entries.description:
Dealing damage with Tarrabah grants Raveneous Beast 2% [PVP: 5%] charge for each hit. Dealing damage to 0 Scorched enemies grants 3%[PVP: 6.7%] charge per hit.

Taking damage grants it 1% charge per instance taken, and kills grant 10% charge.

Stowing Tarrabah subtracts 50% charge (E.g. 70%🠚20%).

At full power, hold [Reload] to 'Unleash The Beast' and refill the magazine, granting the following benefits for 8 seconds:
• 187% [PVP: 120%] increased Bodyshot Damage
• 99% [PVP: 52.7%] increased Precision Damage
• 50% [PVP: 15%] 1 Solar Damage Resistance
• 20% increased Rate of Fire
• 100 Handling
• 100 Mobility
• 100 Reload Speed
• 20% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 33% increased Slide Distance
entries.officialDescription:
This weapon stores power when dealing or receiving damage; defeating combatants or dealing damage to Scorched combatants grants increased progress.
Alternate Weapon Action : Unleashes the beast when full, increasing outgoing damage and reducing incoming Solar damage.

entries.title: Collective Action
entries.description:
Elemental Pickup Interactions grant 🡅33% [PVP: 🡅11%] increased damage for a variable duration based on the pickup. Can be activated while stowed.

0 Ionic Traces, 1 Stasis Shards, and 2 Tangle Detonations grant the buff for 4 seconds. Throwing a held 3 Tangle grants 4 additional seconds. 4 Firesprites and 5 Void Breaches grant the buff for 8 seconds.

Additional Pickups can extend the duration up to the maximum of 16 seconds.

Elemental Pickup Interactions:
• Destroying a 6 Tangle (or Elemental Orbs), either by shooting or throwing.
• Collecting 7 Firesprites, 8 Ionic Traces, 9 Stasis Shards, or 10 Void Breaches

Does not trigger with 11 Stasis Shards generated from Facet of Awakening or Facet of Command.

🡅 Damage is increased by 10%. (30%⁠🠚⁠33%)
entries.officialDescription:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of further increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include 12 Firesprites, 13 Void Breaches, 14 Ionic Traces, 15 Stasis Shards, and 16 Strand Tangles.

entries.title: Compounding Force
entries.description: Instantly destroys PvE Combatant Elemental and Champion Shields on hit.
entries.officialDescription: Fires slugs that cause massive damage to combatant shields. Strong against 0 Barrier Champions.

entries.title: Head Rush
entries.description:
Upon sliding, or upon standing up after having crouched for 2 seconds:
Grants 30 Handling, 30 Reload Speed, and 15% Increased Damage to Hive Combatants for 5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Sliding or standing up after crouching for a short time grants this weapon a brief period of bonus handling, reload speed, and damage against Hive combatants.

entries.title: Nightsworn Sight
entries.description:
Kills or collecting a 0 Void Breach grants 'Nightsworn Sight' for 7 seconds and Truesight for 3 seconds.

Allies with Slayer's Fang within ? meters of you also receive the Nightsworn Sight when you score a kill with the gun.

Nightsworn Sight grants ? Reload speed and the following benefits:
• 15% increased Precision Damage
• 10% increased damage against Fallen and Scorn
• Automatically load 2 rounds from reserves every 4 seconds
• Submunitions apply 1 Weaken for 4 seconds
• Submunitions deal 18% decreased damage and bounce 1 additional time.

Buff can be activated while stowed.
entries.officialDescription:
Dealing final blows to targets grants Nightsworn Sight.

During that time, final blows grant Truesight, reload speed and precision damage is increased, and submunitions weaken targets.

entries.title: Atomizing Rounds
entries.description:
Fires a 3-round burst of delayed Micro-Missile projectiles that detonate after 6 seconds of being embedded into a target.

Hold [Reload] to instantly detonate all fired rounds.
entries.officialDescription: Rounds fired embed themselves in targets. Alternate Weapon Action to detonate embedded rounds.

entries.title: Null Factor
entries.description:
0 Withering Blade hits and bounces grant 7.5% Melee Ability Energy. Additionally, the 1st and 3rd bounces spawn a Small 1 Stasis Crystal.

Shattering a 2 Stasis Crystal or 3 Frozen Enemy with 4 Withering Blade releases a spread of 3 5 Withering Blades.

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Withering Blade hits and bounces create a small Stasis crystal and refund a portion of melee energy. Using Withering Blade to shatter crystals or frozen targets releases a spread of Withering Blades.

entries.title: Charged Up
entries.description: Increases the Maximum Number of Armor Charge Stacks you can hold from 3 to 4|5|6 with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
entries.officialDescription: Increases the maximum number of stacks of Armor Charge you can carry by 1.

entries.title: Rewind Rounds
entries.description:
Upon emptying the Magazine:
Refills 60% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.

Hits are counted from either your last reload or the last time the perk was triggered. Does not require Direct Hits.

Requires firing 28.75% of the Magazine Capacity for the refill to activate.

Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.

Hits after triggering a refill do not count while the Rewind Rounds buff is active (1? second).

Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifle behavior:
• Each individual bolt in the burst counts as a Hit
• Refill amount is uniquely 14% of the number of Hits rounded up (numbers are subject to change once we get more data points)

Nanite Hits count as Hits with the weapon.
entries.officialDescription: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

entries.title: Headseeker
entries.description:
Dealing non-Precision Direct damage grants the following benefits for 0.55 seconds:
• 20% increased Precision Bonus (complicated, see specific damage increases below)
• 3% increased Aim Assist Cone size

Precision damage increases by weapon type/frame:
• Pulse Rifles: Adaptive: 7.1%, Aggressive Burst: 10%, Heavy Burst: 9.5%, High-Impact: 8.74%, Lightweight: 6.3%, Rapid-Fire: 10.3%
• Sidearms: Adaptive Burst: 8.46%, Heavy Burst: 7.36%
• Scout Rifles: Precision: 8.66%

[Bug] Heavy Burst Hand Cannons: 7% increased Weakspot damage.

The distinction between Weakspots and Critspots is complicated and we might write an explainer blog post about it eventually. For the purposes of PvP, the two are equivalent.
entries.officialDescription: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

entries.title: Rapid Hit
entries.description:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier
entries.officialDescription: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

entries.title: Sharp Harvest
entries.description:
Scoring 3 Powered Sword Hits within 🡅2 seconds of each grants 5% of 0 Special Ammo reserves.

Equipping two 1 Special Weapons halves the amount of ammo granted to 2.5% for each one.

🡅 Time allowed between hits is increased by 0.5? seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Landing three light-attack hits within an improved short time grants special ammo.

entries.title: Traitor's Vessel
entries.description:
Fires a wide 16-bolt volley. Aiming Down Sights tightens the spread, overlapping into 8 bolts (with 2 in each group).

Hip-Fired Bolts deal 20% increased damage.

Kills spawn 0 Ionic Traces based off Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 10%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%
• Players: 100%
entries.officialDescription:
Fires a wide horizontal spread when shot from the hip.
Final blows with this weapon have a chance to generate Ionic Traces. Powerful foes and opposing Guardians always generate Ionic Traces.

entries.title: Timelost Magazine
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant an additional 1?% Super Energy.

Upon your Super ending:
• Refills magazine from reserves
• Grants 100% increased Base Magazine Capacity for 20 seconds
• Causes Found Verdict to reload two shells at a time for 20 seconds

Buff can be activated while stowed.

The increased Base Magazine Capacity will be considered the baseline for other perks such as Overflow.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus Super energy. When your Super expires, this weapon's magazine size is doubled for a long duration and reloads from reserves.

entries.title: Tireless Blade
entries.description:
Your first Powered Sword Kill after (re)spawning refunds 1 Ammo. Afterward, every other Powered Sword Kill also refunds 1 Ammo.

🡅 ?% chance to be granted 1 more Ammo.
entries.officialDescription: Sword ammo granted for every other powered Sword final blow, with a chance for additional ammo to be provided.

entries.title: Special Ammo Finder
entries.description:
Grants a 1.25x|1.4x|1.5x multiplier to all Special Ammo Meter progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

This works in the Crucible as well.
entries.officialDescription: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Special ammo meter.

entries.title: Frame of Reference
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a stack of 'Frame of Reference' for 8 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

'Frame of Reference' timer is paused while stowed. Remaining duration is rounded up to a whole number of seconds.

'Frame of Reference' benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 1.45%|2.8%|4.2%|5.6%|7% increased weapon damage
• ?|?|?|?|? Range
• ?|?|?|?|? Reload Speed
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage, reload speed, and range. This effect is frozen in time while the weapon is stowed.

entries.title: Heart Piercer
entries.description:
Slug rounds shatter on impact into 7 semi-tracking submunitions that deal 99 [PVP: 5] damage each. Direct Slug Hits will deal damage with every submunition.

Submunitions are unaffected by damage falloff and ricochet 3 times. They deal 18% reduced damage on the first bounce, then 42.5% reduced damage on subsequent bounces.

Submunitions will attempt to steer towards enemies within 5 meters of their ricochet.
entries.officialDescription: Rounds from this weapon shatter into submunitions on impact. Strong against 0 Overload Champions.

entries.title: Heavy Slug Thrower
entries.description: Can only be fired when Aiming Down Sights and fully spun up. Aiming begins a spin-up time of 1.5 seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Aim Down Sights : Spins up this weapon. This weapon can be fired only when fully spun up.

entries.title: Golden Tricorn
entries.description:
While the perk's buff isn't active, Weapon Kills grant 'Golden Tricorn x1' for 7 seconds, increasing weapon damage by 15%. Additional Kills refresh the buff duration.

While Golden Tricorn x1 or x2 is active:
Grenade or Elemental Melee Kills matching the element of the Weapon grant Golden Tricorn x2 for 10 seconds, increasing weapon damage by 50%.

Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

entries.title: Absorption Cells
entries.description:
Kills or scoring 5 hits with Weapons matching your Super Element grant Super Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1.5%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 2%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 2.5%
• Players: 2.5?%

While your Super is charged:
Kills with Weapons matching your Super's Element grant 4 Stacks of Subclass-Matching Weapon Surge for 11 [PVP: 6] seconds.

After casting your Super Ability, gain x4 0 Arc, 1 Solar, 2 Void, 3 Stasis, and 4 Strand Weapon Surge for 10 seconds, and 'Harmonic Munitions' for 15 seconds.

Harmonic Munitions causes weapons that are the same element as your super to trigger an element-matching explosion on hit. Explosions deal 180 [PVP: ?] damage in a 6 meter radius and can trigger once per second.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows or sustained damage with weapons matching your equipped Super damage type grant you Super energy. When your Super energy is full, you instead gain a temporary bonus to weapon damage of that type. When you've exhausted your Super, matching elemental weapons' damage temporarily causes explosions around the target.

entries.title: The Fundamentals
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to cycle this weapon's element between 0 Arc, 1 Solar, and 2 Void. Selected element persists through stow and death.

Grants 30% [PVP: 10%] increased damage for 10 seconds upon receiving or applying an elemental buff or debuff that matches the currently selected element.

Buff can be activated while stowed.
entries.officialDescription: Alternate Weapon Action : Changes this weapon's damage type, cycling between Void, Arc, and Solar. Grants this weapon temporarily increased damage when you apply or gain an elemental buff or debuff that matches this weapon's damage type.

entries.title: Rolling Storm
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of 0 Bolt Charge.

While 1 Amplified, this is increased to 2 Stacks.

🡅 Weapon Kills with no active 2 Bolt Charge Stacks grant an additional Stack.
entries.officialDescription:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.
Gain increased Bolt Charge stacks when you have none.

entries.title: Hail Barrage
entries.description:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Kills grant one stack of 'Hail Barrage'. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Hip-firing consumes all stacks to fire 0 Stasis arrows in an evenly spread volley.
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant Stasis arrows. Your next hip-fire shot will fire all of them in a single volley.

entries.title: The Whispers
entries.description:
Grants an extra Melee Ability Charge.

Acts as a copy of the Heavy Handed armor mod.
entries.officialDescription: Gain an additional melee charge. Powered melee final blows spawn an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Unrepentant
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within 3.6? seconds of a kill grants 'Unrepentant' for 10 seconds. Buff is removed on stow.

Unrepentant fires an extended 6-round burst that deals 200% [PVP: 0%] increased damage.
entries.officialDescription: Reloading after defeating a target causes the next burst to be a longer, more powerful superburst.

entries.title: Marksman Optics: Low
entries.description:
Passively decreases Zoom by 2.

Decreasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Decreased Magnification
• Decreased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Increased Absolute Recoil
• Widened Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)
entries.officialDescription: Slightly reduces zoom magnification.

entries.title: Fastball
entries.description: Increases velocity of thrown grenade abilities by ~25%.
entries.officialDescription: Increases grenade throw distance.

entries.title: Snareweaver IV
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.

Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3

At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits 0 Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.

Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [PVP: 5] damage and are 1 Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.

5 second cooldown between 2 Suspends on the same enemy.

3 Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with 4 Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.
entries.officialDescription: Precision hits and final blows build energy towards a Snareweaver arrow that can be fired from the hip. On impact, Snareweaver arrows create a pattern of traps that suspend nearby targets.

entries.title: Snareweaver II
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.

Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3

At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits 0 Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.

Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [PVP: 5] damage and are 1 Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.

5 second cooldown between 2 Suspends on the same enemy.

3 Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with 4 Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.
entries.officialDescription: Precision hits and final blows build energy towards a Snareweaver arrow that can be fired from the hip. On impact, Snareweaver arrows create a pattern of traps that suspend nearby targets.

entries.title: Snareweaver III
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.

Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3

At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits 0 Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.

Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [PVP: 5] damage and are 1 Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.

5 second cooldown between 2 Suspends on the same enemy.

3 Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with 4 Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.
entries.officialDescription: Precision hits and final blows build energy towards a Snareweaver arrow that can be fired from the hip. On impact, Snareweaver arrows create a pattern of traps that suspend nearby targets.

entries.title: Swooping Talons
entries.description:
While airborne, hits increase damage by 10% [PVP: 2%] per hit, up to a maximum of 100% [PVP: 20%]. Cooldown of 0.6 seconds between damage increases.

Buff is reset upon touching the ground.
entries.officialDescription: Dealing damage while airborne increases this weapon's damage output.

entries.title: Surplus
entries.description:
Grants Stat Bonuses depending on the number of Charged Abilities.

Stat Bonuses with 1|2|3+ Charged Abilities:
• 5|15|25 Stability
• 5|25|60 Handling
• 10|25|60 Reload Speed

🡅 Stronger Effect.
entries.officialDescription: Substantially increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

entries.title: Archer's Gambit
entries.description:
Hip-fire Precision Hits grant the following benefits for 🡅5 seconds:
• 60% decreased Draw Time
• 100 Reload Speed
• ? Reload Duration Multiplier

Hip-fire Precision Hits extend the buff duration by 4 seconds up to the maximum of 8 seconds.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1? second.
entries.officialDescription: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw speed bonus for an improved duration. Further precision hits extend the duration.

entries.title: Relentless Tracker
entries.description:
Dealing ability damage to unhighlighted Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player targets highlights them for 10 seconds and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for 16 [PVP: 11] seconds.

Highlight duration is not refreshable.

Killing highlighted targets with weapons matching the element of the highlighting ability spawns an Elemental Pickup corresponding to the element in question.

Elemental Pickups include 0 Firesprites, 1 Ionic Traces, 2 Stasis Shards, 3 Tangles, and 4 Void Breaches.
entries.officialDescription: Damaging a powerful combatant or Guardian with an ability temporarily increases weapon damage of the same type. Defeating that marked target with damage that matches the element creates an Elemental pickup.

entries.title: Hawkeye Hack
entries.description:
Modifies 0 Golden Gun to only fire a single shot that deals 650% increased damage and triggers an immediate 1 Ignition.

The triggered 2 Ignition overrides base 3 Scorch sources and solely benefits from damage increases to the 4 Golden Gun.

(A Celestial Nighthawk Precision Hit is ~85% more damage compared to 3 Precision Hits with Marksman Golden Gun. Also, please only use it with Marksman Golden Gun in PvE)

Scoring a 5 Golden Gun Kill refunds 33% Super Energy and causes the enemy to explode, dealing up to 400 [PVP: ?] damage in a ? meter radius.

Precision Kills grant 1.5-4.5% Super Energy depending on Enemy Rank.

6 Golden Gun no longer receives faster active super generation as a roaming-class super.
entries.officialDescription: Precision final blows reduce the cooldown of your Super. Modifies Golden Gun to fire a single, high-damage shot. Targets defeated by that shot give you Super energy and explode.

entries.title: Upgraded Sensor Pack
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness and Radar remains active while Aiming Down Sights.

Crouching grants Enhanced Radar (6⁠🠚⁠12 sectors).

Damaging a PVE Combatant or breaking a Player's Shields marks them for 3 seconds. Marks are visible through walls.

If an Enemy is below 30% Health:
Increases all outgoing damage against them by 1% for every percentage point below 30%.
(10% Health left 🠚 20% increased damage)

PVE Combatant and Player Shields do not count as Health.
entries.officialDescription: Provides radar while you're aiming. Enhances your radar resolution while crouched. Visually marks targets. Deals more damage to low-health marked targets. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.

entries.title: Worldline Catalyst
entries.description: Temporal Sprint is granted 50% faster (1s🠚0.5s).
entries.officialDescription: Reduces the activation time of Tesseract.

entries.title: Incandescent
entries.description:
Weapon Kills trigger a 0 Solar explosion that applies 30 1 Scorch Stacks (🡅45 with 2 Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 🡅15 more 3 Scorch Stacks.

4 Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

🡅 Having 5 Ember of Ashes equipped or Killing higher-tier targets each increase the amount of 6 Scorch applied by 5 Stacks.
entries.officialDescription:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

entries.title: Wellspring
entries.description:
On Weapon Kill:
Grants 🡅9% Ability Energy split equally amongst all uncharged abilities.

Abilities with multiple charges only receive one third of the ability energy normally split to them once they have a full ability charge ready.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

🡅 Ability Energy Gain is increased by 12.5%. (8%🠚9%)
entries.officialDescription: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

entries.title: Overflow
entries.description:
Upon picking up 0 Special or 1 Heavy Ammo:
Refills and Overfills the Magazine from reserves.

Overfill amount maxes out at 🡅120% of the Magazine Capacity. Activates even while stowed.

🡅 Maximum overfill amount is increased by 20% (rounds up).
entries.officialDescription: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo loads this weapon even further beyond normal capacity.

entries.title: Verglas Curve Catalyst
entries.description: Applying 0 Freeze or 1 Slow to a target decreases Draw Time by 35% (567ms🠚368ms) for ? seconds.
entries.officialDescription: Freezing or slowing a target grants this weapon faster draw speed for a short period of time.

entries.title: The Lost Voice
entries.description:
Replaces 0 Healing Grenades' Restoration Orb with a Healing Turret. Consuming a 1 Healing Grenade will spawn a Healing Turret in front of you.

Passively highlights low-health allies with a soft, flashing, red glow.

Healing Turret information:
• Lasts 9 seconds and has 100? Construct HP
• Releases Healing Seekers every 3 seconds towards the user and allies within 30 meters
• Healing Seekers apply 2 Cure x1 and 3 Restoration x1 for 4 [PVP: 3] seconds in a 7.5 meter radius (strength of both buffs is increased to 4 x2, for the wearer only, while 5 Touch of Flame equipped).

Restoring health to damaged allies [PVP: 6 times] spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy at their position.

10 second cooldown between activations.
entries.officialDescription: Healing grenades spawn a Restorative Turret. Healing allies occasionally spawns an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Acrobat's Dodge
entries.description:
Only usable while on the ground.

Performs a front flip in your movement input's direction and slams down the ground with a 0 Solar Knife.

Upon landing after using 1 Acrobat's Dodge:
• Grants you and allies within ? meters 2 Radiant for 10 seconds (15 with 3 Ember of Solace)
• Deals up to 40 [PVP: 20] damage to targets in a ? meter radius
entries.officialDescription: Dodge to perform an acrobatic leap. Upon landing, make yourself and nearby allies radiant.

entries.title: Magnificent Howl
entries.description:
Scoring a Precision Kill grants 1 Stack of 'Precision Final Blows' up to the maximum of 10 Stacks.

Reloading converts 'Precision Final Blows' Stacks into 'Magnificent Howl' Stacks. Having active 'Magnificent Howl' Stacks prevents you from gaining 'Precision Final Blows' Stacks.

Each shot consumes 1 Stack of Magnificent Howl, granting 🡅55% increased damage and ?% increased Damage Falloff Distance.

Precision Kills with buffed shots refund a Stack of Magnificent Howl.

🡅 Buff is increased by 10% (50%🠚55%).
entries.officialDescription: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds. Improves reload.

entries.title: Arc Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with an 0 Arc Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
entries.officialDescription: Rapid Arc weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Touch of Malice
entries.description:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.

The last round of this gun's magazine deals 132% [PVP: 30%] increased damage, drains 7 HP, and is always refunded when shot. Health drain is not lethal.

Scoring kills or activating 'Charged With Blight' restores 105 HP and begins Health Regeneration.

Healing Activation from kills is based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 33.4%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%
• Players: 66.7%
entries.officialDescription: The final round in the magazine deals bonus damage, drawing from the wielder's life force, and then regenerates itself. Defeating powerful combatants or multiple targets rapidly restores health.

entries.title: High Octane
entries.description:
0 Ignitions that occur within a 70 meter radius of you grant 2 stacks of Composite Propellant.

Reaching 5 stacks of Composite Propellant refills the magazine from reserves.
entries.officialDescription: Igniting nearby targets partially replenishes fuel. This weapon refills itself from reserves upon gaining maximum fuel.

entries.title: Warlord's Sigil
entries.description:
Melee/Glaive Melee Kills grant a stack of 'Warlord's Sigil'. Maximum of 10 stacks. Finishers grant 3 stacks (as soon as their animation starts).

Warlord's Sigil stacks decay one at a time every 4.75 seconds.

Warlord's Sigil grants the following Melee Damage increases at 1|2|3|...|10 stacks:
67.5% | 122% | 166% | 202% | 228% | 249% | 265% | 278% | 289% | 300% Additional Base Melee Damage.

Reaching or refreshing the duration of the 10th stack grants 1 Melee Ability Charge and 'Warlord's Fury Ready' for 8 seconds. The 10th stack's duration cannot be refreshed by Finishers.

Using any Melee while Warlord's Fury Ready is active will grant 'Warlord's Fury' for 10 seconds, granting the following benefits:
• 400% Additional Base Melee Damage
• 0.8x Melee animation duration
• 38.4x Melee ability regeneration speed

Warlord's Sigil's stack count is reset to 0 once Warlord's Fury ends. While Warlord's Fury is active, gaining stacks of Warlord's Sigil is not possible.

Not triggering Warlord's Fury will return the buff to Warlord's Sigil x10.
entries.officialDescription: Melee and finisher final blows increase melee damage. With maximum stacks, you gain vastly increased melee regeneration speed for a short time.

entries.title: Vampire's Caress
entries.description:
Melee Kills grant 0 Cure x3 and 1 Restoration x1.

Finishers grant 2 Cure x3 and 3 Restoration x2.

4 Restoration lasts 8 seconds (12 with 5 Ember of Solace) in both cases.
entries.officialDescription: Melee and finisher final blows instantly grant cure and provide restoration for a short duration.

entries.title: Helium Spirals
entries.description:
Only works with the 0 Solar Element Grenades named 1 Solar Grenade equipped.

2 Solar Grenades have Fastball intrinsically and last 2 seconds longer (4🠚6s normally, 6🠚8s with 3 Touch of Flame equipped).

Powered Melee Kills grant 5 seconds of Sunbracers Ready. Using your Grenade Ability while Sunbracers Ready is active grants the Sunbracers buff.

'Sunbracers' grants 20,000% Additional Base 'Solar Grenade' Regeneration Rate for 4 seconds. (Effectively recharges ~132% of a 'Solar Grenade' charge per second)
entries.officialDescription: Increases the duration of Solar Grenades. Solar melee kills grant unlimited Solar Grenade energy for a brief time.

entries.title: Devil's Ruin Catalyst
entries.description:
Elemental Pickup Interactions grant 30% [PVP: 10%] increased damage for a variable duration based on the pickup. Can be activated while stowed.

0 Ionic Traces, 1 Stasis Shards, and 2 Tangle Detonations grant the buff for 4 seconds. Throwing a held 3 Tangle grants 4 additional seconds. 4 Firesprites and 5 Void Breaches grant the buff for 8 seconds.

Additional Pickups can extend the duration up to the maximum of 16 seconds.

Elemental Pickup Interactions:
• Destroying a 6 Tangle (or Elemental Orbs), either by shooting or throwing.
• Collecting 7 Firesprites, 8 Ionic Traces, 9 Stasis Shards, or 10 Void Breaches

Does not trigger with 11 Stasis Shards generated from Facet of Awakening or Facet of Command.
entries.officialDescription:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include 12 Firesprites, 13 Void Breaches, 14 Ionic Traces, 15 Stasis Shards, and 16 Strand Tangles.

entries.title: Whisper Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 30 Reload Speed.

Aiming Down Sights for 1.2 seconds without shooting grants 'Whispered Breathing' until you leave ADS.

Whispered Breathing grants 35% increased precision damage, and an additional 10.77% increased damage against combatants.
entries.officialDescription: Aiming this weapon without firing for a brief moment grants bonus range and precision damage while it remains zoomed.

entries.title: Trinary Vision
entries.description:
Fires three wave-frame grenade launcher projectiles that can [PVP: cannot] deal overlapping damage.

Each projectile deals 581 [PVP: ?] damage and travels 12 meters across the ground.
entries.officialDescription: One-shot handheld Grenade Launcher. Projectiles release a fan of three energy waves on contact with the ground.

entries.title: Stasis Scavenger
entries.description:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to 0 Stasis Weapons matching the Ammo Type.

Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.
entries.officialDescription: Stasis weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.

entries.title: Slug Rifle
entries.description:
Hip-fired shots become slow traveling projectiles that deal up to 55 [PVP: ?] splash damage in a 3.5 meter radius, down to 0% at the edge of the radius, and apply 5 0 Scorch stacks (10 with 1 Ember of Ashes).

Aiming Down Sights shoots hitscan projectiles that deal splash damage in a 3 meter radius.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon lobs explosive slugs. When you're aiming down sights, the slugs travel fast and straight. When you're firing from the hip, the explosion is larger and applies Scorch to the target.

entries.title: M1R Distribution Matrix
entries.description:
Fires a spread of 5 bolts that alternate [+] and [x] pattern, similar to that of a Vex Wyvern.

Each bolt hit grants 8% Glaive Energy and deals 25% increased damage to Vex Combatants. Glaive Melee Hits on Vex Combatants disorient them.

While blocking with Glaive Energy, grants a 0 Void Overshield at a rate of 14 HP/s to both you and allies within a 15 meter radius. Overshield lasts for 8 seconds (12 with 1 Echo of Persistance).

In PvP, glaive shield uniquely provides 50% Damage Resistance against 2 Primary and Melee Damage from other players (compared to the standard 30%).
entries.officialDescription: Fires a spread. Equipped with a quick-draining shield. Blocking damage with your shield gradually bestows Void overshields to yourself and nearby allies.

entries.title: Paracausal Beam
entries.description:
Deals 400% increased damage to Combatant Shields and Subjugator Bosses.

For the purposes of Microcosm, Tormentors and Subjugators are always considered shielded
entries.officialDescription: Fires a beam of Kinetic light, dealing massive bonus damage to shields.

entries.title: Property: Undecidable
entries.description:
The element of this [weapon | instrument | topology] will change to match your equipped grenade.

Kills grant 20% grenade energy and 2.5% additional Light and Dark Transcendence energy.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon|instrument|topology adapts its damage type to match your equipped grenade. Final blows grant grenade and Transcendence energy.

entries.title: Fan Fire
entries.description:
Hip-Fired Precision Hits deal 88% [PVP: ?] increased damage.

Hip-Fired hits grant a stack of 'Fan Fire' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 4 stacks. Stacks are removed on reload or Aiming Down Sights.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4 stacks:
• 5|10|15|20 Reload Speed
• 5%|10%|15%|20% reduced Accuracy Cone Size
entries.officialDescription: This weapon fires full auto. Hip-fire shots deal bonus precision damage while increasing reload speed and accuracy.

entries.title: Void Resistance
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming 0 Void Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.
entries.officialDescription: Reduces incoming Void damage from combatants.

entries.title: Absolution
entries.description:
On Orb of Power Pickups:
Grants 5%|7.5%|10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Reduces all ability cooldowns each time you pick up an Orb of Power.

entries.title: Pace Yourself
entries.description:
Firing semi-automatically grants the following benefits:

• 33% decreased recoil
• ? decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
• ? decreased Accuracy Cone Size
entries.officialDescription: Tapping the trigger gives this weapon less recoil and improves accuracy.

entries.title: The Manticore Catalyst
entries.description:
While airborne, any kill or 5 hits against an Elite, Miniboss, or Boss refills 12 ammo and grants a 15HP 0 Void Overshield for 6 seconds (9 seconds with 1 Echo of Persistance).

1 second cooldown when activated by hits.

No cooldown when activated by kills.
entries.officialDescription: While you are airborne, sustained damage and final blows with this weapon to difficult combatants grant a Void overshield, reduce combatant accuracy, and return ammo to the magazine.

entries.title: Rites of Ember
entries.description:
0 Daybreak Projectiles trigger a 1 Solar Ignition on hit. Ignitions from any source deal 100% increased damage.

Each enemy damaged by an 2 Ignition grants 40% Melee Ability Energy. 3 Scorched enemies grant 5% Melee Ability Energy per tick.

Solar Fulmination from the Hunter's Journal Artifact doubles the Melee Ability Energy gained, and has its own damage doubled as well.

Does not increase 4 Scorch tick damage.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.officialDescription: Your Daybreak projectiles ignite targets on impact. Your Scorch deals additional damage, and builds to more powerful Ignitions. Dealing damage with Scorch or Ignitions grants melee energy.

entries.title: Silkbound Slayer
entries.description:
Deal 50% [PVP: 20%] increased precision damage against 0 Suspended targets. Bodyshots are granted 125% [PVP: 44%?] increased damage (although reported with yellow numbers, they are not precision hits).

1 Suspending an enemy from any source, or damaging a 2 Suspended enemy with this weapon, grants 100 Reload Speed and 30% decreased Draw Time for 6? seconds.
entries.officialDescription: This weapon deals bonus damage to suspended targets. Gain faster draw time for a short duration when you suspend a target from any source or damage a suspended target with this weapon.

entries.title: Swarmers
entries.description:
Spawns 2 0 Threadlings upon destroying a Tangle.
